kits.name: Engineer Tool Kit
kits.notes:
A comprehensive field kit containing specialized tools required for repairing starships, automated tactical mechs (ATMs), hardware, and weapons. Housed in a durable 1'x1' tech case that can be security-sealed (Dif 20). Contains a tech wand, wirelocks, laser cutter, energy flow monitor, and diagnostic supplies (all devices have rating 10).
-- {1'x1' tech case, tech wand, wirelocks, laser cutter, energy flow monitor, supplies} all are included as Free.

kits.name: Engineer Tool Kit (mso)
kits.notes: An engineer tool kit comes with all the essential tools an engineer would need to repair anything from a ship to an ATM to a weapon. The kit is contained in a 1’x1' tech case which can be security sealed for protection (Dif 20). A typical engineer’s kit contains a tech wand, a set of wirelocks, a laser cutter, energy flow monitor, and miscellaneous supplies. All devices in the kit have a d6 rating. -- {1’x1' tech case, tech wand, wirelocks, laser cutter, energy flow monitor, supplies} all are included as Free

kits.name: Medikit
kits.notes:
A medikit contains the same items as a first aid kit, plus common poison antidotes, common vaccines, a biometer, two slap packs, one genesis capsule, a laser scalpel and a power syringe (for injecting antidotes and vaccines). All items have a 10L rating which may be combined(cat) with any appropriate skill.
The first aid components can be used to heal damage at a -1c adjustment.
-- {poison antidotes, common vaccines, a biometer, two slap packs, one genesis capsule, a laser scalpel and a power syringe (for injecting antidotes and vaccines)} all are included as Free

powers.name: Aiming Bonus (mso)
powers.effect: Aiming focus; +1 Atk on next shot.
powers.notes: This enhancement grants a +1 bonus for each full round which a character spends aiming at a single target. The target may move during this time, but may never go out of sight, or the entire bonus is lost. After two rounds of aiming, the bonus to hit is +2, and after three rounds it is +3 — this is the maximum aiming bonus allowed. Purchased at 3 levels: All Ranged/Hurled, One Class, or One Weapon.

powers.name: Ale Fortitude

powers.name: Alloy Specialist

powers.effect: Sheath or draw 1 weapon; no P cost.

powers.name: Ambidexterity (mso)
powers.effect: Dual-wield without off-hand penalty.
powers.notes: This enhancement allows an individual to use both hands equally well. This means that such activities as writing, throwing, eating, etc. can be done easily with either hand. While this enhancement allows individuals to use a weapon in either hand, it does not allow the individual to make two attacks in a round.

powers.name: Bridge Officer (mso)

powers.notes: This skill works only against hurled and muscle-powered missile weapons such as arrows, spears, rocks, etc. It is not effective against firearms or energy weapons. The psionicist must make a normal skill roll, and reduces the target’s falling damage by the amount obtained. If there is any falling damage left, the normal falling rules still apply (i.e., an AR check is still allowed).

powers.name: Last Chance
powers.effect: If reduced to negative Vit; stay at 1 Vit instead.

powers.name: Last Stand
powers.effect: If reduced to negative Vit; act normally until end of rnd.

powers.name: Lava Pool
powers.effect: Create hazard in 1sq: ✨^✨ or foes entering suffer d✨ burn hazard.

powers.name: Leap of the Colossus
powers.effect: Jump up to 5sq: making Brawl Atk/Dmg to target.

powers.name: Leaping Strike
powers.effect: Leap up to double MR👣; Dmg+2.

powers.name: Legendary Encore
powers.effect: Target (self or ally) reroll one failed roll.

powers.name: Legion’s Might
powers.effect: Each different Weapon has Advantage with next Attack, lasts for encounter.

powers.name: Levitate Other
powers.effect: Disk lifts target vertically; Levitate(✨)^🏃 to resist. Target may hop off; move disk at MR each rnd.

powers.name: Levitate Other (mso)
powers.effect: Rng Medium; levitate target up/down with ✨.
powers.notes: This creates a disk of psionic energy which can lift any one Anthropos sized being. Larger beings require a skill check to overcome the added size (Dif set by GM). Each round a new skill check is made to determine the number of feet the disk rises or lowers (psionicist’s option). The disk may not move horizontally. The disk lasts as long as the user maintains concentration. If used against an enemy, the first lift roll must exceeds the enemy’s Def, otherwise he simply hops to the side of the disk. At any later time the victim may, of course, jump off, but would suffer normal falling damage.

powers.name: Levitate Self
powers.effect: Psionic disk under user: vertical (and slight horizontal) movement. Attacks from below: +AR from disk.

powers.name: Levitate Self (mso)
powers.effect: Levitate up/down 👣 ✨.
powers.notes: This power creates a psionic disk beneath the user, which may lift the psionicist and anything carried. As with levitate others, the disk will move up or down (only) a number of feet each round equal to the psionicist’s skill roll that round. Levitate self lasts while being concentrated on. However, unlike most concentration enhancements, the psionicist may still make an Atk action each round.

powers.name: Life Balance (mso)
powers.effect: Rng Touch; equalize Wnds between 2 living targets.
powers.notes: Life balance allows a sorcist to distribute damage between two living beings. The total amount of damage from both beings is added together. The sorcist then distributes the total as desired (i.e., all to one none to the other, half and half, etc.). A sorcist must make a successful punch attack to touch any unwilling subject. Subjects are not allowed an armor roll, not even for Natural Armor.

powers.name: Life Drain
powers.effect: Tight radius AoE: Life Drain(✨)^✨ → 5 Wnd/rnd cummulative. Per target wounded per round, caster regenerates 1 1st Deg wound.

powers.name: Life Drain (mso)
powers.effect: Rng Short; Atk/Dmg ✨; heal self for Wnds dealt.
powers.notes: This allows the sorcist to drain Vitality. Thin beams emerge from a sorcist’s fingers when using this enhancement. An attack roll is then made based on the sorcist’s skill rating. If the roll hits, that number of maximum Vitality points are permanently drained from the victim. No armor rolls are allowed, not even for Natural Armor. This attack has no effect on non-living targets, such as androids. Due to the devastating effects of this enhancement, GMs should not allow one player character to use it upon another.

powers.name: Life Freeze (mso)
powers.effect: Enter cellular hibernation; suspend bodily functions.
powers.notes: Life freeze allows a character to go into a form of hibernation, and slow all of the body’s natural functions to almost a complete stop. Used voluntarily at any point (no roll needed). If critically wounded, all Vitality drain stops. The character appears dead, and may recover with a successful WP check vs a Dif equal to rounds spent in freeze.

powers.name: Light Healing (mso)
powers.effect: Rng Touch; restore ✨ Vit.
powers.notes: Light healing will heal a number of vitality points equal to the sorcist’s skill roll at -1 (cost is 8). Healing can only be used on living subjects, including the sorcist.

powers.name: Light Sleeper (mso)
powers.effect: Aware while asleep; immune to stealth ambush.
powers.notes: This lets a character make enhanced 👁️ Perception check while sleeping. If a sleeping character’s 👁️ Perception check succeeds, the character may awaken immediately if desired, preventing them from being caught flat-footed by midnight ambushes.

powers.name: Light’s Mercy
powers.effect: Reroll one failed Heal roll.

powers.name: Lightning Jolt
powers.effect: Magic✨ Atk ranged d✨ lightning Dmg.

powers.name: Linebreaker

powers.name: Long Range (mso)

powers.name: Lorekeeper’s Recall

powers.name: Luck Restore (mso)

powers.name: Luck Sustain (mso)

powers.name: Lucky Block🛡️

Psychosomaticists may pass directly through any solid object, living or non living, in their path. This power may be used to walk through walls, get behind opponents, etc. Once through, the psychosomaticist instantly reverts to their normal solid state. Thus, this enhancement may only be used to pass through one item at a time. If a psychosomatic with this enhancement states that they are activating it before making a Defense roll, then the attack misses as it passes right through them (effective on physical weapons only, not on energy weapons). Of course, the character must have Nish and spend their attack action on the enhancement as always.

The number obtained is applied to the first opponent. If it hits, half of that attack result is applied to a second opponent, half of that to a third, etc. Single damage roll applies to all hit.

powers.name: Mystic Sight
powers.effect: Spot hidden foes/traps; Mind👁️ perception roll.

powers.effect: Speak shield’s names; allies in earshot next Nish🚩+2.

powers.effect: ✨+2^🫀 or each successive wounding hit targeting same foe causes +5 cumulative Wnds.

powers.notes: This grants a character an enhanced roll (+3) to control emotions, suppress fear, or resist mental manipulation. The character shows little or no outward sign of their true emotional state, making them highly inscrutable to social analysis.

powers.name: Oathbound Fury
powers.effect: If your Wounds ≥ half Vit; Atk+2 this rnd.

powers.name: Object Reading
powers.effect: Touch item; Magic✨ to learn brief history.

powers.effect: AR+1 for 1 Rnd.

powers.notes: Odonata operatives undergo rigorous stealth, precision, and agility conditioning. Activating this conditioning heightens spatial awareness and muscle control, granting Advantage on Motion, Stealth, Dexterity, and Precision Ranged attacks for the encounter.

powers.notes: Oxygenate allows psychosomaticists to absorb oxygen from their body tissue. When used, the oxygen will sustain the user, eliminating any need for breathing, for a number of rounds equal to the skill’s value. This effects of this enhancement are in addition to the normal amount of time a character can go without air without making a suffocation check (see RB, hazards).

powers.name: Stunning Blow (mso)
powers.effect: +Melee Atk; Dmg -3; Wnds = target Stunned for Encounter.
powers.notes: Delivers a concussive strike to vulnerable pressure points or skull sutures to induce temporary shock and disorientation.

powers.name: Stunning Palm
powers.effect: On unarmed hit: Dmg-2 and 👁️^👁️ or target is Stunned.

powers.name: Subdermal Armor
powers.effect: AR+10 vs explosion, blunt, and chop .

powers.name: Summon Golem
powers.effect: MR(6). Atk/Dmg ✨ Dod/AR(✨)/(✨); Vit =(✨), punches only. Instruct in (LoS).

powers.name: Sun Step
powers.effect: Teleport up to 6sq into sunlight.

powers.name: Sun-Kissed Radiance
powers.effect: Emit bright light (AoE 3r) and dim light (AoE 6r) for Encounter; all allies gain Adv(Atk)^undead in bright light.

powers.name: Sunblessed
powers.effect: Light sources you create glow +1sq radius.

powers.name: Super Hearing
powers.effect: +1c bonus to Awareness (hearing) based rolls. Cannot stack with hearing boost.

powers.name: Super Hearing (mso)
powers.effect: Enhanced audial nerves; 👁️+3 to hearing checks.
powers.notes: This enhancement increases a psychosomaticist’s hearing, granting a +3 bonus to a character’s hearing based 👁️ Perception check. It may not be used in conjunction with hearing boost.

powers.name: Super Vision
powers.effect: +1c bonus to Awareness (sight) based rolls. Cannot stack with vision boost.

powers.name: Super Vision (mso)
powers.effect: Enhanced optical nerves; 👁️+3 to visual checks.
powers.notes: Super vision enhances and improves optical efficiency, granting the user a +3 bonus to a character’s sight based 👁️ Perception check. It may not be used in conjunction with vision boost.

powers.name: Sweep Kick
powers.effect: Atk all adjacent foes for normal Dmg; wounded targets fall Prone.

powers.name: Swift Ready
powers.effect: Swap to new weapon; no P cost.

powers.name: Symbiotic Boost
powers.effect: Symbiote on target: e.g. joints = Might(*2); eyes = Awareness; frame = Fortitude; skull = Mind .

powers.name: Tactical Analysis (mso)
powers.effect: Analyze enemy combat patterns; +3 Def vs target for encounter.
powers.notes: Used to observe an opponent’s fighting style. The character must purposely miss (no attack roll needed) one or more consecutive attacks. For each round spent analyzing in this way, the character receives a +1 bonus to hit that opponent on subsequent rounds, up to a maximum of +3.

powers.name: Tactical Awareness
powers.effect: Melee attacks targeting same foe gain cumulative +2 to Atk/Dmg each round for Encounter.

powers.name: Tactical Insight
powers.effect: Target gains Act(+1) for 1–2 rnds.

powers.name: Tactical Retreat
powers.effect: Break melee Sk(👁️)^👁️; Stealth(🏃) at 10; decoy Stealth(👁️)^👁️, Dur 3. MR to escape.

powers.name: Tail Spike Venom (mso)
powers.effect: +Tail spike natural strike (Brawl); Wnds = Save 🫀^20 or Stunned for Encounter.
powers.notes: A venomous barbed natural tail spike unique to Kryll physiology, capable of injecting paralytic soporific neurotoxins.

powers.name: Target Analysis
powers.effect: Study 1 foe: your next Atk targeting that foe gains Advantage.

powers.name: Target Lock
powers.effect: Per rnd 1 drone: Atk 👁️^Dod to target lock (no Dmg). Ranger tech auto-hits locked; allies gain Atk(+5).

powers.name: Taunt of Stone
powers.effect: Mind👁️ or targets within 2sq must focus Atks on you.

powers.name: Taunting Shout
powers.effect: Mind👁️ or target focuses Atks on you.

powers.name: Techno-Babble
powers.effect: Convince with jargon; Mind👁️ persuasion.

powers.name: Telekinetic Crush
powers.effect: Rng Short; 👁️^👁️ or target suffers d👁️ Dmg and is Immobilized.

powers.name: Telekinetic Glide
powers.effect: Teleport up to 8sq to a visible square on solid ground.

powers.name: Telekinetics
powers.effect: Move inanimate <100 Lb at MR(2) or opponent <100 Lb Grab(✨)^✨.

powers.name: Telepathy
powers.effect: Send thoughts to one individual; range in squares = =(✨). Unwilling: Telepathy(✨)^🫀.

powers.name: Telepathy (mso)
powers.effect: Rng Long; 2-way mental communication.
powers.notes: This enhancement allows the psionicist to send thoughts to another individual within a number of squares equal to the skill’s value. The subject need not be a telepath, but must speak the same language in order to receive a linguistic message — otherwise the subject may only receive images and impressions. Characters sending messages to others who do not speak their language should describe the images being sent, and the GM will determine whether the subject understands or not.

powers.name: Teleport (mso)
powers.effect: Rng Long; teleport self to line of sight.
powers.notes: This allows a sorcist to teleport instantly to another location. The sorcist selects the new location and describes it to the GM, who then determines the enhancement’s cost. Possible costs follow, although they should be reduced (up to half) based upon how familiar the sorcist is with the intended teleport sight: 10' (Dif 5), 100' (Dif 10), 1 mile (Dif 15), 10 miles (Dif 20), 100 miles (Dif 20), 1000 miles (Dif 20), On planet (Dif 20), Adjacent planet (Dif 20), In system (Dif 20). Risk of materializing in a solid object exists.

powers.name: Teleport Self
powers.effect: Teleport self and carried items (not living/sentient) to described location. Teleport(✨)^Dif if destination unknown or changed. Never into solid.

powers.name: Terrain Mastery
powers.effect: +2 to Motion🏃 & Mind👁️ rolls in familiar terrain (forest, desert, etc.).

powers.name: Thermal Resistance
powers.effect: Protects against heat up to 200°; AR+2^heat, fire, and plasma for Encounter.

powers.name: Thorn Shield
powers.effect: AR(✨+13) armor.

powers.name: Thorn Spitter
powers.effect: Max 1 plant, MR(0), Atk/Dmg ✨ spit thorn at a target; Dod/AR(✨-1)/(✨*.7) Vit=(✨-1).

powers.name: Thorn Wall
powers.effect: 4 sq, up to 8 ft high. Per 1×1 sq: Atk/Dmg ✨, Vit =(✨) , Dod/AR(✨-2)/(✨), Tough(💪+2)^💪 to break through.

powers.name: Thoughtweave
powers.effect: 1 target: subtle thought/emotion influence; Persuasion(👁️)^👁️.

powers.name: Throw Weapon (mso)
powers.effect: Throw non-thrown melee weapon up to Rng Short.
powers.notes: This enhancement enables a character to throw melee weapons which normally cannot be thrown, such as swords, clubs, or krays. Thrown melee weapons use normal range attenuation rules (no penalty at 2 squares, -1 at 4, -2 at 6, etc.) and cause normal damage minus the Melee Damage adjustment.

powers.name: Thunder Barge Gunner
powers.effect: Fire mounted siege weapon; Dmg+2.

powers.name: Thunder Barge Pilot
powers.effect: If operating Warmachine; Mind👁️ to grant allies Nish🚩+2 this rnd.

powers.name: Tiger Claw
powers.effect: Make 2 unarmed Atk; if both hit, each is Dmg+1.

powers.name: Tight Grip (mso)
powers.effect: +3 to 💪 checks vs disarm and falling.
powers.notes: This gives a character an enhanced 💪 check (+3) when rolling to hold on to anything, resist being disarmed of their weapon, or climbing ropes under severe strain.

powers.name: Tight Quarters (mso)
powers.effect: Ignore Atk penalties in narrow corridors.
powers.notes: Many battles take place in narrow starship corridors, alien tunnels, or cramped ruins. The tight quarters enhancement enables characters to fight in such surroundings without incurring any of the standard movement or combat attack penalties.

powers.name: Time Flicker
powers.effect: Make any 1 roll this Rnd with Advantage, with a -1 penalty.

powers.name: Tinker Spark
powers.effect: Create tiny device (toy, clicker, light) for Encounter.

powers.name: Tinker Trap
powers.effect: Place small trap; Magic✨ or target suffers Magic✨ Dmg.

powers.name: Tiny Terror
powers.effect: If hidden; Atk with Advantage.

powers.name: Titan’s Grip
powers.effect: Can wield massive objects as improvised weapons (Dmg+2) for encounter.

powers.name: Tornado Spin
powers.effect: Summon whirlwind; Magic✨ Atk pushes adjacent foes away.

powers.name: Tough Blunt Weapons (mso)
powers.effect: +1 AR vs blunt weapons.
powers.notes: Characters with this enhancement have highly resilient skeletons or padding. They may add a permanent +1 bonus to their Armor Rating (AR) checks when defending against blunt weapons (punches, clubs, rocks, maces).

powers.name: Tough Edged Weapons (mso)
powers.effect: +1 AR vs edged weapons.
powers.notes: The character's skin or protective field is reinforced. They may add a permanent +1 bonus to their Armor Rating (AR) checks when defending against edged weapons (swords, daggers, krays).

powers.name: Tough Energy Weapons (mso)
powers.effect: +1 AR vs energy weapons.
powers.notes: This enhancement grants the character a permanent +1 bonus to their Armor Rating (AR) checks when defending against energy weapons (blasters, lasers, plasma swords).

powers.name: Tough Projectile Weapons (mso)
powers.effect: +1 AR vs projectile and kinetic weapons.
powers.notes: This enhancement grants the character a permanent +1 bonus to their Armor Rating (AR) checks when defending against physical kinetic projectiles (renders, disk weapons, scythe cannons).

powers.name: Tough Skin
powers.effect: Skin becomes leathery to rocky: +=(💪-1) AR+ or similar (per Ver).

powers.name: Tough Skin (mso)
powers.effect: Rocky dermal sheath; +2 AR for encounter.
powers.notes: This discipline transforms the user’s skin into a tough, rocky sheath, even more resistant to damage than rough skin. Tough skin gives psychosomaticists +2 to AR (regardless of armor worn), and lasts for a number of rounds equal to their skill’s level. Tough skin can not be used in conjunction with rough skin or iron skin, and is considered gone if the user is rendered unconscious.

powers.name: Towering Stride
powers.effect: MR👣 in a straight line, ignoring most terrain, traps, Blocks, etc.

powers.name: Transportal
powers.effect: Summons 2 portals within range. Willing: auto. Unwilling: Sk(✨)^✨ or relocated. Break Melee chance at Sk(✨)^Atk.

powers.name: Trash Shield
powers.effect: AR+1 for Encounter.

powers.name: Tremor Stomp
powers.effect: Might💪 or nearby foes fall Prone.

powers.name: Tribal Bond
powers.effect: Allies Nish🚩+1 for Encounter.

powers.name: Trick of Light
powers.effect: Disguise as another small creature: 👁️^👁️ to fool suspicious observers.

powers.name: Trickster Blink
powers.effect: Teleport up to 3sq.

powers.name: Trickster’s Feint
powers.effect: 1 free reroll.

powers.name: Trickster’s Gambit
powers.effect: Reroll 1 failed Mind👁️ or Magic✨ roll.

powers.name: Trickster's Glide
powers.effect: Move through foes: ✨^✨ or all allies gain Atk+2 and Def+2 targeting touched foes for 1 Rnd.

powers.name: Tunnel Bastion
powers.effect: Raise 1sq wall of stone; provides cover.

powers.name: Turtle Stance
powers.effect: Regain 1 Vit and gain Resist✨+2 for 1 Rnd; req unarmored or very light armor.

powers.name: Tusks & Claws
powers.effect: All Brawl attacks: Dmg+2.

powers.name: Twin Katar Sweep
powers.effect: Atk with both katars; if both hit, target prone.

powers.name: Twin Strike
powers.effect: Multi-Atk with main and/or off-hand daggers (no uplift) to Mulit-Atk limit +1.

powers.name: Twin Threat
powers.effect: Make Atk with main-hand; if miss, immediately Atk with off-hand.

powers.name: Two Weapons (mso)
powers.effect: Dual-wield two weapons with no off-hand penalty.
powers.notes: This enhancement enables a character to fight with two melee weapons — one in each hand. The character may roll to hit once or twice, but both rolls are made at the same rating — equal to the worst weapon’s Atk or -2 less than the best weapon’s Atk (whichever is the lower). Must be taken for both weapons.

powers.name: Umbral Counter
powers.effect: On successful Def; make 1 opportunity attack.

powers.name: Umbral Form
powers.effect: Teleport between visible shadows.

powers.name: Umbral Heritage
powers.effect: Motion🏃 Stealth with Advantage in dim light or darkness.

powers.name: Umbral Step—Short
powers.effect: Teleport 12sq to visible shadow.

powers.name: Unbending Steel
powers.effect: On hit: target's Atk rolls suffer Disadvantage for 1 Rnd.

powers.name: Uncanny Dodge
powers.effect: Gain Advantage on 1 Defense roll this rnd.

powers.name: Uncanny Dodge (Mental Reflex)
powers.effect: Gain Advantage on 1 Dodge🏃 roll this rnd.

powers.name: Unseen Observer
powers.effect: Detect illusions & glamours with Advantage for encounter.

powers.name: Unyielding Rage
powers.effect: Heal Sk(🫀-2) 1st Deg Wnds; all sqs cost MR(1) unless extreme terrain: Immune to Fear/Stun/Slow/Paralysis/Hold/Poisons/Disease.

powers.name: Vampire Touch (mso)
powers.effect: +Rng Touch; Atk ✨ Dmg ✨ (ignores AR); caster heals Vit equal to Dmg dealt; living targets only.
powers.notes: Channels predatory necrotic sorcery through touch, siphoning the living life essence of an organic victim directly into the caster's own body to mend wounds.

powers.name: Vampiric
powers.effect: Drain Vit from victim to self: Resist(✨)^✨ for Wnds & Healing of Drain(✨-1) Ignores armor. No effect on non-living.

powers.name: Vanguard Conditioning (mso)
powers.effect: Adv(👁️, 🏃, 💪, Ranged)
powers.notes: Marines undergo intensive physical and genetic enhancements (enlarged chest cavities, modified adrenal glands, strengthened immune system, and reinforced muscle fibers). Activating this conditioning grants Advantage on Technology, Dexterity, Strength, Fortitude Resistance (FR), and Ranged attacks for the encounter.

powers.name: Vanish
powers.effect: If unseen; become hidden; you may immediately move up to d4 sq toward a visible shadow.

powers.name: Veil of Beauty
powers.effect: Mind👁️ or target is Charmed 1 rnd (does suggestive bidding if not extreme).

powers.name: Veiled Mind
powers.effect: On successful Resist✨^mental effect: 👁️^👁️ or attacker is Weakened.

powers.name: Vengeance Claw
powers.effect: AoE 1r; Atk/Dmg 💪 targeting all foes who attacked you since your last turn.

powers.name: Verdant Parry
powers.effect: Melee Blk ✨: on failure, you may still attempt a standard Dodge (Def 🏃).

powers.name: Verdant Strider
powers.effect: Vines carry at MR; climb/swim/lift/suspend at MR(*.5) via Acrobatics(🏃) or Athletics(💪).

powers.name: Veteran of the Deeps
powers.effect: Reroll 1 failed Might💪 or Motion🏃 roll.

powers.name: Vine Snare
powers.effect: Rng Short; ✨^🫀 or target is ensnared (MR reduced to 4; Atks targeting them gain Advantage).

powers.name: Vision Boost
powers.effect: Improve optic efficiency: telescopic sight; 👁️+ for vision improved.

powers.name: Vision Boost (mso)
powers.effect: Telescopic vision; 👁️+3 on long range visual checks.
powers.notes: Psychosomaticists with this enhancement can effect the efficiency of their optic nerves, improving vision and providing a form of telescopic sight. Vision boost gives the psychosomaticist +1 to his vision related 👁️ Perception check.

powers.name: Vitalize
powers.effect: Temporary +=(🫀) Vit (temp pool); extra Vit may not be healed.

powers.name: Vitalize (mso)
powers.effect: Gain +2 Vit for encounter.
powers.notes: Using this enhancement, psychosomaticists may temporarily increase their bodily Vitality, and are able to take additional damage in combat. This power may only be used when the psychosomaticist is healthy and unwounded. It adds the psychosomaticist’s skill’s value to his Vit maximum (temporarily, don’t actually change the number in the maximum box). The additional Vit points must be the first ones lost in combat, and they may not be healed once lost. These extra Vit points last for a number of rounds equal to the skill’s value.

powers.name: Vitals Strike
powers.effect: On hit; target Resist✨ or Weakened.

powers.name: Void Field
powers.effect: AR+2 against physical, energy, and magic attacks (no protection against Magic Energy Bolt) for Encounter.

powers.name: Void Healing
powers.effect: Heal living target (including self): restore Heal(✨) Vit. Wounds slide normally.

powers.name: Void Pulses
powers.effect: 1 target; auto-hit target for Dmg ✨.

powers.name: Void Step
powers.effect: Teleport up to 5 sq in any direction within sight, OR Sk(✨)^Atk to phase so Attack passes through caster with no effect.

powers.name: Void Strike
powers.effect: Atk/Dmg ✨ and Sk(✨)^🫀 or target displaced up to 3 sq (caster choice; not in air).

powers.name: Void Vanquish
powers.effect: Sk(✨)^✨ -> Vanquishes to the void, When return have 1/2 Vit, Max of 1 Vanquished.

powers.name: Volcanic Sense
powers.effect: Magic✨ to detect stone weaknesses/passages.

powers.name: Walking Tank Conditioning (mso)
powers.effect: Adv(💪, Heavy Ranged); AR+3
powers.notes: Destrons undergo extreme physiological, genetic, and heavy-weapons training. Activating this conditioning allows the Destron to effortlessly brace and fire massive ordnance, granting Advantage on Technology, Strength, Heavy Weapons, Ranged attacks, and Armor checks for the encounter.

powers.name: Wall of Steel
powers.effect: Blk+2 this Rnd; MR is 0 this Rnd.

powers.name: Wall Run
powers.effect: Move across walls/obstacles up to MR👣; Motion🏃 if risky.

powers.name: Wall Run Kick
powers.effect: Run along wall/obstacle up to MR👣; normal Atk & Dmg on landing.

powers.name: WarCry
powers.effect: Mind👁️ or foes hesitate/flee 1 rnd.

powers.name: Water Breathing
powers.effect: Breathe underwater without rolling for 1 Rnd.

powers.name: Wealthy (mso)
powers.effect: Access extensive credit lines and high-tier gear.
powers.notes: The character comes from a background of significant financial resources. This translates directly to doubling their starting credits during character creation or receiving double pay/allowance under specific conditions (synthesized from Rule Book currency mechanics).

powers.name: Weapon & Board
powers.effect: If you hit with a weapon on your last turn: Atk+1 and Def+1 for 1 Rnd.

powers.name: Weapon Breaker
powers.effect: On successful Might💪 Atk; destroy 1 enemy weapon/shield.

powers.name: Weapon Control
powers.effect: On successful Atk; Motion🏃 disarms target.

powers.name: Weapon Mastery
powers.effect: If you attacked last rnd with same weapon; Atk+2 and Dmg+2 this rnd.

powers.name: Weapons Display (mso)
powers.effect: Demonstrate weapon flourish; Save 🫀 or Intimidated.
powers.notes: Allows the character to demonstrate their mastery of a weapon, displaying trick shooting or flourishes to overawe opponents. Takes an Atk action; roll Atk skill vs opponent’s Shock. If successful, opponents are afraid of the character, and attacks against them are made at a +1 bonus.

powers.name: Weather Sense
powers.effect: Predict weather for 1 day; no roll.

powers.name: Weighted Throw
powers.effect: If you are unseen to Target; Hurl dagger at Advantage.

powers.name: Whirling Dance
powers.effect: Make separate Atk & Dmg rolls targeting 2 adjacent foes.

powers.name: Whirlwind Strike
powers.effect: Atk all foes adjacent to you.

powers.name: Whispered Signal
powers.effect: Allies in earshot gain Nish🚩+1 this rnd.

powers.name: Whizbang
powers.effect: Launch spark/popper; Magic✨ Atk & Dmg+1.

powers.name: Wholeness of Body
powers.effect: Restore 2 Vit to yourself.

powers.name: Wild Gambit
powers.effect: Your next roll has Advantage.

powers.name: Winged Flight
powers.effect: Fly MR👣; Hover in place.

powers.name: Woodland Step
powers.effect: Stealth in natural terrain at MR👣+2; 1 rnd.

powers.name: You Look Kinda Nice When You’re in Danger
powers.effect: When ally is hit; choose: ally AR+d4 or next Dmg+d4.

powers.name: Zero-Gravity (mso)
powers.effect: Combatants unfamiliar with zero-gravity are at a serious disadvantage.
powers.notes: Combatants unfamiliar with zero-gravity are at a serious disadvantage. Zero-Gravity specialists have trained extensively to deal with the three-dimensional physics and movement restrictions of low-g or zero-g space, allowing them to move and fight without penalty.

skills.name: Acrobatics (mso)
skills.notes: Acrobatics is the ability to do jumps, flips, tumbles, feats of balance, etc. Successful acrobatics checks allow a character to cross hazardous terrain, dodge falling obstacles, and perform dramatic physical maneuvers.

skills.name: Astrogation (mso)
skills.notes: Astrogation is the ability to plot the best, fastest and safest course through space. With astrogation a character is able to determine safe landing spots, orbital trajectories, etc., and use the skill to assist the helmsman. Simple planet-to-planet course plotting requires no roll; interstellar travel through unexplored space or wormholes requires challenging rolls.

skills.name: Bridge Officer (mso)
skills.path: ["Ship Officer Astrogation (mso)", "Ship Officer Comms (mso)", "Ship Officer Engineer (mso)", "Ship Officer Fighter Pilot (mso)", "Ship Officer Helm (mso)", "Ship Officer Medic (mso)", "Ship Officer Programmer (mso)", "Ship Officer Scientist (mso)", "Ship Officer Tactical (mso)", "Marine (mso) {Trait}", "Warrior (mso) {Trait}", "Dragon (mso) {Trait}", "Mutak (mso) {Trait}", "Destron (mso) {Trait}", "Mensi (mso) {Trait}", "Warlock (mso) {Trait}", "Cyber Warrior (mso) {Trait}", "Bio-Gunner (mso) {Trait}", "Bio-Warrior (mso) {Trait}"]

skills.name: Climbing (mso)
skills.notes: This skill enables the character to climb sheer or precarious surfaces which would normally be too difficult to climb. The GM assesses a difficulty rating based on the surface; a successful check completes the climb, while a failure indicates a fall.

skills.name: Cloak (mso)
skills.notes: Cloak allows a character to operate a cloaking device. Without this skill activating a cloaking device is a related Tech roll. Under normal conditions, individuals skilled at cloak need not make a die roll to activate it. Only in special circumstances will the GM assess a Dif. When a cloaked vessel is scanned, characters with this skill may combine(cat) their rating with the cloak’s rating if they are manning the cloaking device.

skills.name: Common Sense (mso)
skills.path: ["Ship Officer Captain (mso)", "Ship Officer Medic (mso)", "Ship Officer Scientist (mso)", "Warlock (mso)"]

skills.name: Computer (mso)
skills.path: ["Ship Officer Programmer (mso)", "Ship Officer Medic (mso)", "Ship Officer Scientist (mso)"]
skills.notes: This skill allows a character to operate most computers. It also allows a character to track down programming errors, glitches, etc., and to fix them. Normal operations require no roll; hacking or custom programming require specialized checks or the related enhancements.

skills.name: Comtech (mso)
skills.path: ["Ship Officer Captain (mso)", "Ship Officer Comms (mso)", "Ship Officer Programmer (mso)"]
skills.notes: Comtechs are skilled with the use of intership communication devices. They may open and close communications and maintain communication links under difficult circumstances. If communications are being jammed, a roll must be made to break through before any additional communications function may be used.

skills.name: Concealment (mso)
skills.notes: This is the ability to conceal oneself or an item from others’ view. Concealment is rolled vs potential onlooker’s Awa. Unenhanced, a concealed character may only move one square per round without automatically being detected.

skills.name: Counter Security (mso)
skills.notes: This skill enables a character to break through most forms of security devices and measures. This includes picking old world mechanical locks, jury rigging electronic doors, breaking security codes, and otherwise gaining entry to secured areas.

skills.name: Damage Control (mso)
skills.notes: This skill enables characters to prevent system failure on board vehicles and ships which have taken critical damage, as described in RB, combat, vehicle, system failure. The roll is combined(cat) with the ship’s damage control rating (if any). This skill has virtually no other use (i.e., it is not a repair skill by itself).

skills.name: Demolitions (mso)
skills.notes: Demolitions is the skill of being able to set explosive charges so they will detonate in a desired fashion. Note this is not a combat skill and may not be used when throwing grenades or other explosives at opponents. When explosive damage is rolled, it is combined(cat) with this skill.

skills.name: Detect Lie (mso)
skills.notes: This skill allows a character to determine whether an individual is telling the truth. Note that, as this is an intuitive skill, the PC will only have a 'gut feeling' whether the individual is telling the truth or not. Lie detection is rolled vs the subject's Int. If the roll fails, the GM may misinform the player.

skills.name: Disguise (mso)
skills.notes: Characters with disguise can make themselves look different, hiding their own appearance. This skill requires the use of props: makeup, clothing, brushes, even dirt. The skill roll is combined(cat) with the prop's rating (such as a disguise kit). Disguise attempts are rolled vs the Awa of any observer.

skills.name: Dominate (mso)
skills.notes: This skill enables PCs to force NPCs to do their bidding through sheer Will Power (fear in most cases). When attempting to dominate, the PC rolls their skill vs the opponent’s WP. If the roll succeeds, the NPC is compelled to follow the PC’s instructions. This skill should never be used upon a fellow PC.

skills.name: Drive Vehicle (mso)
skills.notes: This skill allows a character to drive any planetary vehicle, except for craft purely designed for flying. This includes transports, armored vehicles, hyperbikes, etc. Normal driving requires no roll; driving in rugged terrain, during a high speed chase, or in severe storms requires a skill roll.

skills.name: Empathy (mso)
skills.notes: This skill borders upon the psionic realm. Empathy allows characters to sense others’ moods — sad, angry, happy, depressed, etc. Characters make a skill roll vs the opponent’s WP to determine their emotional state. Highly reserved races like the Calemora impose a -3 penalty to the check.

skills.name: Falling (mso)
skills.notes: Falling skill allows a character to fall a number of feet equal to his skill roll without damage. A skill roll of 20, for example, would enable a character to fall 4 sq without injury. If the fall exceeds the skill roll, the falling damage is reduced by the amount of the roll. In any event the typical AR check is still allowed.

skills.name: Fast Talk (mso)
skills.notes: This skill enables a character to persuade another to his or her point of view. It may be used while bartering with a merchant, while attempting to get past officious guards, when dealing with troublesome planetary officials, etc. Fast talk rolls are made against an opponent’s Int.

skills.name: First Aid (mso)
skills.notes: First aid allows a character to heal damage to an injured individual. This skill restores a number of points equal to a single skill roll at -3, and it can only be used once per character after combat. It may also be used once every eight hours without penalty if the patient is under first aid care. It can also be used to stop Vitality drain by beating a difficulty of 5x the critical damage.

skills.name: Gambling (mso)
skills.notes: Gambling allows a character to have better odds than others when playing games of chance. If the game involves rolling dice or using cards in reality, the player gets to roll twice or draw extra cards. Otherwise, the roll is combined(cat) with this skill. Grants +3 to straight Luck checks during games.

skills.name: General Knowledge (mso)
skills.notes: This skill represents broad knowledge and understanding. The skill can be used if the player wishes to determine if his character knows something. Also, if everyone is allowed to make an 👁️ check on a knowledge based subject, this character should make the roll combined(cat) with this skill.

skills.name: Interrogate (mso)
skills.notes: Interrogate allows a character to extract information from an individual through selective use of psychology, threats, etc. This skill need not involve actual violence (indeed, violence is often counterproductive). Interrogate rolls are made against the subject’s WP.

skills.name: Language, Anthropian (mso)
skills.notes: Native racial language fluency for Anthropos.

skills.name: Language, Calemoran (mso)
skills.notes: Native racial language fluency for Calemora.

skills.name: Language, Catongi (mso)
skills.notes: Native racial language fluency for Calemora.

skills.name: Language, Dracan (mso)
skills.notes: Native racial language fluency for Draca.

skills.name: Language, Kryll (mso)
skills.notes: Native racial language fluency for Kryll.

skills.name: Language, Pheromonal (mso)
skills.notes: Native racial language fluency for Kryll.

skills.name: Language, Shanask (mso)
skills.notes: Native racial language fluency for Shanask.

skills.name: Language, Zin-Shee (mso)
skills.notes: Native racial language fluency for Zin-Shee Female.

skills.name: Medtech (mso)
skills.notes: Medtech is a medical skill which enables characters to heal serious wounds, set complex fractures, perform surgery, etc. Medtechs may heal damage to characters once after each combat in which the patient received damage. Rolls on other races suffer a -3 penalty unless the Alien Medtech enhancement is taken. Curing blindness, deafness, disease, and poison are related rolls at -3.

skills.name: Navigate (mso)
skills.notes: This skill governs the ability to plot planet surface courses. Navigation difficulty is based upon a character’s familiarity with the planet in question, and the ruggedness of terrain. A vehicle driver may combine(cat) his skill with the navigator's when making drive checks.

skills.name: Nish
skills.notes: Specialized kinetic movement, acrobatics, agility, and rapid relocation.

skills.name: Pilot Small Craft (mso)
skills.notes: This skill enables the user to pilot small, one- or two-person air- and spacecraft, including military fighters, bombers and civilian craft. If such craft is armed, the pilot can also fire forward-firing weapons as a related roll. In combat, the pilot can use this skill to exceed a craft's normal operating limitations.

skills.name: Pilot Starship (mso)
skills.notes: These pilots are skilled in flying starships at sublight speeds. This is a complex and dangerous job, for it often involves negotiating hazardous asteroid fields, flying into wormholes (Dif 10-30), and evading enemy fire. Landings in large vessels are exceptionally difficult (Dif 20+).

skills.name: Raise Shields (mso)
skills.path: ["Ship Officer Fighter Pilot (mso)", "Ship Officer Helm (mso)", "Ship Officer Tactical (mso)"]
skills.notes: This skill simply allows an individual to operate a ship or vehicle’s shields. Raising shields under normal conditions does not require a skill roll. In battle or during severe cosmic turbulence, a roll may be required. Directly manipulating shields allows the character to combine(cat) their rating with the shield's AR.

skills.name: Repair Armor (mso)
skills.notes: Repair armor allows a character to fix personal armor such as flack jacket, marine armor, destron armor, shields, etc. Common repairs include fixing physical damage, power armor short circuits, etc. This skill does not apply to cyber armor or ship/vehicle hull armor.

skills.name: Repair ATM (mso)
skills.notes: Repair ATM is the skill of repairing ATMs such as drones, androids, walkers and all similar guild robots. Other unique ATMs, such as imperial cybertanks, may also be repaired as a related roll. One roll at -3 is allowed immediately after combat to repair damage points equal to the check result.

skills.name: Repair Cybernetics (mso)
skills.notes: This skill represents the ability to analyze and repair cybernetic implants. The GM assigns a Dif; success indicates the repair is complete. If the implant is not removable, on the patient's external surface, or otherwise exposed (through cyber-surgery), the repair cannot be made. Cybertank repairs are made at -3.

skills.name: Repair Equipment (mso)
skills.notes: This skill represents the ability to operate, analyze, and repair equipment items. It can be combined(cat) with tools. It does not apply to ship/vehicle systems, ATMs, ship/vehicle/ATM damage, weapons, armor, or cybernetics.

skills.name: Repair Hull (mso)
skills.notes: This skill allows characters to repair general damage to a ship or vehicle, including doors, cargo bays, and outer armor plating. It does not allow a character to fix ship systems. Repairs during combat require rolling at -3, fixing a number of Hull Points equal to the result.

skills.name: Repair System (mso)
skills.path: ["Ship Officer Engineer (mso)", "Ship Officer Astrogation (mso)", "Ship Officer Captain (mso)", "Ship Officer Comms (mso)", "Ship Officer Programmer (mso)", "Ship Officer Fighter Pilot (mso)", "Ship Officer Helm (mso)", "Ship Officer Medic (mso)", "Ship Officer Scientist (mso)", "Ship Officer Tactical (mso)"]
skills.notes: This skill enables a character to make repairs on any one ship or vehicle station/system (e.g. computer, science station, scanners, engines, communications, helm, tactical, or medical). Additional systems require the 'Additional System' enhancement.

skills.name: Repair Weapon (mso)
skills.notes: Repair weapon allows a character to fix personal weapons such as swords, pistols, cannons, etc. Common repairs include fixing jams, short circuits, and power pack malfunctions. Heavier weapons, including vehicle- and ship-class weapons, are related rolls. Does not apply to cybernetic weapons.

skills.name: Resist Death
skills.notes: Defying mortal trauma, stabilizing critical injuries, and death saving throws.

skills.name: Scanners (mso)
skills.path: ["Ship Officer Astrogation (mso)", "Ship Officer Comms (mso)", "Ship Officer Medic (mso)", "Ship Officer Programmer (mso)", "Ship Officer Scientist (mso)", "Ship Officer Tactical (mso)"]
skills.notes: This skill allows an individual to operate all types of scanners. Any use of scanners requires a skill roll. The operator asks the GM a single, precise yes/no question. If scanners are being jammed, the operator must first roll to break through the jamming before scanning.

skills.name: Sensors (mso)
skills.path: ["Ship Officer Astrogation (mso)", "Ship Officer Fighter Pilot (mso)", "Ship Officer Helm (mso)", "Ship Officer Programmer (mso)", "Ship Officer Scientist (mso)", "Ship Officer Tactical (mso)"]
skills.notes: This skill enables a character to use all types of sensors. Unlike scanners, sensors are preset to detect some phenomenon or condition and alert the crew automatically. The GM has the player roll when the parameters of the sensor setting have occurred in the vicinity.

skills.name: Ship Gunner (mso)
skills.path: ["Ship Officer Fighter Pilot (mso)", "Ship Officer Helm (mso)", "Ship Officer Tactical (mso)", "Destron (mso)"]
skills.notes: Gunners may shoot all fixed position guns on board a ship. A gunner’s attack roll is equal to his or her skill rating combined(cat) with the ship’s Atk rating. Damage is equal to the ship’s Dmg rating. Due to slightly different controls, firing vehicle guns with this skill is a related roll.

skills.name: Ship Power (mso)
skills.path: ["Ship Officer Captain (mso)", "Ship Officer Engineer (mso)", "Ship Officer Fighter Pilot (mso)", "Ship Officer Helm (mso)"]
skills.notes: Powering up a ship requires a Tech roll vs the ship's rating; those with this skill can power up any familiar type of ship automatically. This skill also governs the redirection and transfer of power from one system to another (e.g. engines to shields, increasing AR but lowering MR).

skills.name: Stealth (mso)
skills.notes: This skill allows a character to move without making a sound. Under conditions where other characters make 🏃 check, the stealth character combines(cat) stealth with Dex. If related 🏃 check are required, the character checks straight stealth. Works on nearly any terrain.

skills.name: Survival (mso)
skills.notes: Survival allows characters to live in extremely hostile environments (assuming normal atmospheric pressure and breathable air are present). Survivalists know what plants and animals are edible, how to find or build shelter, and how to obtain drinkable water. Finding water in a desert is Dif 20-30.

skills.name: Swimming (mso)
skills.notes: Without this skill, characters must pass an 🏃^10 check to dog-paddle at 👣 1 or risk drowning. Possessing this skill allows unhindered swimming in calm waters; navigating turbulent waters (rapids, rip tides, stormy seas) requires an 🏃^Dif check. Swimming movement rate equals half the character's 🏃 die.

skills.name: Theft (mso)
skills.notes: Theft is a general skill involving taking objects without being detected. This includes pickpocketing, palming items, and shoplifting. Theft is rolled directly vs the onlooker’s Awa, adjusted by the size of the item and proximity.

skills.name: Tracking (mso)
skills.notes: Tracking allows a character to follow another individual or an animal by observing tracks, disturbances in vegetation, or odors. Tracking can be done in any environment, but hard surfaces (rock, concrete) increase difficulty dramatically (Dif 20-30). Difficulty typically doubles for each hour elapsed.

skills.name: Tractor/Repulsor Beam (mso)
skills.notes: This skill allows an individual to operate a tractor or repulsor beam on a ship or vehicle. The character’s skill rating is combined(cat) with the beam's rating to determine accuracy and hold strength.

skills.name: Transporter (mso)
skills.notes: This skill gives a character the ability to operate any type of transporter. Under ordinary conditions, no rolls are needed to use a transporter. In combat, at extreme ranges, or under heavy atmospheric interference, a skill check vs a GM-assigned Dif is required.

skills.name: Vehicle Gunner (mso)
skills.notes: Vehicle gunners are skilled in firing vehicle-mounted weapons. Firing ship-class guns with this skill is considered a related roll. Accuracy is determined by combining(cat) the skill with the vehicle's weapon rating.

skills.name: Vehicle Power (mso)
skills.notes: Personal sized and street vehicles can be powered on by nearly any character without difficulty. Powering up large combat transports usually requires a Tech roll. Vehicle power allows characters to power up any familiar vehicle without rolling and manage power transfers.

spec_rules.name: Absent-Minded (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Must pass 👁️ check to remember important facts, gear, or instructions.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must make Int rolls to remember important items, names, dates, places, appointments, etc. The Dif is anywhere from 5-20 or more depending on the situation.

spec_rules.name: Acoustic Receptors (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Processes sound and pressure changes via sensory skin receptors across chest and back.
spec_rules.notes: Lacking external ears or ear holes, they process sound and pressure changes through specialized sensory receptors lining their chests and backs.

spec_rules.name: Acoustic Whisper Bypass (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Raspy whisper carries across vacuum/wind, cannot be electronically recorded, and can selectively target listeners.
spec_rules.notes: Communicate in a raspy, low-volume whisper that carries perfectly over distances. This whisper is clearly audible even in a perfect vacuum or above a screaming wind, but it cannot be picked up or recorded by any electronic device. They may selectively choose who may hear their words.

spec_rules.name: Adaptable Spirit
spec_rules.effect: Learn 1 extra skill without skill restrictions.
spec_rules.notes: Human racial passive trait.

spec_rules.name: Ahuk Companionship (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Tames and rides massive 10-legged reptilian Ahuk beasts as honored companions.
spec_rules.notes: Traditionally tame and ride massive, 10-legged reptilian beasts called Ahuk (which grow from the size of a dog to a 10-ton elephant). Tracking, capturing, and taming a wild Ahuk single-handedly is one of the highest honors a warrior can achieve.

spec_rules.name: Anthropos Description (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Perception 👁️; sharp vision/hearing; luck & tech affinity.
spec_rules.notes: Evolved from ancient humanity, the Anthropos are highly social and adaptable six-foot-tall humanoids with exceptionally sharp vision and hearing, who have lost almost all body hair except for head and facial hair. They favor full-body clothing, adorned with status-revealing jewelry, and enter combat heavily armored in high-tech suits with energy shields. Their defining traits remain their insatiable curiosity, legendary luck, and brilliant grasp of technology.

spec_rules.name: Anthropos Dimensions & Lifespan (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Height (5'6" to 7'0"); Weight (160 to 335 lbs); Starting Age 15 to 40 years.
spec_rules.notes: Allowed Genders: Male or Female. Starting Age Formula: 15 to Max: 40 years). Height Formula: 66 inches (Max: 84 inches). Weight Formula: 10 + 150 lbs (Max: 335 lbs).

spec_rules.name: Anthropos Physiology & Activity Cycle (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Vision 180° FOV; Diurnal (8h sleep/16h active); Omnivore (3 meals/day).
spec_rules.notes: Vision: Standard visible spectrum, full color, with a stable 180-degree field of view. Their hearing range is nearly equal to a dog. Sleep: Diurnal. Typically require 8 hours of sleep and remain active for 16 hours, though this adjusts to the planetary cycle of their location. Diet: Omnivores. Consume 3 meals daily, usually scheduled immediately before and after sleep cycles, and prefer to consume liquids with and between meals. Taste is their most sophisticated sense.

spec_rules.name: Anthropos Racial Weapons (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain +1 Atk/Dmg with Antrops Weapons (list is in notes)
spec_rules.notes: Racial weapon proficiency granting Anthropos +1 Atk/Dmg with: Combat Knife, Force Gauntlet, Grenade Launcher Underbarel, Render, Sonic Disrupter, Sonic Sword.

spec_rules.name: Arcane Volatility
spec_rules.effect: Natural 1 on ✨ check = trigger minor chaotic surge.
spec_rules.notes: Handicap / tactical rule exception.

spec_rules.name: Archaic Weapons Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain Archaic Weapons Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Dragons may become skilled in all Archaic Weapons.

spec_rules.name: Archer Weapon Mastery (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Bows and Crossbows.
spec_rules.notes: Combat style mastery granting +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Bows and Crossbows.

spec_rules.name: Attunement of the Hive (mso)
spec_rules.effect: 👁️+3 within range of translator or pheromone node; Adv(👁️) in direct communication with hive-queen.
spec_rules.notes: The Kryll gain +3 Mind bonus when within range of a translator-caste Kryll or a pheromone node, and Adv(Mind) if they are in direct communication with the hive-queen

spec_rules.name: Bad Balance (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to all 🏃 checks requiring balance, tightropes, or narrow ledges.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must roll at a -3 penalty for all acts which require good balance.

spec_rules.name: Bad Defense vs Body (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 Def vs body and natural attacks.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap take a -3 Def penalty vs body weapons.

spec_rules.name: Bad Defense vs Hurled (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 Def vs hurled and thrown weapons.
spec_rules.notes: This handicap inflicts a -3 penalty on all Def rolls vs hurled weapons.

spec_rules.name: Bad Defense vs Melee (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 Def vs swords, axes, and melee weapons.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap take a -3 Def penalty vs melee weapons.

spec_rules.name: Bad Defense vs Ranged (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 Def vs blasters, rifles, and ranged weapons.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap have a -3 penalty on Def rolls vs ranged weapons.

spec_rules.name: Bad Jumper (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to all vertical and horizontal jump checks.
spec_rules.notes: A character with this handicap suffers a -3 penalty to all attempts to jump, either for height or distance.

spec_rules.name: Bad Runner (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to all 🏃 running and sprinting checks.
spec_rules.notes: A character with this handicap suffers a -3 penalty to all rolls to run.

spec_rules.name: Bio-Gunner Conditioning (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 to Biotech, Dexterity, Hurled, Speed, Fortitude, and Ranged.
spec_rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Biotech, Dexterity, Hurled, Speed, Fortitude, and Ranged attributes.

spec_rules.name: Bio-Gunner Focus (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Specialized in Kryllian biological ranged and hurled weaponry.
spec_rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Specialized in Kryllian biological ranged and hurled weaponry (such as weapons that spit acid, fire bore-worms, or physically latch onto enemies).

spec_rules.name: Bio-Warrior Conditioning (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 to Biotech, Strength, Fortitude, Def, Melee, Body, Nish, and Shock.
spec_rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Biotech, Strength, Fortitude, Defense, Melee, Body, Nish 🚩, and Shock attributes.

spec_rules.name: Bio-Warrior Focus (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Master of biological close combat, organic melee weapons, and troop guidance.
spec_rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Master of biological close combat, organic melee weapons (which burrow into target flesh or eat them upon contact), and guiding troops through hazardous, alien environments.

spec_rules.name: BioTech Armor Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain BioTech Armor Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Bio-Gunners may become skilled in all BioTech Armor.

spec_rules.name: BioTech Melee Weapons Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain BioTech Melee Weapons Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Bio-Warriors may become skilled in all BioTech Melee and Body Weapons.

spec_rules.name: BioTech Ranged Weapons Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain BioTech Ranged Weapons Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Bio-Gunners may become skilled in all BioTech Ranged and Hurled Weapons.

spec_rules.name: BiotTech Metabolic Symbiote Suite (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Feeder, Oxygenator Worm, Platelet Mites, Tube-Worms gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Hybrid Set: Kryll Metabolic Symbiote Suite

spec_rules.name: BiotTech Sensory Symbiote Suite (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Bionoculars, Audio-Beetle gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Hybrid Set: Kryll Sensory Symbiote Suite

spec_rules.name: Blaster Weapon Mastery (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Blaster Weapons.
spec_rules.notes: Combat style mastery granting +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Blaster Weapons.

spec_rules.name: Blood-Bonds over Friendship (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Forms sacred warrior blood-bonds sealed with cybernetic implant exchanges.
spec_rules.notes: Traditional military doctrine shuns the concept of "friendship" because commanders must remain unemotional when ordering soldiers to their deaths. Instead, warriors form sacred "blood-bonds," which are highly valued and often sealed with the exchange of precious, ancestral cybernetic implants.

spec_rules.name: Boor (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to all social and diplomatic interaction checks.
spec_rules.notes: The character is socially obnoxious, and annoying. Individuals with this handicap must take a 1c to Cha in all social settings in which being a boor would be a disadvantage. Players should roleplay the character in a suitably boorish manner.

spec_rules.name: Bridge Officer (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +2 to all operational ability rolls on ship systems.
spec_rules.notes: Role mastery for starship and vehicle commanders granting +2 to all operational ability rolls.

spec_rules.name: Calemora Description (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Massive 5'6" copper-skinned humanoids with acoustic skin receptors, martial arts, and tissue control.
spec_rules.notes: Standing at an average of 5'6" but packing 350 pounds of solid, copper-skinned muscle, the Calemora are primitive humanoids with massive, V-shaped torsos and arms as strong as their legs. They completely lack external ears or ear holes, instead detecting sound vibrations through specialized sensory receptors lining their chests and backs. Disdaining armor and propelled firearms, they wear only basic loincloths to leave their acoustic skin-receptors exposed, relying instead on martial arts and supreme psychosomatic control over their own tissue.

spec_rules.name: Calemora Dimensions & Lifespan (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Male Only, Height (5'0" to 6'4"); Width (3'6" to 4'10"); Weight (270 to 570 lbs); Starting Age 30 to 60 years.
spec_rules.notes: Allowed Genders: Male only. Age Formula: 30 years (Max: 60 years). Height Formula: 60 inches (Max: 76 inches). Weight Formula: 270 lbs (Max: 570 lbs). Width Formula: 42 inches (Max: 58 inches).

spec_rules.name: Calemora Physiology & Activity Cycle (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Infrared 180° FOV; No sleep (4h daily meditation); Herbivore (roots/tubers, zero liquid needed).
spec_rules.notes: Vision: Infrared spectrum, white-to-pink shades representing heat signatures, and monochrome red, with a stable 180-degree field of view. Sleep: Do not sleep. Instead, they must rest and meditate for 4 hours daily; failing to do so results in a severely shortened lifespan. Diet: Strict herbivores. Subsist on fleshy, water-rich planetary roots. This diet completely eliminates their need to drink liquids; however, if roots are unavailable, they must consume outworld tubers (potatoes, radishes) and supplement with water.

spec_rules.name: Calemora Racial Weapons (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain +1 Atk/Dmg with Calemora Weapons (list is in notes)
spec_rules.notes: Racial weapon proficiency granting Calemoran +1 Atk/Dmg with: Axe, Ba-Shonk, Hook-Pa, Ka Jung, Kray, Ra-oot, Sword, Ta-oon.

spec_rules.name: Camouflage Mounts (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Rides cybernetically upgraded, color-shifting feline Pouncers as armored war-mounts.
spec_rules.notes: Capture and cybernetically upgrade giant feline predators called "Pouncers" (which can shift their skin pigmentation to match any terrain) to serve as heavily armored war-mounts.

spec_rules.name: Carbine Weapon Mastery (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Carbine Weapons.
spec_rules.notes: Combat style mastery granting +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Carbine Weapons.

spec_rules.name: Catongi Temperature Language (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Non-verbal communication via psychosomatic body temperature shifts at chakra points.
spec_rules.notes: When in close proximity, Calemora communicate non-verbally through Catongi—using psychosomatic control to alter their body temperature at specific sensitive points called chakra. Covering these chakra points severely slows down communication. It is a highly subtle language that is incredibly difficult for other species to learn, requiring specialized infrared equipment.

spec_rules.name: Chapter Inception Armament Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Sorce Saber, Warrior Claws, Vanguard Shield, Marine Assault Suit gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Sorce Saber, Warrior Claws, Vanguard Shield, Marine Assault Suit gain a +1 to all rolls

spec_rules.name: Clumsy (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Must pass 🏃 check when handling delicate items or drop/fumble.
spec_rules.notes: This handicap requires that a character roll a 🏃 check when handling something fragile or in attempts to catch things. All such checks are made at a -3 penalty.

spec_rules.name: Code of Honor
spec_rules.effect: Bound by chivalry: must accept honorable surrenders and never strike a helpless foe.
spec_rules.notes: Handicap / tactical rule exception.

spec_rules.name: Color Blind (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Cannot perceive colors; functions in monochrome vision.
spec_rules.notes: This handicap indicates that a character cannot see colors at all. It may only be taken by members of races who see in color.

spec_rules.name: Comfort-Driven Quarters (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Prioritizes luxury over military utility with dense cozy napping niches.
spec_rules.notes: They prioritize luxury over military utility. The Zin-Shee moon base is characterized by plush furniture, incredibly sparse workspaces, and a massive density of cozy napping niches.

spec_rules.name: Cyber Implants Choice (mso)
spec_rules.effect: May buy any 3 CyberTech Exotics at 1/2 Price.
spec_rules.notes: Specialized Training Tree: May choose any 3 other cyber implants (of choice).

spec_rules.name: Cyber Warrior Conditioning (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 to Fortitude, Cybernetics, and Vitality.
spec_rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Fortitude, Cybernetics, and Vitality attributes.

spec_rules.name: Cyber Warrior Focus (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Heavy mechanical, protective, and sensory cybernetic skeletal enhancements.
spec_rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Operates under the philosophy that the biological flesh is imperfect. Enhances their skeletal frame with heavy mechanical, protective, and sensory cybernetic implants.

spec_rules.name: CyberTech Armor Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain CyberTech Armor Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Cyber Warriors may become skilled in all CyberTech Armor Implants.

spec_rules.name: CyberTech Weapons Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain CyberTech Weapons Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Cyber Warriors may become skilled in all CyberTech Weapons and Weapon Implants.

spec_rules.name: Deep Sleeper (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to 👁️ checks to awaken from loud noises or disturbances.
spec_rules.notes: A deep sleeper will sleep through virtually anything, and suffers a -3 penalty when attempting to wake up, even in the face of loud noise, attack, etc.

spec_rules.name: Destron Conditioning (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 to Technology, Strength, Ranged, and Dexterity.
spec_rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Technology, Strength, Ranged, and Dexterity attributes.

spec_rules.name: Destron Focus (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Walking technological dreadnought employing heavy tech armor and artillery.
spec_rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Walking technological dreadnoughts. Employs heavy walking-tank armor and high-firepower artillery weapons that require power assistance to even lift.

spec_rules.name: Draca Description (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Massive 6'6" reptilian warriors with heavy cybernetic implants, razor jaws, and ritual taillessness.
spec_rules.notes: The Draca are massive, 6'6" bipedal reptilian warriors with thick, scaled skin, clawed extremities, and heavy, razor-toothed jaws. They wear only a loincloth and a tribal chest sash decorated with accolades, though they are instantly recognizable by the brutal, highly customized cybernetic armor and implants riveted directly to their skulls and skeletons. Obsessed with martial prowess, their grim appearance is often marked by the ritual removal of their tails at birth to avoid looking primitive.

spec_rules.name: Draca Dimensions & Lifespan (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Height (6'0" to 7'6"); Weight (250 to 430 lbs); Starting Age 10 to 50 years.
spec_rules.notes: Allowed Genders: Male or Female Age Formula: 10 years (Max: 50 years). Height Formula: 72 inches (Max: 90 inches). Weight Formula: 250 lbs (Max: 430 lbs).

spec_rules.name: Draca Physiology & Activity Cycle (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Monochrome 270° FOV; Diurnal (8h sleep, 6h w/ thermoplas); Strict carnivore (raw meat, liquids 2x/day).
spec_rules.notes: Vision: Standard visible spectrum but entirely monochromatic (black-and-white), with an exceptional 270-degree field of view. Sleep: Sluggish in cold conditions; require 8 hours of sleep during darkness. This requirement is reduced to 6 hours only if fitted with a thermoplas blood-warming implant. Diet: Strict carnivores. Cannot process vegetable matter; eating plants will cause them to starve. Prefer raw, fresh meat and must drink liquids twice daily.

spec_rules.name: Draca Racial Weapons (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain +1 Atk/Dmg with Draca Weapons (list is in notes)
spec_rules.notes: Racial weapon proficiency granting Dracan +1 Atk/Dmg with: Bolt Sword, Drac-Maul, Manta, Scythe-Cannon.

spec_rules.name: Dragon Conditioning (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 to Natural Def, Nish, Speed, Strength, and Body.
spec_rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Natural Defense, Nish 🚩, Speed, Strength, and Body attributes.

spec_rules.name: Dragon Focus (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Unarmed martial close combat mastery from the Calemoran Catong of the Dragon.
spec_rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Unarmed Close Combat. Focuses on the rigorous physical teachings of the Grand Masters from the Calemoran Catong of the Dragon.

spec_rules.name: Egg-Mistress Champions (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Challenging the Egg-mistress requires duel-slaying all 12-20 bodyguards before final duel.
spec_rules.notes: The supreme ruler of the Dracan Holding (the Egg-mistress) is protected by a fanatical elite guard of 12 to 20 clan warriors. To challenge the Egg-mistress for leadership, a claimant must successfully slay every single bodyguard in duel-combat before earning the right to fight her in a final duel to the death.

spec_rules.name: Environmental & Biological Immunity (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Complete immunity to poison, disease, temperature extremes, and vacuum asphyxiation.
spec_rules.notes: Shanask are completely immune to all known forms of poison, disease, and temperature extremes, and can survive indefinitely without air, even in a perfect vacuum

spec_rules.name: Environmental & Postural Shunning (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Shuns artificial light; never sits, kneels, or lies down, remaining permanently standing.
spec_rules.notes: They avoid artificial light sources, preferring natural starlight or planetary illumination. They never sit, kneel, or lie down, remaining permanently standing.

spec_rules.name: Evolutionary Physiology (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Advanced skeletal/muscular build with superior endurance; body hair limited to head and facial hair.
spec_rules.notes: Evolved significantly from ancient human ancestors, possessing an advanced skeletal and muscular architecture with superior physical endurance. They have lost almost all body hair, retaining only head hair and, in males, facial hair.

spec_rules.name: Fast Drain (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Loses Vit at double the normal rate when bleeding or draining.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with fast drain lose Vit faster than others. Characters with this handicap who take critical Dmg receive two points of Dmg per round, instead of one.

spec_rules.name: Fastidious Combat Shunning (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Prefers clean elegant weapons; fights savagely with natural weapons if forced.
spec_rules.notes: Deeply dislike messy, bloody physical combat, preferring elegant, precise weapons (like rapiers or lasers) that kill cleanly. If forced to resort to natural weapons (teeth and claws), they will fight with terrifying, savage violence—but will immediately indulge in a long, hot bath afterward.

spec_rules.name: Fearful (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to fear checks and morale saves.
spec_rules.notes: Fearful characters make fear checks at -3.

spec_rules.name: Feudal Eccentricities & Fads (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Extravagant noble culture obsessed with theatrical fashion and eccentric fads.
spec_rules.notes: Zin-Shee nobles are notoriously extravagant and dramatic dandies. They regularly obsess over faddish, short-term trends, such as wearing elaborate Renaissance ruffs and capes or predicting the future by reading fireplace ashes.

spec_rules.name: Flirtatious (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Must pass 🫀 check to resist romantic advances or seduction.
spec_rules.notes: The character has a hard time resisting members of the opposite sex. As much as anything, flirtatiousness is an opportunity for good roleplaying. If a flirtatious PC encounters a member of the opposite gender (of the same or similar race), he or she must make a WP check vs Cha or be forced to make romantic overtures. The nature of these overtures is up to the player — they need not be overt or graphic, but must be made nonetheless. Races with minimal emotions or different biologies such Kryll, Shanask and Calemora are not really appropriate for this handicap, but as always, the GM may decide otherwise.

spec_rules.name: Fortune's Child
spec_rules.effect: +1 Max 🍀 pool.
spec_rules.notes: Derived stat hook: Increases Max Luck pool by 1.

spec_rules.name: Frail (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Maximum Vit is permanently reduced (2 dice steps below actual Vit).
spec_rules.notes: Frail characters have a Vit maximum which is 2d below their actual Vit. A frail character with a d8 vitality would, therefore, have only 8 (d6) Vitality points, instead of 12. The character may still use his or her normal Vit for all other rolls, however.

spec_rules.name: Fraternal Jewelry (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Wears intricate jewelry as status symbols or to designate elite/fraternity/military circles.
spec_rules.notes: Both sexes wear intricate jewelry (such as custom rings, headbands, collars, or necklaces) as status symbols or to designate membership in elite groups, fraternities, or military circles.

spec_rules.name: Frictionless Silent Travel (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Moves in absolute silence and leaves no tracks or footprints.
spec_rules.notes: Shanask move in absolute silence and leave no physical tracks or footprints whatsoever

spec_rules.name: Generation-Spanning Clan Feuds (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Matrilineal clans engage in generational blood feuds; immediate revenge required.
spec_rules.notes: Standard societal units are matrilineal clans tracing descent from the female egg-layer. These clans regularly lock into brutal, generational blood feuds. Failing to immediately avenge the assassination of a relative is viewed as a fatal sign of clan weakness.

spec_rules.name: Glass Cannon
spec_rules.effect: -3 Max Vit.
spec_rules.notes: Derived stat hook: Reduces Max Vitality by 3.

spec_rules.name: Glass Jaw (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +When wounded by a physical blow; Save 🫀^Wounds or Stunned for 1-Rnd.
spec_rules.notes: A severe physiological fragility where blunt physical trauma to the head or jaw easily overwhelms cranial equilibrium and triggers immediate sensory blackout.

spec_rules.name: Greedy (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Must pass 🫀 check with Adv vs value or demand largest share of loot.
spec_rules.notes: Greedy characters who encounter large amounts of money, valuable pieces of equipment, etc., must make a WP roll with advantage vs the value in credits or demand to be given the item or the lion’s share of the money. Greed is also a good roleplaying handicap, as it does not always have direct gaming applications.

spec_rules.name: Heirloom Machinery (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Cybernetic implants treated with religious reverence and inherited as clan heirlooms.
spec_rules.notes: Cybernetic implants are treated with religious fervor and are frequently passed down through generations as highly valued clan heirlooms.

spec_rules.name: Hermetic Seal
spec_rules.effect: Immune to toxic atmospheres and hard vacuum; 48h air supply.
spec_rules.notes: Integrated environmental life support.

spec_rules.name: Hive Isolation Death (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Prolonged hive isolation causes standard Kryll to lose will to live; PC Kryll are rare exceptions.
spec_rules.notes: Kryll are fundamentally built for hive life. If isolated from a hive queen, pheromone nodes, or a translator-caste leader for more than a few hours, a standard Kryll warrior will lose the will to live, stop eating, and starve to death. PC Kryll are rare exceptions.

spec_rules.name: Immutable Robe (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Robes cannot be removed or opened; physical attempts to strip robes trigger paralysis.
spec_rules.notes: It is physically impossible to roll up a Shanask's sleeves, lower their hood, or expose the body beneath. Any physical attempt to remove their robes activates a defensive Sorce mechanism that paralyzes the offender.

spec_rules.name: Impossible Robes
spec_rules.effect: Base AR is derived from 👁️ die rating (d4→4, d6→6, d8→8, d10→10, d12→12).
spec_rules.notes: Derived stat hook: Automatically sets base AR from Mind attribute.

spec_rules.name: Keen Senses
spec_rules.effect: Adv(Perception 👁️, Awareness 👁️).
spec_rules.notes: Elf racial passive trait.

spec_rules.name: Kryll Description (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Insectoid hive-beings with biotech mastery, peeling exoskeletons, and living organic armor.
spec_rules.notes: The Kryll are insectoid hive-beings resembling a massive cross between a praying mantis and an ant, standing up to five feet tall with glittering, multi-faceted eyes and heavy, serrated mandibles. They wear no clothing, exposing their colorful, perpetually peeling chitinous exoskeletons and specialized nutrient glands that secrete slime to feed their living weapons. Operating under a rigid hive caste system, they are the galaxy's ultimate masters of biotechnology, wrapping themselves in living, breathing organic armor.

spec_rules.name: Kryll Dimensions & Lifespan (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Allowed Genders: None (neuter). Height (4'0" to 5'0"); Length (5'2" to 7'0"); Weight (300 to 540 lbs); Starting Age 5 to 15 years.
spec_rules.notes: Allowed Genders: None (neuter). Age Formula: 5 years (Max: 15 years). Height Formula: 48 inches (Max: 60 inches). Length Formula: 62 inches (Max: 84 inches). Weight Formula: 300 lbs (Max: 540 lbs).

spec_rules.name: Kryll Physiology & Activity Cycle (mso)
spec_rules.effect: UV & Starlight 360° FOV; No sleep (24h continuous); Universal Organic Digestion (eats q5-6h).
spec_rules.notes: Vision: Ultraviolet-sensitive, starlight amplification, multi-faceted color, with a full 360-degree field of view. Sleep: Never sleep. Capable of continuous 24-hour activity. Diet: Omnivorous. Universal Organic Digestion: Kryll digestive systems are augmented with symbiotic organisms that allow them to digest nearly any form of organic matter without causing toxic side effects, which helps fuel their high metabolism requiring them to consume several pounds of food every 5 to 6 hours

spec_rules.name: Kryll Racial Weapons (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Kryll have no tacial eeapons, though they tend to take BioTech weapons.
spec_rules.notes: Kryll have no racial weapons, though they tend to take BioTech weapons.

spec_rules.name: Kurr'ssa Companions (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Keeps blinding eye-beam feline Kurr'ssa pets that demand constant attention.
spec_rules.notes: Frequently keep small, highly independent feline predators called Kurr'ssa as pets. Kurr'ssa can project bioelectrical light beams from their eyes to blind targets. They are demanding, coddled creatures; if denied constant attention, they will use their eye-beams and claws to systematically destroy their owner's possessions.

spec_rules.name: Language, Guildspeak (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Can speak: GuildSpeak
spec_rules.notes: Can speak: GuildSpeak

spec_rules.name: Laziness & Slavery (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Disdains manual labor; historical slavery faces internal liberation movement rift.
spec_rules.notes: Disdain tedious, uninteresting, or manual labor. Historically, the Matriarchy conquered and enslaved other races (like the Lirrit) to perform these dull tasks. Outworld Zin-Shee within the Guild have begun a movement to liberate all slaves, creating a massive political rift that threatens to split the Matriarchy.

spec_rules.name: Limping Gait
spec_rules.notes: Handicap / tactical rule exception.

spec_rules.name: Locomotor Cyber-Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Cyber-Legs (Speed), Cyber-Legs (Strength), Joint Locks, Power Joints gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Cyber-Legs (Speed), Cyber-Legs (Strength), Joint Locks, Power Joints gain a +1 to all rolls

spec_rules.name: Low Cold Tolerance (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to all checks vs cold; -1 AR vs cold Dmg.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must make all rolls against cold at -3. Armor rolls vs cold damage are made at -1.

spec_rules.name: Low Death Threshold (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Death checks begin at -5 Vit instead of normal -10 Vit.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with low death thresholds begin making death checks at five points of critical Dmg, rather than the normal 10.

spec_rules.name: Low Heat Tolerance (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to all checks vs heat; -1 AR vs heat and plasma Dmg.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must make all rolls against heat at -3. Armor rolls vs heat and plasma Dmg are at -1.

spec_rules.name: Low Poison Tolerance (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to all saves and checks to resist poisons and toxins.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap take a -3 penalty on all rolls to resist poison.

spec_rules.name: Marine Conditioning (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 to Technology, Dexterity, Strength, Fortitude, and Ranged.
spec_rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Technology, Dexterity, Strength, Fortitude, and Ranged attributes.

spec_rules.name: Marine Focus (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Versatile military vanguard optimized for mobile medium-range firearms and combat survival.
spec_rules.notes: Objective & Focus: The highly versatile vanguard of the military order, undergoing physical and genetic augmentations to optimize mobile medium-range firearm tactics and combat survival.

spec_rules.name: Marriage & Litter Lifecycle (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Short-term child-raising marriage alliances dissolved peacefully at child maturity.
