spec_rules.notes: Marriage is treated as a short-term alliance that is dissolved without any animosity or tension once the children reach maturity. Females typically raise two to three litters in a lifetime and engage in numerous passionate, non-procreative affairs.

spec_rules.name: Martial Arts Expert (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to Brawl and unarmed strikes.
spec_rules.notes: Martial arts combat style mastery granting +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to Brawl and unarmed strikes.

spec_rules.name: Martial Arts Weapons Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain Martial Arts Weapons Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Dragons may become skilled in all Martial Arts Melee and Monastic Weapons.

spec_rules.name: Mensi Conditioning (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 to Will Power, Charisma, and Nish.
spec_rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Will Power, Charisma, and Nish 🚩 attributes.

spec_rules.name: Mensi Focus (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Paranormal telepath and telekineticist mastering physical reality manipulation and mind focus.
spec_rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Paranormal telepaths and telekineticists who spend mentally grueling training cycles focusing thought into physical reality and mind manipulation.

spec_rules.name: Molting Exoskeleton (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Chitinous exoskeleton constantly peels and molts, giving a ragged shredded appearance.
spec_rules.notes: Their chitinous, colorful exoskeleton is constantly peeling and molting, giving them a perpetually ragged, shredded appearance.

spec_rules.name: Monosexual Society (mso)
spec_rules.effect: All-male society; secret reproduction; calling all members father, brother, or son.
spec_rules.notes: Reproduce through completely undocumented, highly secret means. They call all elders "father," peers "brother," and youths "son". Speaking to outworlders about their reproduction or family structures is a severe violation of their Code of the Dragon.

spec_rules.name: Mutak Conditioning (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 to Fortitude, Will Power, and Vitality.
spec_rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Fortitude, Will Power, and Vitality attributes.

spec_rules.name: Mutak Focus (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Psychosomatic cellular control commanding adrenaline, tissue density, and regeneration.
spec_rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Psychosomatic physical masters who train their minds to physically command every tissue, adrenaline flow, and bone cell in their body for superhuman survival and hand-to-hand combat.

spec_rules.name: Mystical Flask Dependency (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Must use carried liquid and powder flask compounds to enable natural healing.
spec_rules.notes: Every Shanask carries a pair of flasks (one containing powder, the other liquid). They must use these compounds to heal physical damage; they are completely incapable of natural healing if these flasks are lost or destroyed.

spec_rules.name: Nature Attunement
spec_rules.effect: Ignore 👣 penalties in natural wilderness terrain.
spec_rules.notes: Elf racial passive trait.

spec_rules.name: Neuter Castes (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Adventuring worker/warrior castes are sterile and genderless; only queens and drones possess gender.
spec_rules.notes: All standard worker and warrior castes are genetically female but sterile, and function as genderless ("neuter") entities. Adventuring Kryll are strictly sterile worker and warrior castes. Only the massive hive-queens and their blind, short-lived drones possess gender.

spec_rules.name: Night Blindness (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Treats low-light conditions as total darkness; blind in dim light.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap treat low-light conditions as total darkness, and function as if completely blind.

spec_rules.name: No Physical Contact (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Strictly refuses to touch any living being, maintaining a one-inch cloak buffer.
spec_rules.notes: Strictly refuse to touch any living being. When delivering touch-based Sorce spells, they only bring their cloak within an inch or two of the target

spec_rules.name: One-Eyed
spec_rules.effect: Dis(Shot) due to depth perception handicap.
spec_rules.notes: Handicap / tactical rule exception.

spec_rules.name: Pacifist (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Will not fight unless personally attacked or an ally is struck.
spec_rules.notes: Pacifists will not normally fight unless they are personally attacked, or one of their allies has actually been hit.

spec_rules.name: Parenting & PUBLIC Decorum (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Strict public discipline with rapid maturation; absolute gender equality.
spec_rules.notes: Young hatchlings mature very quickly. While parents may show tenderness and deep affection in private, young Draca are strictly forbidden from showing weakness and must act as disciplined, mature adults whenever in public. Genders have absolute political and social equality.

spec_rules.name: Pheromonal Intercoms (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Hive bio-nodes act as biochemical intercoms transferring pheromonal data instantly.
spec_rules.notes: Kryll starships and hives are laced with biological communication nodes that act as instant, biochemical intercoms, transferring complex pheromonal data at the speed of a nerve impulse.

spec_rules.name: Physical Records (mso)
spec_rules.effect: No written books; history and martial philosophy preserved solely in stone carvings.
spec_rules.notes: Books and permanent written records are entirely unknown; they preserve their history and martial philosophies solely through deep stone carvings in their catongs.

spec_rules.name: Physical Symmetry (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Massive upper body symmetry; arm/shoulder strength and bone thickness matches legs.
spec_rules.notes: Their upper bodies are exceptionally massive, with the bones and muscles of their arms and shoulders matching the sheer strength and thickness of their legs.

spec_rules.name: Pistolier Weapon Mastery (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Tech-Pistol Weapons.
spec_rules.notes: Combat style mastery granting +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Tech-Pistol Weapons.

spec_rules.name: Pixie Gliding
spec_rules.effect: Glide safely from any height; immune to fall Dmg.
spec_rules.notes: Fairy racial passive trait.

spec_rules.name: Poison Resistance
spec_rules.effect: 🫀+5^poison, toxins, and alcohol.
spec_rules.notes: Dwarf racial passive trait.

spec_rules.name: Poor Hearing (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to all 👁️ auditory perception checks.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must take a -3 penalty to all rolls based upon hearing.

spec_rules.name: Poor Smell (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to all 👁️ olfactory and scent tracking checks.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must take a -3 penalty to all rolls based upon smell.

spec_rules.name: Poor Taste (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to all 👁️ taste and food/poison identification checks.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must take a -3 penalty to all rolls based upon taste.

spec_rules.name: Poor Touch (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to all 👁️ tactile and micro-texture checks.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must take a -3 penalty to all rolls based upon touch.

spec_rules.name: Poor Vision (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to all 👁️ visual perception checks.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must take a -3 penalty to all rolls based upon vision.

spec_rules.name: Poverty (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Starts with half credits; mission allowances reduced by 1 rank.
spec_rules.notes: The character is poor, or is badly in debt. Poor characters receive only half their starting credits, and earn mission allowance at one rank below their actual rank. Rank two characters receive pay as if they were rank one, rank three would take pay at rank two, etc. (Rank zero characters still receive normal allowance, however). If the character becomes poor after generation, then half of the character’s funds are immediately deducted, and future allowance penalties are as described above.

spec_rules.name: Pragmatic Cattle Culturing (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Views non-aligned foreign species with cold utility, breeding unaligned sentients as livestock.
spec_rules.notes: Kryll view foreign species with cold utility. If a species is not an ally or an enemy, traditional hive-queens will simply breed them as docile livestock.

spec_rules.name: Psionic Field Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Encase, Shield gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Psionic Field Set

spec_rules.name: Psionic Force Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Blast, Blow, Landing, Punch, Shove gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Psionic Force Set

spec_rules.name: Psionic Mental Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Minor Telepathy, Mind Probe, Read Surface Thoughts, Telepathy gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Psionic Mental Set

spec_rules.name: Psionic Reality Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Hallucination, Haze gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Psionic Reality Set

spec_rules.name: Psionic Telekinesis Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Hurl, Jerk, Levitate Other, Levitate Self, Move Object, Rend, Return gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Psionic Telekinesis Set

spec_rules.name: Psionics Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain Psionics (mso) Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Character may become skilled in all Psionic powers.

spec_rules.name: Psionics Restriction (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Cannot possess psionic powers; compensated with superior physical combat ability.
spec_rules.notes: Zin-Shee Males do not and may not possess psionic powers; to compensate, they are gifted with superior natural physical combat abilities.

spec_rules.name: Psychosomatic Alteration Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Molecular Diffusion gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Psychosomatic Alteration Set

spec_rules.name: Psychosomatic Defensive Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Body Heal, Iron Skin, Rough Skin, Tough Skin, Vitalize gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Psychosomatic Defensive Set

spec_rules.name: Psychosomatic Muscular Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Jump, Speed, Strength Surge, Strengthen gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Psychosomatic Muscular Set

spec_rules.name: Psychosomatic Offensive Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Death Blow, Electric Palm, Power Punch, Stun gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Psychosomatic Offensive Set

spec_rules.name: Psychosomatic Sensory Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Hearing Boost, Super Hearing, Super Vision, Vision Boost gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Psychosomatic Sensory Set

spec_rules.name: Psychosomatic Survival Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Oxygenate, Resist Cold, Resist Heat gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Psychosomatic Survival Set

spec_rules.name: Psychosomatics Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain Psychosomatics (mso) Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Character may become skilled in all Psychosomatic powers.

spec_rules.name: Pulse Laser Mastery (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Pulse Laser Weapons.
spec_rules.notes: Combat style mastery granting +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Pulse Laser Weapons.

spec_rules.effect: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Initiate, 1-Mech-1, 2-Mech-2, 3-Mech-3, 4-Mech-4, 5-Mech-5, 6-Cyborg-1, 7-Cyborg-2, 8-Cyborg-3, 9-Cyber Knight, 10+-Cybe
spec_rules.notes: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Initiate, 1-Mech-1, 2-Mech-2, 3-Mech-3, 4-Mech-4, 5-Mech-5, 6-Cyborg-1, 7-Cyborg-2, 8-Cyborg-3, 9-Cyber Knight, 10+-Cyber Lord (Chapter Master title).

spec_rules.effect: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Recruit, 1-Infantryman, 2-Squad Leader, 3-Sergeant, 4-Lieutenant, 5-Captain, 6-Centurion, 7-Colonel, 8-General, 9-Brigad
spec_rules.notes: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Recruit, 1-Infantryman, 2-Squad Leader, 3-Sergeant, 4-Lieutenant, 5-Captain, 6-Centurion, 7-Colonel, 8-General, 9-Brigadier General, 10+-Destron Master.

spec_rules.name: Ranks of the Grand Master (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-White, 1-Yellow, 2-Orange, 3-Green, 4-Blue, 5-Purple, 6-Red, 7-Brown, 8-Black, 9-Master, 10+-Grand Master.
spec_rules.notes: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-White, 1-Yellow, 2-Orange, 3-Green, 4-Blue, 5-Purple, 6-Red, 7-Brown, 8-Black, 9-Master, 10+-Grand Master.

spec_rules.notes: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Neophyte, 1-Magus First Rank, 2-Magus Second Rank, 3-Magus Third Rank, 4-Magus Fourth Rank, 5-Magus Fifth Rank, 6-Magus Sixth Rank, 7-Magus Seventh Rank, 8-Master, 9-Shadow Master, 10+-Grand Warlock.

spec_rules.effect: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Recruit, 1-Private, 2-Corporal, 3-Sergeant, 4-Lieutenant, 5-Captain, 6-Major, 7-Colonel, 8-General, 9-Brigadier General,
spec_rules.notes: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Recruit, 1-Private, 2-Corporal, 3-Sergeant, 4-Lieutenant, 5-Captain, 6-Major, 7-Colonel, 8-General, 9-Brigadier General, 10+-Marshal.

spec_rules.name: Ranks of the Odonata (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Ephemer, 1-Diptera, 2-Siphon, 3-Hymekin, 4-Hemi, 5-Zorap, 6-Tricho, 7-Mec, 8-Neuro, 9-Plec, 10+-Odonata (Chapter Master
spec_rules.notes: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Ephemer, 1-Diptera, 2-Siphon, 3-Hymekin, 4-Hemi, 5-Zorap, 6-Tricho, 7-Mec, 8-Neuro, 9-Plec, 10+-Odonata (Chapter Master title).

spec_rules.name: Ranks of the Seer (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Novice, 1-Telepath First Circle, 2-Telepath Second Circle, 3-Telepath Third Circle, 4-Seer First Circle, 5-Seer Second C
spec_rules.notes: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Novice, 1-Telepath First Circle, 2-Telepath Second Circle, 3-Telepath Third Circle, 4-Seer First Circle, 5-Seer Second Circle, 6-Seer Third Circle, 7-Oracle First Circle, 8-Oracle Second Circle, 9-Mensi Master, 10+-Mensi High Master.

spec_rules.name: Ranks of the Silvan (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Carabid, 1-Dytisc, 2-Gyrini, 3-Omophron, 4-Rysod, 5-Curculion, 6-Anthribid, 7-Malachii, 8-Mordell, 9-Chrysome, 10+-Silva
spec_rules.notes: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Carabid, 1-Dytisc, 2-Gyrini, 3-Omophron, 4-Rysod, 5-Curculion, 6-Anthribid, 7-Malachii, 8-Mordell, 9-Chrysome, 10+-Silvan (Chapter Master title).

spec_rules.name: Ranks of the Somatic Master (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-White, 1-Yellow, 2-Orange, 3-Green, 4-Blue, 5-Purple, 6-Red, 7-Brown, 8-Black, 9-Master, 10+-Grand Master.
spec_rules.notes: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-White, 1-Yellow, 2-Orange, 3-Green, 4-Blue, 5-Purple, 6-Red, 7-Brown, 8-Black, 9-Master, 10+-Grand Master.

spec_rules.name: Ranks of the Vanguard (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Recruit, 1-Trooper, 2-Corporal, 3-Sergeant, 4-Lieutenant, 5-Captain, 6-Major, 7-Colonel, 8-General, 9-Brigadier General,
spec_rules.notes: Progression within the chapter ranks: 0-Recruit, 1-Trooper, 2-Corporal, 3-Sergeant, 4-Lieutenant, 5-Captain, 6-Major, 7-Colonel, 8-General, 9-Brigadier General, 10+-Marshal.

spec_rules.name: Relentless Stamina
spec_rules.effect: When reduced to 0 Vit; immediately remain at 1 Vit (1-Enc).
spec_rules.notes: Orc racial passive trait.

spec_rules.name: Restricted Healing Channels (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Healing restricted to Sorce, GM approved Exotics/Artifacts, and flask-dependent natural healing.
spec_rules.notes: The only forms of healing that function on Shanask are Sorce and natural healing and GM approved Exotics and Artifacts; they are completely incapable of natural healing if their carried liquid and powder flasks are lost or destroyed

spec_rules.name: Rifle Weapon Mastery (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Rifle Weapons.
spec_rules.notes: Combat style mastery granting +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Rifle Weapons.

spec_rules.name: Self-Repairing Robes (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Full-length black robes automatically self-repair tears and combat Dmg over time.
spec_rules.notes: Their full-length black robes appear to be organic or semi-sentient, repairing tears or combat damage automatically over time.

spec_rules.name: Sensory Augmentation Cyber-Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Audial Transceiver, Multi-Spectrum Eye, Micro-Laser, Comm Link gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Hybrid Set: Sensory Augmentation Cyber-Kit

spec_rules.name: Shanask Description (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Ageless 6'6" hooded robed beings with glowing red eyes; radiates fear and never eats or sleeps.
spec_rules.notes: Standing at a constant, ageless 6'6", the Shanask are highly mysterious beings completely enveloped in self-repairing, full-length black robes that cannot be rolled up or removed. The shadows of their deep hoods reveal nothing of their physical form except for a pair of unblinkingly intense, glowing red eyes. They never sit, eat, or sleep, and they naturally radiate an aura of gloom and fear that makes the skin of nearby sentients crawl.

spec_rules.name: Shanask Dimensions & Lifespan (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gender: Unknown. Height (6'6"); Weight (250 lbs); Starting Age Unknown.
spec_rules.notes: Allowed Genders: Unknown. Age Formula: Unknown. Height Formula: 6’6" (constant). Weight Formula: 250 lbs (constant).

spec_rules.name: Shanask Immunity (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Immune to poison, disease, temperature extremes, and space vacuum.
spec_rules.notes: Shanasks are immune to poison, disease, temperature extremes, and the vacuum of space.

spec_rules.name: Shanask Physiology & Activity Cycle (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Grayscale & Sorce colors 90° FOV; No sleep (continuous standing); No food/water/breath.
spec_rules.notes: Vision: Spectrum is grayscale (colorblind), but they can uniquely perceive Sorce colors. Their hoods restrict peripheral vision, fanning out in a narrow 90-degree field of view. Sleep: Never sleep. Capable of endless, continuous standing activity. Diet: None. They never eat, drink, or breathe, and do not excrete biological waste.

spec_rules.name: Shanask Racial Weapons (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain +1 Atk/Dmg with Shanask Weapons (list is in notes)
spec_rules.notes: Racial weapon proficiency granting Shanask +1 Atk/Dmg with: Implosion Ball, Sorce Crystal, sorce Saber.

spec_rules.name: Shanask Touch (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Zero brawl Dmg; brawl attacks deliver touch-based Sorce spells without physical contact.
spec_rules.notes: Shanask will never physically touch other life forms; they deal zero brawl damage. They use their brawl attack solely to deliver touch-based Sorce spells, but without actual contact.

spec_rules.name: Shattered Training Grounds (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Hones reflexes and settles disputes on airless wargame planet Ka-Ma-Kolak.
spec_rules.notes: Settle inter-clan disputes and hone combat reflexes on Ka-Ma-Kolak, a dedicated, airless "wargame" planet where centuries of unrestrained testing have pulverized entire mountain ranges into dust.

spec_rules.name: Ship Officer Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: May pick ONE Ship Officer Kit and Learn it for Free.
spec_rules.notes: May pick ONE Ship Officer Kit and Learn for Free.

spec_rules.name: Short Temper (mso)
spec_rules.effect: If insulted or provoked; Save 🫀 or lose temper and start fight.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap have a tendency to hit first and ask questions later. If confronted with a situation which the character considers insulting or threatening, the player must make a WP(15) roll. If the roll fails, the character will “blow up,” throwing things, yelling, and possibly even starting a fight. Again, this handicap has excellent roleplaying applications.

spec_rules.name: Skeletal Reinforcement Cyber-Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Titanium Endoskeleton, Spine Support, Heavy Rib Cage gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Hybrid Set: Skeletal Reinforcement Cyber-Kit

spec_rules.name: Slovenly (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Poor personal hygiene and messy habits; roleplay flaw.
spec_rules.notes: The character is, in short, a slob. His or her living conditions and personal habits leave a great deal to be desired. Again, the player should expand upon this handicap, and roleplay for maximum effectiveness.

spec_rules.name: Slow (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Movement rate reduced to next lower bracket (👣-2).
spec_rules.notes: A character with this handicap always moves at the next lower MR as indicated on the back of the character sheet.

spec_rules.name: Slow Healer (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Time required for natural recovery and healing checks is doubled.
spec_rules.notes: The normal amount of time required for the disadvantage healing check is doubled for slow healers. Thus, a slow healer may roll only once every eight hours (rather than four).

spec_rules.name: Slow Reaction (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Cannot use doubling die on 🚩 initiative rolls.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap may not use the doubling die when making Initiative rolls (i.e., it is a non-doubled roll).

spec_rules.name: Slow Restore (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Session start: roll 🍀; if fails, regain no 🍀 for adventure.
spec_rules.notes: At the beginning of each gaming session, a character with this handicap must make a Luck roll. If the roll exceeds the character’s total luck value, then the character gains back all of his or her luck boxes for the adventure. If the roll fails, then the character regains no luck boxes. Any luck boxes remaining from the last gaming session are kept, however.

spec_rules.name: Social Dependency (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Highly gregarious; cannot survive prolonged psychological/emotional isolation from sentients.
spec_rules.notes: Highly social and gregarious; Anthropos cannot survive psychologically or emotionally for long periods without contact with other sentients.

spec_rules.name: Somatic Combat Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Electric Palm, Iron Skin, Claws & Fangs, Molecular Diffusion, Density Increase gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Somatic Combat Set

spec_rules.name: Sorce Associative Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Binding Word, Radiate Fear gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Sorce Associative Set

spec_rules.name: Sorce Defensive Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Adhere, Immortal Stance, Sorce Field gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Sorce Defensive Set

spec_rules.name: Sorce Destructive Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Death Ray, Energy Bolt, Fireball, Lightning Strike gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Sorce Destructive Set

spec_rules.name: Sorce Environmental Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Door Hand, Door Master, Glow Globe gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Sorce Environmental Set

spec_rules.name: Sorce Healing Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Heal All, Healing, Life Balance, Light Healing gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Sorce Healing Set

spec_rules.name: Sorce Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain Sorce (mso) Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Character may become skilled in all Sorce powers.

spec_rules.name: Sorce Offensive Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Choke, Death Ray, Energy Bolt, Life Drain, Shockblast, Vampire Touch gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Sorce Offensive Set

spec_rules.name: Sorce Transportal Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Displace, Displace Group, Ghost Walk, Teleport gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Sorce Transportal Set

spec_rules.name: Stonecunning
spec_rules.effect: Adv(👁️) to detect stonework traps, architectural secrets, and subterranean depth.
spec_rules.notes: Dwarf racial passive trait.

spec_rules.name: Submersion Air Barrier (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Protective one-inch air bubble automatically surrounds them when submerged in water or mud.
spec_rules.notes: If a Shanask submerges beneath water or thin mud, a protective one-inch bubble of air always forms and surrounds them

spec_rules.name: Swift Step
spec_rules.effect: +1 👣 (Armored and Shielded).
spec_rules.notes: Derived stat hook: Adds +1 to Movement Rate.

spec_rules.name: Tactical Negotiation & "Unfair" Combat (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Prefers negotiation over fighting; avoids combat without a clear, overwhelming advantage.
spec_rules.notes: They naturally prefer sitting down to negotiate rather than fighting. They are famously reluctant to enter a combat scenario unless they possess a clear, overwhelming advantage; Anthropos strategists dismiss the concept of a "fair fight" as foolish

spec_rules.name: Taste and Smell Anhedonia (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Completely lacks any sense of taste or smell.
spec_rules.notes: Shanask completely lack any sense of taste or smell.

spec_rules.name: Taste Deprivation (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Completely lacks physical sense of taste.
spec_rules.notes: Kryll completely lack a physical sense of taste

spec_rules.name: Tech Armor Heavy Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain Tech Armor Heavy Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Destrons may become skilled in all Heavy Tech Armor.

spec_rules.name: Tech Armor Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain Tech Armor Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Warriors may become skilled in all Tech Armor suits.

spec_rules.name: Tech Armor Medium Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain Tech Armor Medium Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Marines may become skilled in all Medium AR Tech Armor.

spec_rules.name: Tech Explosive Weapons Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain Tech Explosive Weapons Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Destrons may become skilled in all Explosive Ordnance and Heavy Munitions.

spec_rules.name: Tech Heavy Ranged Weapons Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain Tech Heavy Ranged Weapons Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Destrons may become skilled in all Heavy-Ranged Tech Weapons.

spec_rules.name: Tech Melee Weapons Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain Tech Melee Weapons Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Warriors may become skilled in all Tech Melee and Exotic Polearm Weapons.

spec_rules.name: Tech Ranged Weapons Kit (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain Tech Ranged Weapons Kit for Free
spec_rules.notes: Marines may become skilled in all Medium Tech Ranged Firearms.

spec_rules.name: Telekinetic Force Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Blast, Encase, Levitate Self, Levitate Object, Kinetic Wall, Kinetic Shield gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Telekinetic Force Set

spec_rules.name: Telepathic Mind Set (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Mind Probe, Mental Shield, Telepathy, Hallucination, Suggestion gain a +1 to all rolls
spec_rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Power Set: Telepathic Mind Set

spec_rules.name: The Law of Exile (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Code violation results in total social exile; exile crimes met with instant execution.
spec_rules.notes: Violating even a single tenet of the Code of the Dragon results in immediate exile. Exiles are treated as if they do not exist and are completely ignored. If an exile commits a crime, they are instantly executed by any nearby Calemora.

spec_rules.name: The Psionic Eye-Glow (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Slit-pupil eyes glow with bright visible energy when channeling psionics.
spec_rules.notes: When channeling telepathic or telekinetic energy, their slit-pupil eyes glow with a bright, visible energy.

spec_rules.name: The Sponge World (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Mobile hive is a giant sponge-like bio-vessel with biological thrusters and bioluminescence.
spec_rules.notes: The Kryll-Hive is a massive, green, sponge-like mobile organism propelled by living biological thrusters and illuminated entirely by bioluminescent creatures

spec_rules.name: The Tail Taboo (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Tails surgically removed at birth by cultural tradition; tailed Draca viewed as primitive.
spec_rules.notes: Though naturally born with powerful tails, tradition dictates their immediate surgical removal at birth. Draca who retain their tails are viewed as provincial, backward, and primitive.

spec_rules.name: The Translator Caste (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Translator caste telepathically receives queen orders and speaks sophisticated alien languages.
spec_rules.notes: Translators are specialized workers who can telepathically receive orders from the hive-queen and speak to outworlders in highly cultured, sophisticated versions of alien languages.

spec_rules.name: Thick-Headed (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Plodding logic; -3 to 👁️ checks to notice clues or deduct facts.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap are basically slow to notice things, plodding in their thought patterns, stubborn, and unlikely to change their course unless confronted with obvious disaster. When other characters are allowed to make 👁️ check, thick-headed characters may be excluded, or make the checks at a -3 penalty. Thick-headedness is another opportunity for good roleplaying, as well. Players may decide that a thick-headed character will miss an obvious point, or come to exactly the wrong conclusions given circumstances. Such good roleplaying should, of course, be rewarded by the GM.

spec_rules.name: Total Pain Immunity (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Completely ignores physical pain sensations while remaining aware of tissue Dmg.
spec_rules.notes: While aware of physical pain as an "alarm warning" that tissue is damaged, they can completely ignore the sensation, allowing them to withstand horrific torture and remain focused in battle.

spec_rules.name: Tough Hide
spec_rules.effect: +1 Natural AR.
spec_rules.notes: Derived stat hook: Adds +1 flat AR bonus.

spec_rules.name: Tribal Sashes (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Wears decorated tribal chest sash to display accolades, weapons, and rank emblems.
spec_rules.notes: They shun heavy clothing, wearing only a loincloth and a custom chest sash decorated with tribal markings used to hold personal accolades, weapons, and rank emblems.

spec_rules.name: Tunnel Vision (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Field of vision reduced by one step (e.g. 180° to 90°).
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap have their field of vision reduced. A member of a race which normally has a 360-degree field of vision is reduced to 270 degrees; 270 is reduced to 180; and 180 is reduced to 90. Races (such as the Shanask) which normally have a 90-degree field of vision may not take this handicap.

spec_rules.name: Unattractive (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to social checks where physical appearance is a factor.
spec_rules.notes: Like beauty, unattractiveness is a difficult concept to define. Often, unattractiveness is a result of “ugly” personalities, bad habits, etc. In game terms, this disadvantage causes a character to take a -3 penalty on Cha rolls in which physical appearance might be a factor (when dealing with aliens, for example, ugliness is entirely relative, and unlikely to affect Cha).

spec_rules.name: Unconsciousness and Paralysis Immunity (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +Immune to Unconscious and Paralyzed; remains vulnerable to Stun.
spec_rules.notes: Unique Shanask physiology possesses a decentralized nervous system and redundant bio-synthetic circulatory loops, rendering them completely immune to loss of consciousness and neuromuscular paralysis.

spec_rules.name: Unhealthy (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to 🫀 saves vs illnesses and diseases.
spec_rules.notes: Unhealthy characters catch illnesses more easily than other characters. All FR rolls to resist disease are made at -3.

spec_rules.name: Unlucky (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Must spend 2 🍀 chits to reroll dice instead of 1 🍀.
spec_rules.notes: Unlucky characters must spend two luck boxes each time they wish to reroll the dice. This handicap does not affect luck burn.

spec_rules.name: Unrestricted Surface Crossing (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Crosses any surface (water, mud, snow) without suffering movement penalties.
spec_rules.notes: Shanask can travel across any surface, including water, mud, and snow, without suffering movement penalties

spec_rules.name: Vanish on Death
spec_rules.effect: Upon death, body dissolves into radiant mist or stardust.
spec_rules.notes: Narrative passive quirk.

spec_rules.name: Vanish on Death (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Cannot be revived; upon death, body, robe, and flasks vanish into thin air leaving only carried gear.
spec_rules.notes: No rolls are permitted to revive a dead Shanask. Upon failing a death check, their body, robe, and flasks, , and flasks instantly vanish into thin air, leaving only their carried gear scattered on the floor.

spec_rules.name: Very Unlucky (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Must spend all remaining 🍀 chits to reroll dice.
spec_rules.notes: A character with this handicap must spend all of his or her luck boxes to reroll the dice (i.e., they effectively have one luck box).

spec_rules.name: Vitality Drain Exemption (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Exempt from vitality drain and bleeding rules; Wnds do not worsen over time.
spec_rules.notes: Shanask are entirely exempt from the standard Vitality drain and bleeding rules, preventing their wounds from worsening over time when critically damaged

spec_rules.name: Vulnerable vs Blunt Weapons (mso)
spec_rules.effect: AR rolls vs blunt weapons are halved (1d).
spec_rules.notes: Individuals with this handicap make AR rolls vs blunt weapons at 1d.

spec_rules.name: Vulnerable vs Edged Weapons (mso)
spec_rules.effect: AR rolls vs edged weapons are halved (1d).
spec_rules.notes: Individuals with this handicap make AR rolls vs edged weapons at 1d.

spec_rules.name: Vulnerable vs Energy Weapons (mso)
spec_rules.effect: AR rolls vs energy and plasma weapons are halved (1d).
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must make AR rolls vs energy or plasma weapons at 1d.

spec_rules.name: Vulnerable vs Projectile Weapons (mso)
spec_rules.effect: AR rolls vs projectile and kinetic weapons are halved (1d).
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must make AR rolls vs projectile weapons at 1d.

spec_rules.name: Warlock Conditioning (mso)
spec_rules.effect: +1 to Luck, Intelligence, and Nish.
spec_rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Luck, Intelligence, and Nish 🚩 attributes.

spec_rules.name: Warlock Focus (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Mystical defender mastering the reality-warping planar energies of the Sorce.
spec_rules.notes: Objective & Focus: The mystical defenders of Dha. Masters of the reality-warping planar energies of the Sorce.

spec_rules.name: Warrior Conditioning (mso)
spec_rules.effect: 🚩+1, Speed, Fortitude, Shock, Melee, Natural Def, and Strength.
spec_rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent 🚩+1 (Initiative), Speed, Fortitude, Shock, Melee, Natural Defense, and Strength attributes.

spec_rules.name: Warrior Focus (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Ultimate martial master of physical close-quarters combat and knighthood tactics.
spec_rules.notes: Objective & Focus: The ultimate martial masters of physical close-quarters combat. Blends standard tech melee, exotic polearms, and ancient knighthood tactics.

spec_rules.name: Weak Grip (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to 💪 checks to hold objects or resist disarm.
spec_rules.notes: This character must take a -3 penalty when rolling to hold onto things that would normally require a 💪 check.

spec_rules.name: Weak Will (mso)
spec_rules.effect: -3 to 🫀 checks to resist falling unconscious.
spec_rules.notes: Characters with this disadvantage incur a -3 penalty on all WP rolls required to stay conscious.

spec_rules.name: Zin-Shee Female Description (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Agile bipedal feline humanoids with psionic glowing slit-eyes, sharp senses, and dapper style.
spec_rules.notes: The Zin-Shee are agile, bipedal felines covered in beautifully patterned fur resembling leopards, tigers, or panthers, with retractable claws, cat-like ears, and a tufted beard. When channeling their potent mental psionics, their gold, green, or yellow cat-like slit eyes glow with a bright, visible energy. Extremely dapper and dramatic, their noble classes are notorious for overdressing in extravagant, Renaissance-style garments like velvet doublets, long capes, and broad-brimmed hats.

spec_rules.name: Zin-Shee Female Dimensions & Lifespan (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Height (5'0" to 6'0"); Weight (100 to 220 lbs); Starting Age 15 to 40 years.
spec_rules.notes: Allowed Genders: Female Age Formula: 15 years (Max: 40 years). Height Formula: 60 inches (Max: 72 inches). Weight Formula: 100 lbs (Max: 220 lbs).

spec_rules.name: Zin-Shee Female Physiology & Activity Cycle (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Color & Starlight 180° FOV; Polyphasic (naps q6h); Strict carnivore (ill on plants).
spec_rules.notes: Vision: Full visible spectrum color, starlight amplification, with a 180-degree field of view. Gold, green, or yellow eyes. Sleep: Do not sleep continuously; must catch brief naps. Become extremely cranky and restless if more than 6 hours pass without a nap. Diet: Strict carnivores. Can survive as herbivores for several weeks, but will quickly grow listless, dull-furred, and ill.

spec_rules.name: Zin-Shee Male Description (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Agile bipedal feline humanoids with sharp senses, physical prowess, and dapper style.
spec_rules.notes: The Zin-Shee are agile, bipedal felines covered in beautifully patterned fur resembling leopards, tigers, or panthers, with retractable claws, cat-like ears, and a tufted beard. Extremely dapper and dramatic, their noble classes are notorious for overdressing in extravagant, Renaissance-style garments like velvet doublets, long capes, and broad-brimmed hats.

spec_rules.name: Zin-Shee Male Dimensions & Lifespan (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Height (5'6" to 6'6"); Weight (150 to 270 lbs); Starting Age 15 to 40 years.
spec_rules.notes: Allowed Genders: Male Age Formula: 15 years (Max: 40 years). Height Formula: 66 inches (Max: 78 inches). Weight Formula: 150 lbs (Max: 270 lbs).

spec_rules.name: Zin-Shee Male Physiology & Activity Cycle (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Color & Starlight 180° FOV; Polyphasic (naps q6h); Strict carnivore (ill on plants).
spec_rules.notes: Vision: Full visible spectrum color, starlight amplification, with a 180-degree field of view. Gold, green, or yellow eyes. Sleep: Do not sleep continuously; must catch brief naps. Become extremely cranky and restless if more than 6 hours pass without a nap. Diet: Strict carnivores. Can survive as herbivores for several weeks, but will quickly grow listless, dull-furred, and ill.

spec_rules.name: Zin-Shee Racial Weapons (mso)
spec_rules.effect: Gain +1 Atk/Dmg with Zin-Shee Weapons (list is in notes)
spec_rules.notes: Racial weapon proficiency granting Zin-Shee +1 Atk/Dmg with: Fang-Rifle, Pulse Laser Pistol, Pulse Laser Carbine, Screamer, shirrac, Warrior Claws.

rules.name: Absent-Minded (mso)
rules.effect: Must pass 👁️ check to remember important facts, gear, or instructions.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must make Int rolls to remember important items, names, dates, places, appointments, etc. The Dif is anywhere from 5-20 or more depending on the situation.

rules.name: Acoustic Receptors (mso)
rules.effect: Processes sound and pressure changes via sensory skin receptors across chest and back.
rules.notes: Lacking external ears or ear holes, they process sound and pressure changes through specialized sensory receptors lining their chests and backs.

rules.name: Acoustic Whisper Bypass (mso)
rules.effect: Raspy whisper carries across vacuum/wind, cannot be electronically recorded, and can selectively target listeners.
rules.notes: Communicate in a raspy, low-volume whisper that carries perfectly over distances. This whisper is clearly audible even in a perfect vacuum or above a screaming wind, but it cannot be picked up or recorded by any electronic device. They may selectively choose who may hear their words.

rules.name: Adaptable Spirit
rules.effect: Learn 1 extra skill without skill restrictions.
rules.notes: Human racial passive trait.

rules.name: Ahuk Companionship (mso)
rules.effect: Tames and rides massive 10-legged reptilian Ahuk beasts as honored companions.
rules.notes: Traditionally tame and ride massive, 10-legged reptilian beasts called Ahuk (which grow from the size of a dog to a 10-ton elephant). Tracking, capturing, and taming a wild Ahuk single-handedly is one of the highest honors a warrior can achieve.

rules.name: Anthropos Description (mso)
rules.effect: Perception 👁️; sharp vision/hearing; luck & tech affinity.
rules.notes: Evolved from ancient humanity, the Anthropos are highly social and adaptable six-foot-tall humanoids with exceptionally sharp vision and hearing, who have lost almost all body hair except for head and facial hair. They favor full-body clothing, adorned with status-revealing jewelry, and enter combat heavily armored in high-tech suits with energy shields. Their defining traits remain their insatiable curiosity, legendary luck, and brilliant grasp of technology.

rules.name: Anthropos Dimensions & Lifespan (mso)
rules.effect: Height (5'6" to 7'0"); Weight (160 to 335 lbs); Starting Age 15 to 40 years.
rules.notes: Allowed Genders: Male or Female. Starting Age Formula: 15 to Max: 40 years). Height Formula: 66 inches (Max: 84 inches). Weight Formula: 10 + 150 lbs (Max: 335 lbs).

rules.name: Anthropos Physiology & Activity Cycle (mso)
rules.effect: Vision 180° FOV; Diurnal (8h sleep/16h active); Omnivore (3 meals/day).
rules.notes: Vision: Standard visible spectrum, full color, with a stable 180-degree field of view. Their hearing range is nearly equal to a dog. Sleep: Diurnal. Typically require 8 hours of sleep and remain active for 16 hours, though this adjusts to the planetary cycle of their location. Diet: Omnivores. Consume 3 meals daily, usually scheduled immediately before and after sleep cycles, and prefer to consume liquids with and between meals. Taste is their most sophisticated sense.

rules.name: Anthropos Racial Weapons (mso)
rules.effect: Gain +1 Atk/Dmg with Antrops Weapons (list is in notes)
rules.notes: Racial weapon proficiency granting Anthropos +1 Atk/Dmg with: Combat Knife, Force Gauntlet, Grenade Launcher Underbarel, Render, Sonic Disrupter, Sonic Sword.

rules.name: Arcane Volatility
rules.effect: Natural 1 on ✨ check = trigger minor chaotic surge.
rules.notes: Handicap / tactical rule exception.

rules.name: Archaic Weapons Kit (mso)
rules.effect: Gain Archaic Weapons Kit for Free
rules.notes: Dragons may become skilled in all Archaic Weapons.

rules.name: Archer Weapon Mastery (mso)
rules.effect: +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Bows and Crossbows.
rules.notes: Combat style mastery granting +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Bows and Crossbows.

rules.name: Attunement of the Hive (mso)
rules.effect: 👁️+3 within range of translator or pheromone node; Adv(👁️) in direct communication with hive-queen.
rules.notes: The Kryll gain +3 Mind bonus when within range of a translator-caste Kryll or a pheromone node, and Adv(Mind) if they are in direct communication with the hive-queen

rules.name: Bad Balance (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to all 🏃 checks requiring balance, tightropes, or narrow ledges.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must roll at a -3 penalty for all acts which require good balance.

rules.name: Bad Defense vs Body (mso)
rules.effect: -3 Def vs body and natural attacks.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap take a -3 Def penalty vs body weapons.

rules.name: Bad Defense vs Hurled (mso)
rules.effect: -3 Def vs hurled and thrown weapons.
rules.notes: This handicap inflicts a -3 penalty on all Def rolls vs hurled weapons.

rules.name: Bad Defense vs Melee (mso)
rules.effect: -3 Def vs swords, axes, and melee weapons.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap take a -3 Def penalty vs melee weapons.

rules.name: Bad Defense vs Ranged (mso)
rules.effect: -3 Def vs blasters, rifles, and ranged weapons.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap have a -3 penalty on Def rolls vs ranged weapons.

rules.name: Bad Jumper (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to all vertical and horizontal jump checks.
rules.notes: A character with this handicap suffers a -3 penalty to all attempts to jump, either for height or distance.

rules.name: Bad Runner (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to all 🏃 running and sprinting checks.
rules.notes: A character with this handicap suffers a -3 penalty to all rolls to run.

rules.name: Bio-Gunner Conditioning (mso)
rules.effect: +1 to Biotech, Dexterity, Hurled, Speed, Fortitude, and Ranged.
rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Biotech, Dexterity, Hurled, Speed, Fortitude, and Ranged attributes.

rules.name: Bio-Gunner Focus (mso)
rules.effect: Specialized in Kryllian biological ranged and hurled weaponry.
rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Specialized in Kryllian biological ranged and hurled weaponry (such as weapons that spit acid, fire bore-worms, or physically latch onto enemies).

rules.name: Bio-Warrior Conditioning (mso)
rules.effect: +1 to Biotech, Strength, Fortitude, Def, Melee, Body, Nish, and Shock.
rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Biotech, Strength, Fortitude, Defense, Melee, Body, Nish 🚩, and Shock attributes.

rules.name: Bio-Warrior Focus (mso)
rules.effect: Master of biological close combat, organic melee weapons, and troop guidance.
rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Master of biological close combat, organic melee weapons (which burrow into target flesh or eat them upon contact), and guiding troops through hazardous, alien environments.

rules.name: BioTech Armor Kit (mso)
rules.effect: Gain BioTech Armor Kit for Free
rules.notes: Bio-Gunners may become skilled in all BioTech Armor.

rules.name: BioTech Melee Weapons Kit (mso)
rules.effect: Gain BioTech Melee Weapons Kit for Free
rules.notes: Bio-Warriors may become skilled in all BioTech Melee and Body Weapons.

rules.name: BioTech Ranged Weapons Kit (mso)
rules.effect: Gain BioTech Ranged Weapons Kit for Free
rules.notes: Bio-Gunners may become skilled in all BioTech Ranged and Hurled Weapons.

rules.name: BiotTech Metabolic Symbiote Suite (mso)
rules.effect: Feeder, Oxygenator Worm, Platelet Mites, Tube-Worms gain a +1 to all rolls
rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Hybrid Set: Kryll Metabolic Symbiote Suite

rules.name: BiotTech Sensory Symbiote Suite (mso)
rules.effect: Bionoculars, Audio-Beetle gain a +1 to all rolls
rules.notes: Set synergy bonus for Hybrid Set: Kryll Sensory Symbiote Suite

rules.name: Blaster Weapon Mastery (mso)
rules.effect: +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Blaster Weapons.
rules.notes: Combat style mastery granting +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Blaster Weapons.

rules.name: Blood-Bonds over Friendship (mso)
rules.effect: Forms sacred warrior blood-bonds sealed with cybernetic implant exchanges.
rules.notes: Traditional military doctrine shuns the concept of "friendship" because commanders must remain unemotional when ordering soldiers to their deaths. Instead, warriors form sacred "blood-bonds," which are highly valued and often sealed with the exchange of precious, ancestral cybernetic implants.

rules.name: Boor (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to all social and diplomatic interaction checks.
rules.notes: The character is socially obnoxious, and annoying. Individuals with this handicap must take a 1c to Cha in all social settings in which being a boor would be a disadvantage. Players should roleplay the character in a suitably boorish manner.

rules.name: Bridge Officer (mso)
rules.effect: +2 to all operational ability rolls on ship systems.
rules.notes: Role mastery for starship and vehicle commanders granting +2 to all operational ability rolls.

rules.name: Calemora Description (mso)
rules.effect: Massive 5'6" copper-skinned humanoids with acoustic skin receptors, martial arts, and tissue control.
rules.notes: Standing at an average of 5'6" but packing 350 pounds of solid, copper-skinned muscle, the Calemora are primitive humanoids with massive, V-shaped torsos and arms as strong as their legs. They completely lack external ears or ear holes, instead detecting sound vibrations through specialized sensory receptors lining their chests and backs. Disdaining armor and propelled firearms, they wear only basic loincloths to leave their acoustic skin-receptors exposed, relying instead on martial arts and supreme psychosomatic control over their own tissue.

rules.name: Calemora Dimensions & Lifespan (mso)
rules.effect: Male Only, Height (5'0" to 6'4"); Width (3'6" to 4'10"); Weight (270 to 570 lbs); Starting Age 30 to 60 years.
rules.notes: Allowed Genders: Male only. Age Formula: 30 years (Max: 60 years). Height Formula: 60 inches (Max: 76 inches). Weight Formula: 270 lbs (Max: 570 lbs). Width Formula: 42 inches (Max: 58 inches).

rules.name: Calemora Physiology & Activity Cycle (mso)
rules.effect: Infrared 180° FOV; No sleep (4h daily meditation); Herbivore (roots/tubers, zero liquid needed).
rules.notes: Vision: Infrared spectrum, white-to-pink shades representing heat signatures, and monochrome red, with a stable 180-degree field of view. Sleep: Do not sleep. Instead, they must rest and meditate for 4 hours daily; failing to do so results in a severely shortened lifespan. Diet: Strict herbivores. Subsist on fleshy, water-rich planetary roots. This diet completely eliminates their need to drink liquids; however, if roots are unavailable, they must consume outworld tubers (potatoes, radishes) and supplement with water.

rules.name: Calemora Racial Weapons (mso)
rules.effect: Gain +1 Atk/Dmg with Calemora Weapons (list is in notes)
rules.notes: Racial weapon proficiency granting Calemoran +1 Atk/Dmg with: Axe, Ba-Shonk, Hook-Pa, Ka Jung, Kray, Ra-oot, Sword, Ta-oon.

rules.name: Camouflage Mounts (mso)
rules.effect: Rides cybernetically upgraded, color-shifting feline Pouncers as armored war-mounts.
rules.notes: Capture and cybernetically upgrade giant feline predators called "Pouncers" (which can shift their skin pigmentation to match any terrain) to serve as heavily armored war-mounts.

rules.name: Carbine Weapon Mastery (mso)
rules.effect: +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Carbine Weapons.
rules.notes: Combat style mastery granting +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Carbine Weapons.

rules.name: Catongi Temperature Language (mso)
rules.effect: Non-verbal communication via psychosomatic body temperature shifts at chakra points.
rules.notes: When in close proximity, Calemora communicate non-verbally through Catongi—using psychosomatic control to alter their body temperature at specific sensitive points called chakra. Covering these chakra points severely slows down communication. It is a highly subtle language that is incredibly difficult for other species to learn, requiring specialized infrared equipment.

rules.name: Chapter Inception Armament Set (mso)
rules.effect: Sorce Saber, Warrior Claws, Vanguard Shield, Marine Assault Suit gain a +1 to all rolls
rules.notes: Sorce Saber, Warrior Claws, Vanguard Shield, Marine Assault Suit gain a +1 to all rolls

rules.name: Clumsy (mso)
rules.effect: Must pass 🏃 check when handling delicate items or drop/fumble.
rules.notes: This handicap requires that a character roll a 🏃 check when handling something fragile or in attempts to catch things. All such checks are made at a -3 penalty.

rules.name: Code of Honor
rules.effect: Bound by chivalry: must accept honorable surrenders and never strike a helpless foe.
rules.notes: Handicap / tactical rule exception.

rules.name: Color Blind (mso)
rules.effect: Cannot perceive colors; functions in monochrome vision.
rules.notes: This handicap indicates that a character cannot see colors at all. It may only be taken by members of races who see in color.

rules.name: Comfort-Driven Quarters (mso)
rules.effect: Prioritizes luxury over military utility with dense cozy napping niches.
rules.notes: They prioritize luxury over military utility. The Zin-Shee moon base is characterized by plush furniture, incredibly sparse workspaces, and a massive density of cozy napping niches.

rules.name: Cyber Implants Choice (mso)
rules.effect: May buy any 3 CyberTech Exotics at 1/2 Price.
rules.notes: Specialized Training Tree: May choose any 3 other cyber implants (of choice).

rules.name: Cyber Warrior Conditioning (mso)
rules.effect: +1 to Fortitude, Cybernetics, and Vitality.
rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Fortitude, Cybernetics, and Vitality attributes.

rules.name: Cyber Warrior Focus (mso)
rules.effect: Heavy mechanical, protective, and sensory cybernetic skeletal enhancements.
rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Operates under the philosophy that the biological flesh is imperfect. Enhances their skeletal frame with heavy mechanical, protective, and sensory cybernetic implants.

rules.name: CyberTech Armor Kit (mso)
rules.effect: Gain CyberTech Armor Kit for Free
rules.notes: Cyber Warriors may become skilled in all CyberTech Armor Implants.

rules.name: CyberTech Weapons Kit (mso)
rules.effect: Gain CyberTech Weapons Kit for Free
rules.notes: Cyber Warriors may become skilled in all CyberTech Weapons and Weapon Implants.

rules.name: Deep Sleeper (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to 👁️ checks to awaken from loud noises or disturbances.
rules.notes: A deep sleeper will sleep through virtually anything, and suffers a -3 penalty when attempting to wake up, even in the face of loud noise, attack, etc.

rules.name: Destron Conditioning (mso)
rules.effect: +1 to Technology, Strength, Ranged, and Dexterity.
rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Technology, Strength, Ranged, and Dexterity attributes.

rules.name: Destron Focus (mso)
rules.effect: Walking technological dreadnought employing heavy tech armor and artillery.
rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Walking technological dreadnoughts. Employs heavy walking-tank armor and high-firepower artillery weapons that require power assistance to even lift.

rules.name: Draca Description (mso)
rules.effect: Massive 6'6" reptilian warriors with heavy cybernetic implants, razor jaws, and ritual taillessness.
rules.notes: The Draca are massive, 6'6" bipedal reptilian warriors with thick, scaled skin, clawed extremities, and heavy, razor-toothed jaws. They wear only a loincloth and a tribal chest sash decorated with accolades, though they are instantly recognizable by the brutal, highly customized cybernetic armor and implants riveted directly to their skulls and skeletons. Obsessed with martial prowess, their grim appearance is often marked by the ritual removal of their tails at birth to avoid looking primitive.

rules.name: Draca Dimensions & Lifespan (mso)
rules.effect: Height (6'0" to 7'6"); Weight (250 to 430 lbs); Starting Age 10 to 50 years.
rules.notes: Allowed Genders: Male or Female Age Formula: 10 years (Max: 50 years). Height Formula: 72 inches (Max: 90 inches). Weight Formula: 250 lbs (Max: 430 lbs).

rules.name: Draca Physiology & Activity Cycle (mso)
rules.effect: Monochrome 270° FOV; Diurnal (8h sleep, 6h w/ thermoplas); Strict carnivore (raw meat, liquids 2x/day).
rules.notes: Vision: Standard visible spectrum but entirely monochromatic (black-and-white), with an exceptional 270-degree field of view. Sleep: Sluggish in cold conditions; require 8 hours of sleep during darkness. This requirement is reduced to 6 hours only if fitted with a thermoplas blood-warming implant. Diet: Strict carnivores. Cannot process vegetable matter; eating plants will cause them to starve. Prefer raw, fresh meat and must drink liquids twice daily.

rules.name: Draca Racial Weapons (mso)
rules.effect: Gain +1 Atk/Dmg with Draca Weapons (list is in notes)
rules.notes: Racial weapon proficiency granting Dracan +1 Atk/Dmg with: Bolt Sword, Drac-Maul, Manta, Scythe-Cannon.

rules.name: Dragon Conditioning (mso)
rules.effect: +1 to Natural Def, Nish, Speed, Strength, and Body.
rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Natural Defense, Nish 🚩, Speed, Strength, and Body attributes.

rules.name: Dragon Focus (mso)
rules.effect: Unarmed martial close combat mastery from the Calemoran Catong of the Dragon.
rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Unarmed Close Combat. Focuses on the rigorous physical teachings of the Grand Masters from the Calemoran Catong of the Dragon.

rules.name: Egg-Mistress Champions (mso)
rules.effect: Challenging the Egg-mistress requires duel-slaying all 12-20 bodyguards before final duel.
rules.notes: The supreme ruler of the Dracan Holding (the Egg-mistress) is protected by a fanatical elite guard of 12 to 20 clan warriors. To challenge the Egg-mistress for leadership, a claimant must successfully slay every single bodyguard in duel-combat before earning the right to fight her in a final duel to the death.

rules.name: Environmental & Biological Immunity (mso)
rules.effect: Complete immunity to poison, disease, temperature extremes, and vacuum asphyxiation.
rules.notes: Shanask are completely immune to all known forms of poison, disease, and temperature extremes, and can survive indefinitely without air, even in a perfect vacuum

rules.name: Environmental & Postural Shunning (mso)
rules.effect: Shuns artificial light; never sits, kneels, or lies down, remaining permanently standing.
rules.notes: They avoid artificial light sources, preferring natural starlight or planetary illumination. They never sit, kneel, or lie down, remaining permanently standing.

rules.name: Evolutionary Physiology (mso)
rules.effect: Advanced skeletal/muscular build with superior endurance; body hair limited to head and facial hair.
rules.notes: Evolved significantly from ancient human ancestors, possessing an advanced skeletal and muscular architecture with superior physical endurance. They have lost almost all body hair, retaining only head hair and, in males, facial hair.

rules.name: Fast Drain (mso)
rules.effect: Loses Vit at double the normal rate when bleeding or draining.
rules.notes: Characters with fast drain lose Vit faster than others. Characters with this handicap who take critical Dmg receive two points of Dmg per round, instead of one.

rules.name: Fastidious Combat Shunning (mso)
rules.effect: Prefers clean elegant weapons; fights savagely with natural weapons if forced.
rules.notes: Deeply dislike messy, bloody physical combat, preferring elegant, precise weapons (like rapiers or lasers) that kill cleanly. If forced to resort to natural weapons (teeth and claws), they will fight with terrifying, savage violence—but will immediately indulge in a long, hot bath afterward.

rules.name: Fearful (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to fear checks and morale saves.
rules.notes: Fearful characters make fear checks at -3.

rules.name: Feudal Eccentricities & Fads (mso)
rules.effect: Extravagant noble culture obsessed with theatrical fashion and eccentric fads.
rules.notes: Zin-Shee nobles are notoriously extravagant and dramatic dandies. They regularly obsess over faddish, short-term trends, such as wearing elaborate Renaissance ruffs and capes or predicting the future by reading fireplace ashes.

rules.name: Flirtatious (mso)
rules.effect: Must pass 🫀 check to resist romantic advances or seduction.
rules.notes: The character has a hard time resisting members of the opposite sex. As much as anything, flirtatiousness is an opportunity for good roleplaying. If a flirtatious PC encounters a member of the opposite gender (of the same or similar race), he or she must make a WP check vs Cha or be forced to make romantic overtures. The nature of these overtures is up to the player — they need not be overt or graphic, but must be made nonetheless. Races with minimal emotions or different biologies such Kryll, Shanask and Calemora are not really appropriate for this handicap, but as always, the GM may decide otherwise.

rules.name: Fortune's Child
rules.effect: +1 Max 🍀 pool.
rules.notes: Derived stat hook: Increases Max Luck pool by 1.

rules.name: Frail (mso)
rules.effect: Maximum Vit is permanently reduced (2 dice steps below actual Vit).
rules.notes: Frail characters have a Vit maximum which is 2d below their actual Vit. A frail character with a d8 vitality would, therefore, have only 8 (d6) Vitality points, instead of 12. The character may still use his or her normal Vit for all other rolls, however.

rules.name: Fraternal Jewelry (mso)
rules.effect: Wears intricate jewelry as status symbols or to designate elite/fraternity/military circles.
rules.notes: Both sexes wear intricate jewelry (such as custom rings, headbands, collars, or necklaces) as status symbols or to designate membership in elite groups, fraternities, or military circles.

rules.name: Frictionless Silent Travel (mso)
rules.effect: Moves in absolute silence and leaves no tracks or footprints.
rules.notes: Shanask move in absolute silence and leave no physical tracks or footprints whatsoever

rules.name: Generation-Spanning Clan Feuds (mso)
rules.effect: Matrilineal clans engage in generational blood feuds; immediate revenge required.
rules.notes: Standard societal units are matrilineal clans tracing descent from the female egg-layer. These clans regularly lock into brutal, generational blood feuds. Failing to immediately avenge the assassination of a relative is viewed as a fatal sign of clan weakness.

rules.name: Glass Cannon
rules.effect: -3 Max Vit.
rules.notes: Derived stat hook: Reduces Max Vitality by 3.

rules.name: Glass Jaw (mso)
rules.effect: +When wounded by a physical blow; Save 🫀^Wounds or Stunned for 1-Rnd.
rules.notes: A severe physiological fragility where blunt physical trauma to the head or jaw easily overwhelms cranial equilibrium and triggers immediate sensory blackout.

rules.name: Greedy (mso)
rules.effect: Must pass 🫀 check with Adv vs value or demand largest share of loot.
rules.notes: Greedy characters who encounter large amounts of money, valuable pieces of equipment, etc., must make a WP roll with advantage vs the value in credits or demand to be given the item or the lion’s share of the money. Greed is also a good roleplaying handicap, as it does not always have direct gaming applications.

rules.name: Heirloom Machinery (mso)
rules.effect: Cybernetic implants treated with religious reverence and inherited as clan heirlooms.
rules.notes: Cybernetic implants are treated with religious fervor and are frequently passed down through generations as highly valued clan heirlooms.

rules.name: Hermetic Seal
rules.effect: Immune to toxic atmospheres and hard vacuum; 48h air supply.
rules.notes: Integrated environmental life support.

rules.name: Hive Isolation Death (mso)
rules.effect: Prolonged hive isolation causes standard Kryll to lose will to live; PC Kryll are rare exceptions.
rules.notes: Kryll are fundamentally built for hive life. If isolated from a hive queen, pheromone nodes, or a translator-caste leader for more than a few hours, a standard Kryll warrior will lose the will to live, stop eating, and starve to death. PC Kryll are rare exceptions.

rules.name: Immutable Robe (mso)
rules.effect: Robes cannot be removed or opened; physical attempts to strip robes trigger paralysis.
rules.notes: It is physically impossible to roll up a Shanask's sleeves, lower their hood, or expose the body beneath. Any physical attempt to remove their robes activates a defensive Sorce mechanism that paralyzes the offender.

rules.name: Impossible Robes
rules.effect: Base AR is derived from 👁️ die rating (d4→4, d6→6, d8→8, d10→10, d12→12).
rules.notes: Derived stat hook: Automatically sets base AR from Mind attribute.

rules.name: Keen Senses
rules.effect: Adv(Perception 👁️, Awareness 👁️).
rules.notes: Elf racial passive trait.

rules.name: Kryll Description (mso)
rules.effect: Insectoid hive-beings with biotech mastery, peeling exoskeletons, and living organic armor.
rules.notes: The Kryll are insectoid hive-beings resembling a massive cross between a praying mantis and an ant, standing up to five feet tall with glittering, multi-faceted eyes and heavy, serrated mandibles. They wear no clothing, exposing their colorful, perpetually peeling chitinous exoskeletons and specialized nutrient glands that secrete slime to feed their living weapons. Operating under a rigid hive caste system, they are the galaxy's ultimate masters of biotechnology, wrapping themselves in living, breathing organic armor.

rules.name: Kryll Dimensions & Lifespan (mso)
rules.effect: Allowed Genders: None (neuter). Height (4'0" to 5'0"); Length (5'2" to 7'0"); Weight (300 to 540 lbs); Starting Age 5 to 15 years.
rules.notes: Allowed Genders: None (neuter). Age Formula: 5 years (Max: 15 years). Height Formula: 48 inches (Max: 60 inches). Length Formula: 62 inches (Max: 84 inches). Weight Formula: 300 lbs (Max: 540 lbs).

rules.name: Kryll Physiology & Activity Cycle (mso)
rules.effect: UV & Starlight 360° FOV; No sleep (24h continuous); Universal Organic Digestion (eats q5-6h).
rules.notes: Vision: Ultraviolet-sensitive, starlight amplification, multi-faceted color, with a full 360-degree field of view. Sleep: Never sleep. Capable of continuous 24-hour activity. Diet: Omnivorous. Universal Organic Digestion: Kryll digestive systems are augmented with symbiotic organisms that allow them to digest nearly any form of organic matter without causing toxic side effects, which helps fuel their high metabolism requiring them to consume several pounds of food every 5 to 6 hours

rules.name: Kryll Racial Weapons (mso)
rules.effect: Kryll have no tacial eeapons, though they tend to take BioTech weapons.
rules.notes: Kryll have no racial weapons, though they tend to take BioTech weapons.

rules.name: Kurr'ssa Companions (mso)
rules.effect: Keeps blinding eye-beam feline Kurr'ssa pets that demand constant attention.
rules.notes: Frequently keep small, highly independent feline predators called Kurr'ssa as pets. Kurr'ssa can project bioelectrical light beams from their eyes to blind targets. They are demanding, coddled creatures; if denied constant attention, they will use their eye-beams and claws to systematically destroy their owner's possessions.

rules.name: Language, Guildspeak (mso)
rules.effect: Can speak: GuildSpeak
rules.notes: Can speak: GuildSpeak

rules.name: Laziness & Slavery (mso)
rules.effect: Disdains manual labor; historical slavery faces internal liberation movement rift.
rules.notes: Disdain tedious, uninteresting, or manual labor. Historically, the Matriarchy conquered and enslaved other races (like the Lirrit) to perform these dull tasks. Outworld Zin-Shee within the Guild have begun a movement to liberate all slaves, creating a massive political rift that threatens to split the Matriarchy.

rules.name: Limping Gait
rules.notes: Handicap / tactical rule exception.

rules.name: Locomotor Cyber-Kit (mso)
rules.effect: Cyber-Legs (Speed), Cyber-Legs (Strength), Joint Locks, Power Joints gain a +1 to all rolls
rules.notes: Cyber-Legs (Speed), Cyber-Legs (Strength), Joint Locks, Power Joints gain a +1 to all rolls

rules.name: Low Cold Tolerance (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to all checks vs cold; -1 AR vs cold Dmg.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must make all rolls against cold at -3. Armor rolls vs cold damage are made at -1.

rules.name: Low Death Threshold (mso)
rules.effect: Death checks begin at -5 Vit instead of normal -10 Vit.
rules.notes: Characters with low death thresholds begin making death checks at five points of critical Dmg, rather than the normal 10.

rules.name: Low Heat Tolerance (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to all checks vs heat; -1 AR vs heat and plasma Dmg.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must make all rolls against heat at -3. Armor rolls vs heat and plasma Dmg are at -1.

rules.name: Low Poison Tolerance (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to all saves and checks to resist poisons and toxins.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap take a -3 penalty on all rolls to resist poison.

rules.name: Marine Conditioning (mso)
rules.effect: +1 to Technology, Dexterity, Strength, Fortitude, and Ranged.
rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Technology, Dexterity, Strength, Fortitude, and Ranged attributes.

rules.name: Marine Focus (mso)
rules.effect: Versatile military vanguard optimized for mobile medium-range firearms and combat survival.
rules.notes: Objective & Focus: The highly versatile vanguard of the military order, undergoing physical and genetic augmentations to optimize mobile medium-range firearm tactics and combat survival.

rules.name: Marriage & Litter Lifecycle (mso)
rules.effect: Short-term child-raising marriage alliances dissolved peacefully at child maturity.
rules.notes: Marriage is treated as a short-term alliance that is dissolved without any animosity or tension once the children reach maturity. Females typically raise two to three litters in a lifetime and engage in numerous passionate, non-procreative affairs.

rules.name: Martial Arts Expert (mso)
rules.effect: +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to Brawl and unarmed strikes.
rules.notes: Martial arts combat style mastery granting +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to Brawl and unarmed strikes.

rules.name: Martial Arts Weapons Kit (mso)
rules.effect: Gain Martial Arts Weapons Kit for Free
rules.notes: Dragons may become skilled in all Martial Arts Melee and Monastic Weapons.

rules.name: Mensi Conditioning (mso)
rules.effect: +1 to Will Power, Charisma, and Nish.
rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Will Power, Charisma, and Nish 🚩 attributes.

rules.name: Mensi Focus (mso)
rules.effect: Paranormal telepath and telekineticist mastering physical reality manipulation and mind focus.
rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Paranormal telepaths and telekineticists who spend mentally grueling training cycles focusing thought into physical reality and mind manipulation.

rules.name: Molting Exoskeleton (mso)
rules.effect: Chitinous exoskeleton constantly peels and molts, giving a ragged shredded appearance.
rules.notes: Their chitinous, colorful exoskeleton is constantly peeling and molting, giving them a perpetually ragged, shredded appearance.

rules.name: Monosexual Society (mso)
rules.effect: All-male society; secret reproduction; calling all members father, brother, or son.
rules.notes: Reproduce through completely undocumented, highly secret means. They call all elders "father," peers "brother," and youths "son". Speaking to outworlders about their reproduction or family structures is a severe violation of their Code of the Dragon.

rules.name: Mutak Conditioning (mso)
rules.effect: +1 to Fortitude, Will Power, and Vitality.
rules.notes: MSO Physical Conditioning: Permanent +1 to Fortitude, Will Power, and Vitality attributes.

rules.name: Mutak Focus (mso)
rules.effect: Psychosomatic cellular control commanding adrenaline, tissue density, and regeneration.
rules.notes: Objective & Focus: Psychosomatic physical masters who train their minds to physically command every tissue, adrenaline flow, and bone cell in their body for superhuman survival and hand-to-hand combat.

rules.name: Mystical Flask Dependency (mso)
rules.effect: Must use carried liquid and powder flask compounds to enable natural healing.
rules.notes: Every Shanask carries a pair of flasks (one containing powder, the other liquid). They must use these compounds to heal physical damage; they are completely incapable of natural healing if these flasks are lost or destroyed.

rules.name: Nature Attunement
rules.effect: Ignore 👣 penalties in natural wilderness terrain.
rules.notes: Elf racial passive trait.

rules.name: Neuter Castes (mso)
rules.effect: Adventuring worker/warrior castes are sterile and genderless; only queens and drones possess gender.
rules.notes: All standard worker and warrior castes are genetically female but sterile, and function as genderless ("neuter") entities. Adventuring Kryll are strictly sterile worker and warrior castes. Only the massive hive-queens and their blind, short-lived drones possess gender.

rules.name: Night Blindness (mso)
rules.effect: Treats low-light conditions as total darkness; blind in dim light.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap treat low-light conditions as total darkness, and function as if completely blind.

rules.name: No Physical Contact (mso)
rules.effect: Strictly refuses to touch any living being, maintaining a one-inch cloak buffer.
rules.notes: Strictly refuse to touch any living being. When delivering touch-based Sorce spells, they only bring their cloak within an inch or two of the target

rules.name: One-Eyed
rules.effect: Dis(Shot) due to depth perception handicap.
rules.notes: Handicap / tactical rule exception.

rules.name: Pacifist (mso)
rules.effect: Will not fight unless personally attacked or an ally is struck.
rules.notes: Pacifists will not normally fight unless they are personally attacked, or one of their allies has actually been hit.

rules.name: Parenting & PUBLIC Decorum (mso)
rules.effect: Strict public discipline with rapid maturation; absolute gender equality.
rules.notes: Young hatchlings mature very quickly. While parents may show tenderness and deep affection in private, young Draca are strictly forbidden from showing weakness and must act as disciplined, mature adults whenever in public. Genders have absolute political and social equality.

rules.name: Pheromonal Intercoms (mso)
rules.effect: Hive bio-nodes act as biochemical intercoms transferring pheromonal data instantly.
rules.notes: Kryll starships and hives are laced with biological communication nodes that act as instant, biochemical intercoms, transferring complex pheromonal data at the speed of a nerve impulse.

rules.name: Physical Records (mso)
rules.effect: No written books; history and martial philosophy preserved solely in stone carvings.
rules.notes: Books and permanent written records are entirely unknown; they preserve their history and martial philosophies solely through deep stone carvings in their catongs.

rules.name: Physical Symmetry (mso)
rules.effect: Massive upper body symmetry; arm/shoulder strength and bone thickness matches legs.
rules.notes: Their upper bodies are exceptionally massive, with the bones and muscles of their arms and shoulders matching the sheer strength and thickness of their legs.

rules.name: Pistolier Weapon Mastery (mso)
rules.effect: +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Tech-Pistol Weapons.
rules.notes: Combat style mastery granting +1 Atk and +1 Dmg to all Tech-Pistol Weapons.

rules.name: Pixie Gliding
rules.effect: Glide safely from any height; immune to fall Dmg.
rules.notes: Fairy racial passive trait.

rules.name: Poison Resistance
rules.effect: 🫀+5^poison, toxins, and alcohol.
rules.notes: Dwarf racial passive trait.

rules.name: Poor Hearing (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to all 👁️ auditory perception checks.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must take a -3 penalty to all rolls based upon hearing.

rules.name: Poor Smell (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to all 👁️ olfactory and scent tracking checks.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must take a -3 penalty to all rolls based upon smell.

rules.name: Poor Taste (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to all 👁️ taste and food/poison identification checks.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must take a -3 penalty to all rolls based upon taste.

rules.name: Poor Touch (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to all 👁️ tactile and micro-texture checks.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must take a -3 penalty to all rolls based upon touch.

rules.name: Poor Vision (mso)
rules.effect: -3 to all 👁️ visual perception checks.
rules.notes: Characters with this handicap must take a -3 penalty to all rolls based upon vision.

rules.name: Poverty (mso)
rules.effect: Starts with half credits; mission allowances reduced by 1 rank.
rules.notes: The character is poor, or is badly in debt. Poor characters receive only half their starting credits, and earn mission allowance at one rank below their actual rank. Rank two characters receive pay as if they were rank one, rank three would take pay at rank two, etc. (Rank zero characters still receive normal allowance, however). If the character becomes poor after generation, then half of the character’s funds are immediately deducted, and future allowance penalties are as described above.

rules.name: Pragmatic Cattle Culturing (mso)
rules.effect: Views non-aligned foreign species with cold utility, breeding unaligned sentients as livestock.
rules.notes: Kryll view foreign species with cold utility. If a species is not an ally or an enemy, traditional hive-queens will simply breed them as docile livestock.

rules.effect: Cannot possess psionic powers; compensated with superior physical combat ability.
rules.notes: Zin-Shee Males do not and may not possess psionic powers; to compensate, they are gifted with superior natural physical combat abilities.
