Carapace Armor is the pinnacle of living armor, offering marine-grade protection and full environmental sealing.
Effects
-- Living shell provides protection comparable to heavy marine armor; seals airtight and filters air for breathing.
-- Front left clear for unimpaired vision.
-- Can be tailored to different species by special order.

armor.name: Chain Shirt
armor.notes: Chain Shirt is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

armor.name: Cyber A
armor.notes:
Cyber A adds torso and both forearms to the facial plating. The wearer has chest or back coverage (or one major torso surface), full facial armor, and both forearms plated. This moderate coverage protects the core and arms while leaving the upper arms and legs unarmored. The plating is integrated across regions for a cohesive cyber look.
The result is a clear step up from Cyber L: face, torso (one side), and both forearms in metallic armor.
Effects
-- Covers face, one torso surface (chest or back), and both forearms.
-- Component regions integrate for a single Cyber A loadout.

armor.name: Cyber G
armor.notes:
Cyber G extends coverage to full torso (chest and back), full facial armor, and both arms in full—forearm and upper arm on each side. The wearer's core, head, and arms are fully protected by cyber plating; only the legs remain unarmored. This substantial loadout is for those who expect heavy contact in the upper body and want maximum arm and torso protection.
The silhouette is imposing: torso, face, and both arms in seamless or articulated cyber armor, often with tribal or symbolic detailing.
Cyber G offers near-complete upper-body cyber protection.
Effects
-- Covers full torso (chest and back), face, and both arms (forearm + upper arm each).
-- Legs are not covered.

armor.name: Cyber H
armor.notes:
Cyber H is full-body partial cyber armor: torso (chest and back), facial plating, both arms (forearm and upper arm each), and both legs (thigh, knee, and shin each). Every major region is covered with integrated cyber plating, creating a complete partial suit. The armor is still classified as partial rather than full suit armor but represents the maximum coverage available in the cyber armor line.
The wearer is fully plated from head to foot in gleaming metallic armor, with articulated joints at knees, elbows, and waist.
Cyber H is the pinnacle of cyber partial armor.
Effects
-- Covers full torso, face, both arms (forearm + upper arm each), and both legs (thigh + knee + shin each).
-- Full-body partial cyber; all regions integrated.

armor.name: Cyber L
armor.notes:
Cyber L is minimal cyber armor coverage: facial plating plus one forearm. The face is protected by gleaming metallic half-face armor, often used alongside cyber-eyes and inscribed with runes or symbolic images. One forearm is fully plated and integrated with the user's cybernetic framework. Together they offer light partial protection for those who want a visible cyber look without heavy coverage.
The appearance is distinctive but limited—half face and one arm in metal, the rest of the body unarmored.
Cyber L provides the lightest cyber armor option while still signaling the wearer's augmentation.
Effects
-- Covers roughly half the face and one forearm only.
-- Often paired with cyber-eyes or other facial modifications.

armor.name: Cyber Partial Extreme (mso)
armor.notes: Surgically implanted maximum-density full-skeleton cyber-armor chassis reinforcement and heavy spiked alloy plating across chest, back, and all limbs, delivering near-impenetrable cybernetic fortification.

armor.name: Cyber Partial Heavy (mso)
armor.notes: Surgically implanted heavy cybernetic armor plating covering vital quadrants. Potential components include Torso Plating (Chest/Back), reinforced composite limb sets, and heavy subdermal alloy plating.

armor.name: Cyber Partial Light (mso)
armor.notes: Surgically implanted cybernetic armor plating covering light extremities. Potential components include Forearm Plating, Knee Plating, Facial Plating, or Shin Plating (standard or spiked), riveted directly to bone and integrated with neural sensors.

armor.name: Cyber Partial Medium (mso)
armor.notes: Surgically implanted cybernetic armor plating covering intermediate limb zones. Potential components include Upper Arm Plating, Thigh Plating, reinforced limb clusters, or multi-zone subdermal weaves.

armor.name: Denim Battle Vest
armor.notes: Denim Battle Vest is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

armor.name: Destron Armor (mso)
armor.notes: Heavily armored, power assisted, and armed to the teeth, the Destron warrior is a walking engine of destruction, easily capable of shrugging off attacks from even the deadliest heavy weapon. Standard systems (included free) are compensators, two external and one internal hard point, sealed, two flood lights, genjector, joint locks, strength enhancers, targeting computer, communicator kit, ultralock boot kit, and macrovisor kit.

armor.name: Destron Chassis
armor.notes: Heavy powered combat armor chassis.

armor.name: Dragon Scale Armor
armor.notes: Dragon Scale Armor is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

armor.name: Ethereal
armor.notes:
Ethereal Armor Kit
Ethereal Armor is a masterful fusion of agility and protection, crafted specifically for the character to enhance their melee prowess and channel Aether energy into their combat techniques. Weighing just 12 pounds, this sleek armor is made from Aether Weave Fabric, a cutting-edge textile infused with Aether energy that enhances the wearer’s speed, agility, and precision while providing lightweight protection.
When the character dons the Ethereal Armor, they feel an immediate connection to the Aether energy flowing through the intricate patterns and glowing runes that adorn its surface. The armor fits like a second skin, allowing for unrestricted movement, while the Aether Resonance Plates provide critical reinforcement in key areas. The Phantom Cloak upgrade can be activated, causing the armor to shimmer and fade from view, rendering the character nearly invisible as they prepare to strike from the shadows. The compact Aether core hums quietly, powering the armor’s enhancements and ensuring that the character remains a formidable force in any combat scenario.
With Ethereal Armor, the character becomes a swift and silent warrior, capable of executing devastating techniques with unmatched precision and grace.
Effects
-- Lightweight armor designed for agility and enhanced melee capabilities through Aether energy.
-- Powered by an Aether core that requires periodic recharging.

armor.name: Expedition Armor
armor.notes:
Expedition Armor is heavier than standard trooper armor and is typically issued to infantry who expect heavy firepower or prolonged resistance. Door gunners, vehicle crews, and dismounted troops in contested zones often wear this style for the extra protection and the ability to operate for extended periods with integrated nutrition and medical support. It offers a balance between mobility and durability for sustained operations.
The suit features plated coverage over a durable undersuit, with one external hard point for mission-specific gear. Integrated systems include targeting, communications, and illumination, plus nutrijector and slap-o-matic for field care. The overall look is utilitarian and robust, suited to long patrols and harsh environments.
Expedition Armor supports troops who need to hold the line and stay effective when resupply is delayed.
Effects
-- One external hard point, nutrijector, slap-o-matic, targeting computer, communicator kit, illuminator kit (included).

armor.name: Expedition Armor (mso)
armor.notes: Heavier than trooper armor, expedition armor is typically worn by infantrymen who expect to face heavy firepower or dogged resistance. Door gunners on transports often wear this style of armor. Standard systems (included free) are one external hard point, nutrijector, slap-o-matic, targeting computer, communicator kit, and illuminator kit.

armor.name: Field Plate
armor.notes: Field Plate is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

armor.name: Flak
armor.notes:
Flak is a generic term for infantry body armor consisting of metal, ceramic, or plastic plates sewn or bonded into a vest and pants. Lightweight and affordable, it is widely used by infantry, irregulars, and anyone who needs basic protection without the cost or weight of full tactical armor. The plates distribute impact and stop or reduce penetration from small arms and fragmentation.
The look is utilitarian: webbing or fabric carriers hold rigid panels over the torso and sometimes the limbs. Colors and cuts vary by force and supplier. Flak offers no sealed environment, no powered systems, and minimal coverage compared to full suit armor—but it is easy to don, maintain, and replace.
Flak provides practical, budget-friendly protection for frontline roles where full armor is not available or not desired.
Effects
-- Plates provide protection against small arms and fragmentation; coverage is typically torso-focused.
-- No sealed environment or integrated systems; worn over normal clothing or undersuit.
-- Commonly used by infantry, raiders, and forces with limited logistics.

armor.name: Flak (mso)
armor.notes: "Flak" is a generic term for infantry body armor, consisting of metal, ceramic or plastic plates sewn into a vest and pants. Flak is commonly used by infantry, raiders, and those who cannot afford better.

armor.name: Full Plate
armor.notes: Full Plate is a masterwork of interlocking steel plates, meticulously forged by ancient blacksmiths to form a seamless second skin. Every joint is reinforced with riveted girders, and the polished surface reflects the wearer's resolve, turning the armor into a mobile fortress of unyielding defiance.

armor.name: Fury
armor.notes:
Fury Armor Kit
Fury Armor is an intimidating blend of traditional craftsmanship and advanced materials, meticulously designed to enhance the character's strength, durability, and combat prowess. Weighing 30 pounds, this robust armor offers unparalleled protection and power, perfect for breaking enemy lines and absorbing significant damage in the heat of battle. The armor is constructed from Rage Plates, a rare alloy that hardens during the character’s berserk states, and Adaptive Mesh, a flexible material that conforms to the character's movements and transformations, ensuring that their ferocity is never hindered.
The armor’s design is both fearsome and functional, with dark metallic tones, crimson highlights, and battle-worn insignias that strike terror into the hearts of enemies. The surface is covered with intricate engravings and runes that glow faintly when the character enters a rage, channeling their ferocity into raw combat power. The Adaptive Mesh allows for rapid, powerful movements, while the Rage Plates provide exceptional protection, making the character a terrifying force on the battlefield.
When the character dons Fury Armor, they become a walking fortress of raw strength and advanced technology. The armor's Combat Enhancers tap into the character’s adrenaline, boosting their physical power and accelerating healing during battle. Despite its heavy construction, the armor operates silently, thanks to noise-dampening materials, allowing the character to approach their enemies unnoticed before unleashing devastating attacks. Fury Armor is more than just protection; it is a manifestation of the character’s unstoppable rage and indomitable spirit.

armor.name: Gaia
armor.notes:
Gaia Armor Kit
Gaia Armor is an extraordinary blend of organic and synthetic materials, designed specifically for the character to master battlefield control and defense. This biotechnological marvel offers exceptional protection and adaptability, ensuring that the character remains a formidable force in any environment. Composed of plant-based nanotechnology interwoven with high-strength synthetic fibers, Gaia Armor provides both flexibility and durability, allowing the character to move with ease while being shielded from harm.
Visually, Gaia Armor is a stunning representation of the harmony between nature and technology. The armor features a palette of deep greens and earthy browns, reminiscent of a forest, with bioluminescent accents that glow softly, adjusting to the surrounding environment to enhance camouflage. The surface of the armor has a textured, natural appearance, with intricate patterns of leaves and vines etched into the material. As the character moves, the armor adapts seamlessly, its organic components shifting and growing to meet the challenges of the terrain, all while maintaining an air of silent, deadly grace.
Gaia Armor embodies the perfect fusion of nature and technology, providing the character with unmatched protection and versatility on the battlefield.

armor.name: Gambeson
armor.notes: Gambeson is a quilted textile masterpiece, woven from dense layers of linen and wool to absorb the force of blows. Its padded construction offers a surprising balance of flexibility and protection, resembling a second layer of flesh that moves in harmony with the wearer's every motion.

armor.name: Geomantic
armor.notes:
Geomantic Armor Kit
Geomantic Armor is a unique fusion of natural materials and advanced technology, crafted specifically for the character to excel in tactical support and spellcasting. This armor offers exceptional defense and mobility through its Earth-Infused Plating, reinforced with minerals and crystals for superior protection, and Adaptive Layering, which adjusts to environmental conditions. Powered by a Magitech Core, the armor enhances the character's spellcasting abilities, making their elemental magic more potent and efficient.
When worn, Geomantic Armor presents an awe-inspiring sight. The armor’s surface is an intricate blend of earthy browns and greens, with shimmering crystal highlights that catch the light and reflect the character’s connection to the earth. The runes and symbols etched across the armor pulse rhythmically with elemental energy, casting a soft glow that intensifies during spellcasting. The suit hums with a low, resonant frequency, a constant reminder of the powerful Magitech Core within. As the character moves, the armor adapts seamlessly to their environment, the layers shifting and adjusting with a subtle, organic sound, providing both protection and freedom of movement.
Geomantic Armor is the ultimate combination of natural fortitude and advanced technology, offering the character unmatched protection, mobility, and spellcasting prowess, ensuring their dominance on the battlefield.
Effects
-- Armor operates effectively in a wide temperature range (-40°F to 130°F).
-- See below for specific enhancements.

armor.name: Glowweave Robe
armor.notes: Glowweave Robe is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

armor.name: Half-Plate
armor.notes: Half-Plate combines the resilience of plate armor with the agility of chainmail, featuring reinforced plates on the torso and limbs while leaving the arms and legs clad in supple leather. The design strikes a balance between defense and mobility, its angular contours suggesting both strength and calculated restraint.

armor.name: Hardened Riot Exo-Suit
armor.notes: Hardened Riot Exo-Suit is a fusion of cybernetic engineering and tactical armor, featuring a skeletal framework of carbon fiber and titanium alloy. Its surface is covered in a reactive polymer that shifts color in response to environmental threats, while integrated plating offers protection against both ballistic and energy-based attacks.

armor.name: Heavy Laminar
armor.notes: Heavy Laminar is constructed from overlapping layers of tempered steel and reinforced leather, bound together with braided steel cords. The armor's layered design distributes impact across its surface, creating a visual effect of rippling metal that seems to absorb blows rather than resist them.

armor.name: Hide Armor
armor.notes: Hide Armor is crafted from the thick, supple hides of large beasts, expertly tanned and layered to form a flexible yet durable defense. Its natural texture and muted sheen give it a rugged, primal appearance, blending seamlessly with the wilderness.

armor.name: Husk (mso)
armor.notes: Similar to pod armor, husk armor is made from the dried-out husks of genetically engineered seed vessels. After the seeds fall, the remaining brownish husk is the size of an adult Kryll warrior (although, like pod armor, husks may be 'tailored' to fit other species).

armor.name: Husk Armor
armor.notes:
Husk Armor is made from the dried husks of genetically engineered seed vessels. After the seeds are released, the remaining brownish husk is roughly the size of an adult humanoid and can be tailored to fit different species. Like pod armor, it is a form of bio-armor that relies on grown rather than forged materials. The husk is lightweight for its coverage and provides good protection against impacts and abrasion, though it lacks the self-sealing and regeneration of living carapace or vine armor.
The appearance is organic and slightly rough—a brown, pod-like shell that wraps around the wearer and is secured with straps or natural fastenings. It is often used by forces that have access to bio-engineering and prefer sustainable, grown equipment over metal and plastic. Husk armor is typically less expensive than carapace and does not require the same level of care as living vine or spider armor.
Husk Armor offers solid bio-armor protection in a durable, non-living form.
Effects
-- Made from dried seed-vessel husks; can be tailored to wearer size and species.
-- Good protection against impacts; no sealing or regeneration.
-- Lightweight for its coverage compared to metal equivalents.

armor.name: Juggernaut Armor
armor.notes:
Juggernaut Armor is heavily armored, power-assisted, and built to dominate the battlefield. The wearer becomes a walking engine of destruction, capable of absorbing and shrugging off attacks that would disable lighter suits. Multiple hardpoints, joint locks, and strength enhancers allow the operator to carry heavy weapons and close with the enemy under fire, while sealed systems and integrated lighting support operations in any environment.
The suit's silhouette is imposing: thick plating, reinforced limbs, and a helm that integrates targeting and macrovisor systems. Every component is geared toward maximum durability and firepower. Juggernaut Armor is reserved for elite assault units and special operations where overwhelming force and resilience are required.
Juggernaut Armor defines the heavy-assault role, trading agility for near-unmatched protection and firepower.
Effects
-- Compensators, two external and one internal hard point, sealed, two flood lights, genjector, joint locks, strength enhancers, targeting computer, communicator kit, ultralock boot kit, macrovisor kit (included).

armor.name: Lamellar Armor
armor.notes: Lamellar Armor consists of overlapping rectangular plates sewn onto a sturdy backing, offering a balance of mobility and protection. The intricate arrangement of the scales mimics the armor of reptiles, exuding a sense of ancient craftsmanship and tactical precision.

armor.name: Leaf (mso)
armor.notes: Leaf armor is a sort of symbiotic vine, which grows upon the host’s body (although it must be watered occasionally). The vine produces layers of tough, shingle-like leaves which absorb damage and fall away as they are hit. A single plant easily produces enough leaves to last during an adventure, and grows them back in a matter of days.

armor.name: Leaf Armor
armor.notes:
Leaf Armor is a symbiotic vine that grows on the host's body and must be watered occasionally. The vine produces layers of tough, shingle-like leaves that absorb damage and slough off when struck, then regrow within days. A single plant produces enough leaves to last through an extended adventure, making it a renewable form of protection favored by those who can maintain a symbiotic relationship with the organism.
The armor looks distinctly organic: green or brown foliage overlapping across the wearer's torso and limbs, with a texture that is both plant-like and resilient. It does not seal the wearer from the environment but does provide meaningful protection against cuts and impacts. The vine must be cared for (water, light, and minimal damage to the root structure) to keep it healthy and productive.
Leaf Armor combines renewable protection with a distinctive, living aesthetic.
Effects
-- Symbiotic vine produces damage-absorbing leaves that fall away when hit and regrow in a matter of days.
-- Requires occasional watering and basic care.
-- Does not provide sealed environment; protection is against physical damage.

armor.name: Leather Jacket
armor.notes: A Leather Jacket is a lightweight, form-fitting armor made from cured animal hide, reinforced with stitching and metal tips for added durability. Its supple surface conforms to the wearer's body, providing a practical and versatile layer of defense.

armor.name: Marine Armor
armor.notes:
Marine Armor is heavy, well-defended suit armor and is widely recognized as the standard protection for elite marine forces. It combines full coverage with an internal environment, strength enhancers, and a full suite of tactical systems so that marines can fight in vacuum, in atmosphere, or in contaminated zones without compromise. The suit is sealed, climate-controlled, and built to withstand the rigors of ship-to-ship and planetary operations.
The armor's design is iconic: solid plating, full helmet with macrovisor, and a balanced array of hardpoints and internal slots. Integrated lighting, communicator, and targeting systems are standard, along with slap-o-matic and nutrijector for sustained operations. Marines trained in this armor are expected to operate in any environment and prevail.
Marine Armor represents the gold standard for general-purpose heavy suit protection.
Effects
-- Compensators, one external and one internal hard point, internal environment, sealed, strength enhancers, slap-o-matic, nutrijector, targeting computer, communicator kit, macrovisor kit, illuminator kit (included).

armor.name: Marine Armor (mso)
armor.notes: This heavy, well-defended armor is known throughout the Guild, and is the standard protection for the legendary known space marines. Standard systems (included free) are compensators, one external and one internal hard point, internal environment, sealed, strength enhancers, slap-o-matic, nutrijector, targeting computer, communicator kit, macrovisor kit, and illuminator kit.

armor.name: Mithril Mail
armor.notes: Mithril Mail is a rare and lustrous armor forged from the ethereal silver-gray metal known as mithril. Its lightweight yet impossibly strong threads shimmer faintly, as if woven from starlight itself, making it a coveted treasure among warriors.

armor.name: Obsidian Carapace
armor.notes: The Obsidian Carapace is a seamless, matte-black exosuit forged from hyper-dense volcanic glass and reinforced with a lattice of nano-fibers, its surface etched with faint, iridescent circuitry that pulses with a low, ambient glow. The armor’s contours mimic the jagged, organic geometry of a predator’s skeleton, with overlapping plates that shift subtly under movement, as if alive, while its joints are lined with a slick, non-reflective polymer that repels both physical impact and energy discharges. In dim light, faint fractal patterns shimmer across its surface, resembling trapped lightning, and the air around it hums with a static charge, as though the suit itself is a conduit for latent power.

armor.name: Padded Cloth
armor.notes: A dense, quilted matrix of interwoven synthetic fibers and reinforced polymer weaves, the Padded Cloth armor forms a second skin over the wearer’s body, its surface etched with micro-channel patterns that dissipate heat and moisture. In medieval contexts, it mimics layered wool and linen, stitched with geometric precision to balance flexibility and impact absorption; in sci-fi iterations, it adopts a sleek, matte-black polymer with embedded neural接口 nodes that adapt to the user’s biomechanics. Its seams are reinforced with a translucent, honeycomb-like resin, giving it a faintly iridescent sheen under bright light, while discreet utility pockets along the torso and limbs suggest a focus on practicality over ornamentation.

armor.name: Plate Harness
armor.notes: A fusion of medieval craftsmanship and futuristic engineering, the Plate Harness is a sleek, angular exoskeleton forged from blackened titanium-infused steel, its surface etched with intricate, glowing circuitry that pulses faintly with an inner light. The armor’s overlapping plates mimic traditional chainmail in texture but are reinforced with lightweight nanocomposite plating, while a reinforced, helmet-like visor curves over the wearer’s face, its polished surface reflecting ambient light like a mirror. Articulated joints allow fluid movement, and along the spine runs a serpentine conduit of faintly bioluminescent alloy, suggesting both protection and an unseen, adaptive technological interface.

armor.name: Pod (mso)
armor.notes: These enormous seed-pods are grown to the size of a normal Kryll warrior (although they may also be grown to the size of other races such as the Calemora, as well). The listed cost is for the plant which produces the pods, rather than the pods themselves, for once picked a pod will wither and become useless as armor after one adventure (i.e., about 2-4 weeks). Pod armor plants always have at least one pod available for harvest.

armor.name: Pod Armor
armor.notes:
Pod Armor is grown from enormous seed-pods produced by a dedicated plant. The pods are cultivated to the size of the intended wearer (humanoid or other species) and the cost typically covers the plant itself, which continuously produces pods. Once a pod is picked and used, it withers and becomes useless as armor after roughly one adventure (about two to four weeks). A healthy plant always has at least one pod ready for harvest, so users can rotate pods as needed.
The armor appears as a large, pod-like shell that the wearer steps into or wraps around themselves. It is organic, relatively lightweight, and provides good protection for its weight, but it is not sealed and does not repair itself like carapace or leaf armor. Pod armor is popular among forces that use bio-engineered equipment and can maintain the growing plants.
Pod Armor offers renewable, grown protection with the constraint of limited pod lifespan once harvested.
Effects
-- Grown pods; cost is for the plant, which produces pods continuously.
-- Harvested pod lasts one adventure (about 2–4 weeks) then withers.
-- Plant keeps at least one pod available for harvest; can be grown to fit different species.

armor.name: Power Frame
armor.notes:
A Power Frame is a military version of the industrial power lifters used to move cargo and heavy objects. It resembles an oversized humanoid framework with large mechanical claws and a partially armored roll cage to protect the operator. In addition to lifting and carrying, it is fitted with compensators, strength enhancers, joint locks, and multiple hardpoints, making it suitable for combat engineering, breaching, and heavy-weapons deployment.
The frame towers over a normal humanoid; the operator sits or stands inside, controlling the limbs and systems. Armor coverage is sufficient to protect against small arms and fragments, but the frame is not a substitute for full assault armor in open combat. It excels in logistics, demolition, and roles where raw strength and tool capacity matter most.
The Power Frame is the military heavy-lifter and combat-engineering platform of choice.
Effects

armor.name: Quantum Armor (mso)
armor.notes: The massively durable, highly classified power armor worn by the legendary Quantum Knights. Features advanced reactive plating and kinetic nullification.

armor.name: Riot Gear
armor.notes: A hybrid of modular plating and reinforced synthetic fabric, Riot Gear merges angular, overlapping plates of darkened alloy with sleek, ergonomic contours that hug the wearer’s form. Embedded within the armor’s surface are faintly glowing etchings of circuitry, their patterns shifting subtly in response to movement, while reinforced polymer panels flex like second skin under impact. The helmet’s visor integrates a translucent, holographic display that projects tactical data and environmental hazards, its edges lined with a faint, pulsating aura of adaptive camouflage that blurs the wearer’s outline against chaotic backdrops.

armor.name: Samurai Armor
armor.notes: A fusion of traditional craftsmanship and cutting-edge materials, this armor combines layered steel plates with reinforced polymer composites, molded into a sleek, ergonomic silhouette. The helmet features a narrow, angular visor reminiscent of samurai kabuto, framed by glowing circuitry that pulses with a faint, neon-blue aura, while articulated joints are sheathed in seamless cerametal alloys that shimmer under light. A pair of curved, blade-like pauldrons extend from the shoulders, etched with intricate wave patterns that seem to ripple subtly, as if caught between solid matter and liquid energy.

armor.name: Scale Mail
armor.notes: Overlapping plates of reinforced polymer and interwoven carbon fiber form a second-skin exosuit, each scale etched with micro-grooves that channel kinetic energy away from the wearer. The armor’s surface shimmers with a faint iridescence, as if coated in liquid metal that shifts hue with movement, while embedded filaments of adaptive nanofiber tighten or loosen dynamically to balance flexibility and impact resistance. A faint, pulsating glow emanates from the joints, suggesting latent reactive properties that might deflect projectiles or dissipate heat, though its full potential remains enigmatic.

armor.name: Scout Armor
armor.notes:
Scout Armor is a lightweight suit of advanced plate affixed to a durable body suit, designed for reconnaissance, flanking, and covert operations. Built with an integrated personal stealth net that grants Adv(Stealth 🏃) against enemy perception. Features internal compensators, an internal hardpoint, integrated targeting computer, communicator, macrovisor, jump-pack, and oxygenator.
Effects: Personal stealth net grants Adv(Stealth 🏃); includes compensators, 1 internal hardpoint, targeting computer, and mission kits.

armor.name: Scout Armor (mso)
armor.notes: A lightweight suit of plasteel plating affixed to a durable body suit engineered for high-mobility reconnaissance and infiltration. Standard systems (included free) are compensators, one internal hard point, targeting computer, communicator kit, jump-pack kit, macrovisor kit, and oxygenator kit.

armor.name: Space Suit
armor.notes:
Space Suits are compact and efficient, fully spaceworthy and capable of sustaining the wearer in vacuum and hostile atmospheres. They are of minimal use in direct combat due to limited armor and mobility, but they are essential for extravehicular activity, emergency egress, and operations in airless or toxic environments. Integrated systems include sealing, internal environment, illuminator, macrovisor with star-light and star-lamp enhancement, and ultralock boot kit for secure footing.
The suit is form-fitting and functional, with a helmet that provides a full seal and often enhanced vision for low-light and vacuum. It is the baseline survival gear for anyone operating in space or in similarly hostile conditions where breathable air and pressure are not guaranteed.
Space Suits are the minimum standard for surviving and working in vacuum.
Effects
-- Sealed, internal environment, illuminator kit, macrovisor kit with star-light and star-lamp enhancement, ultralock boot kit (included).
-- Optimized for EVA and hostile atmosphere; not intended for frontline combat.

armor.name: Spectre
armor.notes:
Spectre Armor Kit
Spectre Armor is the pinnacle of stealth technology, crafted specifically for the character to excel in reconnaissance, long-range elimination, and survival in hostile environments. Weighing only 15 pounds, this advanced suit is constructed from Nano-Weave Fabric, offering exceptional resistance to both energy and ballistic attacks while maintaining unparalleled flexibility. This flexibility ensures that the wearer can perform the rapid, agile movements essential for stealth operations.
When donned, the Spectre Armor envelops the character in a sleek, matte black shell that seems to absorb light, rendering them nearly invisible in shadowed environments. The armor’s adaptive panels subtly shift in hue, blending seamlessly with the character's surroundings, creating a chameleon-like effect that enhances stealth. The sensation of wearing the armor is akin to becoming one with the environment—silent and fluid, with every movement cushioned by noise-dampening materials that prevent any sound from escaping. The pouches and fasteners are strategically placed for easy access to gear, yet they blend into the armor's minimalist design, ensuring nothing disrupts the smooth, ghostly appearance.
Spectre Armor combines advanced protection with stealth and agility, making it an indispensable asset for the character on critical missions. Its ability to adapt and remain undetected in various environments ensures the character can carry out their objectives with unparalleled precision.
Effects
-- Power is supplied by an integrated battery pack, supporting extended missions.
-- Operates in extreme temperatures (-50°F to 130°F); vulnerable to prolonged exposure to corrosives.

armor.name: Spider (mso)
armor.notes: A suit of living Kryll bio-armor consisting of thousands of tiny semi-sentient arachnids swarming over the host’s body and interlocking their thorny legs like living chain mail. When struck, the arachnids rapidly shift across the body to seal breaches and restore coverage. The webbed lattice acts like a cargo net, holding small personal items securely against the suit.

armor.name: Spider Armor
armor.notes:
Spider Armor is one of the most unusual forms of bio-armor: thousands of tiny arachnids swarm over the wearer's body, interlocking their thorny legs to form a living layer that covers every exposed surface. When some spiders are destroyed by impacts or projectiles, the semi-sentient swarm quickly redistributes to close gaps, restoring full coverage. The spiders also act as a living cargo net, holding the wearer's gear in place, and they bite unauthorized individuals who attempt to touch the wearer or their belongings—inflicting moderate damage and an irritating itch. The armor can be disconcerting for those unaccustomed to it, but it provides resilient, self-repairing protection and built-in security for carried items.
The appearance is unmistakable: a shifting, crawling layer of small arachnids that constantly adjust to movement and damage. The sensation of wearing spider armor is unique; the wearer may feel slight movement and the spiders' grip on equipment. Despite its unsettling nature, the armor is highly effective and can be maintained with minimal logistics compared to metal or powered suits.
Spider Armor is the choice for those who want living, self-repairing protection and are willing to accept its distinctive nature and defensive bite.
Effects
-- Living arachnid layer that redistributes to cover gaps when some spiders are lost; provides resilient protection.
-- Acts as a cargo net, securing the wearer's items.
-- Spiders bite unauthorized persons who touch the wearer or their gear; bite causes moderate damage and an irritating itch.

armor.name: Spider Enhanced
armor.notes:
For an additional cost, larger warrior spiders can be purchased to upgrade Spider Armor. The enhanced swarm provides higher armor rating (20 AR). The bite of the larger spiders is more potent, causing greater damage to anyone who attempts to pilfer the wearer's belongings. These larger spiders can recognize the host's close associates and will not attack them if they judge the associate's intentions to be honorable.
Effects
-- Higher armor rating (20 AR) than standard Spider Armor.
-- More potent bite against unauthorized persons touching the wearer or their gear.
-- Enhanced spiders can remember and spare the host's trusted associates.

armor.name: Spider Enhanced (mso)
armor.notes: A fortified variant of Kryll spider armor comprised of larger, genetically bred warrior arachnids providing reinforced chitinous protection. These disciplined spiders possess heightened cognitive recognition, remembering the host’s designated allies and refraining from striking them so long as their intentions remain honorable.

armor.name: Spiked Armor
armor.notes: Spiked Armor is a fearsome defensive gear adorned with jagged, protruding spikes along its surface. Designed to deter close combat attacks, its intimidating appearance radiates menace, making the wearer a formidable opponent on the battlefield.

armor.name: Trooper Armor
armor.notes:
Trooper Armor is the standard personal armor for infantry across many forces. It consists of rigid plates over a micro-mesh body suit and includes a full-head helmet. It offers solid protection against small arms and fragments while remaining relatively light and mobile. One external hard point allows for mission-specific gear; integrated targeting computer, communicator kit, and oxygenator support sustained operations in atmosphere or in thin-air environments.
The suit's appearance is utilitarian and recognizable: plated torso and limbs, sealed helmet, and a balance of coverage and weight that allows the average trooper to march, fight, and operate for extended periods. It is the workhorse of conventional infantry.
Trooper Armor is the baseline infantry suit for general-purpose combat and patrol.
Effects
-- One external hard point, targeting computer, communicator kit, oxygenator kit (included).

armor.name: Trooper Armor (mso)
armor.notes: This is the standard personal armor used by infantry throughout Known Space. Consisting of plasteel plates over a micro mesh body suit, trooper armor also includes a full-head helmet. Standard systems (included free) are one external hard point, targeting computer, communicator kit, and oxygenator kit.

armor.name: Void Shroud
armor.notes:
Void Shroud Kit
Void Shroud is a set of enchanted robes that enhances the character's connection to the void, providing formidable protection against both physical and magical attacks. These robes, weighing only 10 pounds, are crafted from Void Weave Fabric, a mysterious blend of void-infused silk and arcane threads, creating a fabric that shimmers with a dark, otherworldly glow. This armor allows the character to move with exceptional mobility and cast spells with heightened efficiency.
When the character dons the Void Shroud, the robes seem to meld with the surrounding shadows, their colors shifting and swirling like the night sky—deep purples, blues, and star-speckled blacks. Intricate runes and sigils pulse with void energy, creating an ethereal aura that both mesmerizes and intimidates. The robes flutter silently with each movement, the fabric appearing to absorb light, rendering the character a ghostly, almost intangible figure on the battlefield. To enemies, the character is a spectral presence, seemingly at one with the void, their form constantly flickering at the edge of perception.
Void Shroud merges void magic with arcane craftsmanship, granting the character unparalleled protection and spellcasting power, enabling them to dominate any battlefield with their dark, otherworldly presence.
Effects
-- Enchanted robes that enhances the character’s connection to the void, providing protection against physical and magical attacks.

shields.name: Buckler Shield (mso)
shields.notes: A small shield intended for quick use and defense, a buckler provides minimal encumbrance and can easily be carried anywhere.

shields.name: Heater Shield
shields.notes:
The heater shield is a large, roughly triangular shield most commonly associated with knights and other archaic heavy troop types. It provides a moderate amount of protection across a broad front, covering the torso and upper leg when held in line, and is often used in formation or for mounted combat. Its flat or gently curved face can bear heraldry or unit markings.
Construction is typically a wooden or composite core with leather or metal facing, and a central arm-strap and grip. The shape balances coverage and weight, allowing the bearer to present a solid barrier while still moving and fighting. It is heavier and more cumbersome than a buckler but far more protective.
The heater shield is a classic choice for those who want substantial coverage without the bulk of a tower shield.
Effects
-- Often used in formation or with heavy armor.
-- May bear heraldry or markings.

shields.name: Heater Shield (mso)
shields.notes: This is a large, roughly triangular shield, most commonly associated with knights and other archaic troop types. It is relatively large, and provides a moderate amount of protection.

shields.name: Kite Shield
shields.notes: Long tapered shield, excellent for infantry formations.

shields.name: Power Shield
shields.notes:
The Power Shield is a physical shield enhanced with an ultralock assembly so it can be securely attached to the user's arm, leaving the hand free when needed. A charged ionic field around the shield disperses or attenuates energy-weapon hits, while a micro-repulsor field diverts or reduces the energy of kinetic attacks. The result is a hybrid defense that combines the reliability of a physical barrier with active countermeasures.
The shield can be carried in the hand or locked to the forearm, and its systems are powered by a compact cell. The surface is typically rigid and can be used for bashing or blocking in melee. It is favored by front-line troops who want both a physical shield and protection against directed energy.
The Power Shield bridges traditional shield use and modern defensive technology.
Effects
-- Ultralock assembly allows secure attachment to the arm.
-- Ionic field disperses or attenuates energy-weapon charges; micro-repulsor field reduces kinetic impact.
-- Can be used as a physical shield in melee.

shields.name: Power Shield (mso)
shields.notes: The power shield features an ultralock assembly which allows it to be attached to its user's arm. A charged ionic field surrounding the shield disperses charges from energy weapons, while a micro-repulser field diverts or reduces the energy of kinetic attacks.

shields.name: Round Shield
shields.notes: Mid-sized wooden shield, classic adventurer gear.

shields.name: Siege Wall Shield
shields.notes: Oversized heavy wood-and-iron shield, used in sieges.

shields.name: Tower Shield
shields.notes:
Tower shields are large, bulky, and relatively clumsy, rarely carried by modern mobile forces. On low-tech worlds and in historical warfare, they character used to form shield walls and to protect against massed archery and thrown weapons. A single bearer can shelter behind one while advancing or holding a position, trading mobility for maximum frontal coverage.
The shield is typically rectangular or oval, tall enough to cover most of the body, and heavy enough to resist sustained impacts. It is held with both hands or braced, and is best suited to static or slow advances rather than skirmishing. In the right context, it remains a formidable defensive tool.
The tower shield is the heaviest archaic shield option, favoring formation combat and siege roles.
Effects
-- Suited to shield walls and protection against ranged barrages.
-- Typically used in static or slow-advance tactics.

shields.name: Tower Shield (mso)
shields.notes: Large, bulky and clumsy, tower shields are rarely if ever carried by modern military forces. On low-tech worlds, and in past history, tower shields were used to form shield walls and to provide protection against enemy archery.

supplies.name: AegisColar
supplies.notes:
The AegisColar is a sophisticated piece of gear designed to provide instant access to protective armor with the simple press of a button. This half-collar, worn around the back of the neck, can store an entire set of armor by breaking it down into individual plates and storing them within the collar itself. When needed, the collar swiftly reassembles and deploys the armor over the wearer’s body, providing immediate protection. The process is efficient, though it does produce a slight noise as the plates are fitted together during the assembly and disassembly.
The AegisColar resembles the regal collars of ancient Egypt, but with a futuristic twist. Its sleek, metallic surface gleams with a polished sheen, catching the light as it rests subtly on the back of the neck. When activated, the collar emits a faint hum, and the stored armor begins to unfurl from within. Plates glide smoothly over the wearer’s body, forming a seamless protective layer. The entire process is a marvel of technology, as each plate locks into place with precision, creating a visual spectacle akin to watching an intricate puzzle assemble itself. The slight clinking of metal as the plates fit together adds to the sense of mechanical elegance, making the transformation feel both powerful and awe-inspiring.
Unleash the power of instant protection with the AegisColar, the ultimate fusion of ancient style and cutting-edge technology, ensuring you're always ready for battle at the press of a button.
Effects
\-- Half collar stores/returns armor at press of a button.
\-- Armor rolls out/in as plates via internal transporters.

supplies.name: AeroJet Thruster
supplies.notes:
The AeroJet Thruster is an advanced propulsion system worn as a backpack, designed specifically for atmospheric flight. Utilizing a combination of powerful turbofans and a minijet propulsion system, it enables the wearer to achieve vertical lift and horizontal movement. The pack is controlled through a pair of retractable arms equipped with joysticks, allowing for precise maneuverability in flight. However, its functionality is limited to environments with an atmosphere, rendering it ineffective in space. The pack is powered by Nova-Cores, providing up to one hour of continuous operation before needing to recharge. The Nova-Core recharges the pack at a rate of one minute of flight time for every ten minutes of downtime.
The AeroJet Thruster is a sleek and robust piece of equipment, with a design that exudes both power and efficiency. The backpack is crafted from lightweight, durable materials, its surface smooth and aerodynamic. When activated, the turbofans emit a low hum that gradually intensifies as the minijet engines ignite, propelling the user into the air. The retractable control arms extend smoothly, bringing the joysticks into the user’s hands, ready for immediate maneuvering. As the thruster lifts off, the sensation of acceleration is exhilarating, with the world below quickly shrinking as the user soars effortlessly through the sky. The soft glow of the Nova-Core, visible through a small panel on the pack, pulsates rhythmically, a visual testament to the advanced technology within.
With the AeroJet Thruster, take to the skies and leave the ground far behind—where your only limit is the horizon.
Effects
\-- Backpack with turbofans/minijet for atmospheric flight (useless in space).
\-- Lifts up to 100 ft/Rnd, horizontal MR(24).
\-- Retractable arms with joysticks for control.
\-- Operates 1 hr on Nova-Cores, recharges 1 min flight per 10 min.

supplies.name: Anti-Grav Harness
supplies.notes:
The Anti-Grav Harness is a sophisticated suspensor belt that provides unparalleled support and versatility for its wearer. This large metal ring, equipped with adjustable expansion slides, comfortably fits around the midsection of most beings. Once secured with eight inward-extending pins, the harness activates its anti-gravity field, allowing the user to hover effortlessly as they move. The harness has additional storage options provided by various hooks, fasteners, and compartments integrated into the belt’s design. Moreover, if the user’s armor is rigid, the harness can integrate directly with the armor. An articulated arm, which can mount a single heavy item like a cannon, extends from the belt and offers buoyant support, making even the heaviest weapons feel nearly weightless. The arm’s internal technology ensures that the user’s balance remains stable, despite the additional load. However, the harness does impose a movement restriction.
Visually, the Anti-Grav Harness is an impressive piece of engineering, its robust metal ring gleaming with a polished finish. The belt’s structure is both functional and aesthetically pleasing, with its sleek design and compact form. When activated, the harness emits a faint, barely audible hum, creating a sense of quiet power. The eight pins, which secure the belt to the user, extend smoothly and lock into place with a satisfying click. The articulated arm, with its highly maneuverable joints, is a marvel to behold, moving effortlessly in response to the wearer’s commands. Whether suspending a heavy weapon or simply hovering alongside the user, the harness exudes an air of effortless control, making it an indispensable tool for those who require both mobility and heavy-duty support.
Elevate your combat readiness with the Anti-Grav Harness, the ultimate solution for carrying heavy loads without breaking a sweat, ensuring you're always prepared for whatever the battlefield throws your way.
Effects
\-- Suspensor belt, activates anti-gravity field to support X Enc
\-- Includes articulated arm, mounts single item up to additional Y Enc (e.g., heavy weapon).
\-- Arm-mount item has no Enc, provides buoyant support, compensates balance.

supplies.name: Cyber X-Ray Eye
supplies.notes:
The Cyber X-Ray Eye is an advanced cybernetic implant designed to enhance an existing cyber eye, providing the user with the ability to see through various layers of material. This implant allows the user to penetrate surfaces, revealing hidden objects, spaces or things behind them. The depth of vision depends on the material’s density, with greater clarity through lighter substances such as cloth or thin walls, and more resistance when attempting to see through denser materials like stone or metal. This implant is particularly valuable for reconnaissance, security, and tactical operations, offering the wearer a significant advantage in environments where unseen obstacles or threats may lurk.
Visually, the Cyber X-Ray Eye is a marvel of sleek, futuristic design, seamlessly integrated with the user’s existing cyber eye. When activated, the eye emits a faint, bluish glow that intensifies as the X-ray vision engages, casting a subtle light across the surface being scanned. The surrounding area may appear slightly distorted, as if the air itself is rippling in response to the eye’s penetrating gaze. As the user focuses, the glow sharpens into a precise beam, illuminating hidden details beneath layers of material. The experience of using the Cyber X-Ray Eye is akin to peeling back the layers of reality, revealing a hidden world that exists just out of sight. The sensation is both thrilling and empowering, giving the user a sense of omniscience as they uncover secrets that would otherwise remain concealed.
Unlock the unseen with the Cyber X-Ray Eye, and gain the power to see beyond the surface, revealing hidden truths and gaining the ultimate advantage in any situation.
Effects
\-- Cyber implant requiring existing cyber eye.
\-- X-ray vision with Sk() open-ended roll based on material density

supplies.name: Cyber-Legs, Speed
supplies.notes:
Cyber-Legs, Speed are a cutting-edge full-leg replacement designed for individuals seeking enhanced mobility and speed. These cybernetic limbs replace both legs entirely, including necessary reinforcements to the pelvic area to handle the increased weight and torque generated by the advanced mechanics. Constructed with a metal alloy core wrapped in a durable vulcanized rubber exterior, these legs are built to endure extreme conditions, including the heat from soft molten metal. The internal servos operate with remarkable quietness, ensuring smooth and efficient movement. Designed for speed, these cyber-legs significantly boost the wearer’s movement rate and agility, making them an ideal choice for those who require quick and nimble responses in high-stakes environments.
The visual design of the Cyber-Legs, Speed is both sleek and robust, exuding a sense of raw power combined with high-tech elegance. The metal alloy core gleams beneath the matte, textured finish of the vulcanized rubber, giving the legs a rugged yet polished appearance. The feet are equipped with specialized tracks and retractable claws, providing superior grip on various surfaces, from slick urban streets to soft, uneven terrain. When in motion, the legs exhibit a fluid, almost graceful movement, with the servos operating so silently that they seem to glide effortlessly. The enhanced leap and jump capabilities add a dynamic edge, allowing the user to vault over obstacles with ease. The overall effect is one of relentless precision and strength, as these cyber-legs transform the wearer into a veritable force of nature.
Elevate your performance with Cyber-Legs, Speed, where every step is a leap towards unparalleled agility and power, ensuring you outpace and outmaneuver anything that stands in your way.
Effects
\-- Full leg replacement for speed and agility; metal alloy core, vulcanized rubber exterior.
\-- Feet have tracks/claws for grip or soft surfaces.
\-- Permanent AR bonuses apply

supplies.name: Cyber-Legs, Strength
supplies.notes:
The Cyber-Legs, Strength model is a powerful full-leg replacement designed for those who require enhanced strength and durability. These cybernetic limbs replace both legs entirely, incorporating enhancements to the pelvic area to support the increased weight and torque generated by their advanced mechanics. With a metal alloy core encased in a durable vulcanized rubber exterior, these legs are built to endure the harshest conditions, including exposure to soft molten metal. The internal servos are engineered to operate with near-silent efficiency, providing seamless and powerful movement. These cyber-legs significantly boost the wearer’s leg strength, allowing for immense power in activities such as shoulder lifts and leg presses, as well as delivering devastating kicks. However, the added bulk of these legs imposes a limit on the wearer’s movement rate, ensuring that the trade-off between strength and speed is carefully balanced.
Visually, the Cyber-Legs, Strength model is a striking fusion of industrial might and cutting-edge technology. The metal alloy core is visible beneath the rugged vulcanized rubber, giving the legs a formidable and imposing appearance. The legs are bulkier than other models, with a design that emphasizes power over agility. The reinforced joints and pistons are built to withstand immense pressure, and the overall construction exudes an aura of unyielding strength. When in use, the legs move with a deliberate, controlled force, each step resonating with the power of an unstoppable machine. The sound of the servos is barely perceptible, adding to the impression of effortless strength. The wearer’s kicks and movements carry an undeniable weight, making it clear that these legs are designed for those who need to overpower their surroundings with sheer force.
Harness the raw power of Cyber-Legs, Strength, and experience a level of physical dominance that will leave your foes trembling, as you crush obstacles and opponents alike with every step.
Effects
\-- Full leg replacement for strength and power; metal alloy core, vulcanized rubber exterior.

supplies.name: CyberGuards
supplies.notes:
CyberGuards are a revolutionary cybernetic implant designed to enhance the body's natural defense against blunt force trauma. These implants consist of thousands of nail-shaped shock absorbers that are meticulously embedded beneath the skin and anchored to the underlying bone structure. By distributing the impact of blunt forces more effectively than tissue alone, CyberGuards significantly reduce the damage from crushing, falling, or any blunt weapon strikes. The result is a system where the user might only experience a series of round, circular bruises instead of severe injuries. When combined with SteelOsteal enhancements, the protective benefits are amplified even further, making the wearer incredibly resilient to blunt trauma.
Visually, the presence of CyberGuards is almost undetectable, as the implants are discreetly hidden beneath the skin. However, upon closer inspection or under certain lighting, a subtle pattern of faintly raised circles might be visible, hinting at the advanced technology beneath. The skin over these areas feels slightly firmer to the touch, a testament to the shock absorbers working beneath the surface. During an impact, there is a noticeable dampening effect, as if the force is being absorbed and dispersed by an invisible shield. This gives the user a sense of invulnerability, as they withstand blows that would incapacitate an ordinary person. The combination of advanced materials and precise engineering results in a seamless integration that enhances both the durability and functionality of the user's body.
Equip yourself with CyberGuards and turn every hit into a mere bruise, ensuring that no amount of blunt force can slow you down as you stand strong against the harshest of impacts.
Effects
\-- Cyber implant of shock absorbers under the skin.

supplies.name: D-Carbine
supplies.notes:
The D-Carbine is an advanced weapon utilizing dimensional technology to fire unpredictable transformative projectiles. Similar in design to a standard Blaster Carbine, it fires two-inch dimensional spheres that transform after traveling two squares into random objects or entities.
Effects
-- Carbine shoots dimensional balls that transform after 2 squares.
-- Ball types randomly determined per shot:
  1 Rubble: 1sq, Dmg 20, knockdown (💪^💪).
  2 Steel beam: 2sq swath, Dmg 10, knockdown (💪^💪) and pushed back.
  3 Ice Cubes: 2 dozen cubes, cosmetic impact (no significant Dmg).
  4 Burning logs: Dmg 25, knockdown (💪^💪), ignites flammables as a burn hazard.
  5 Nest of snakes/insects: AoE 1r, Dmg 10 at start of each Nish.
  6 Combat Mech: Fights for Encounter, then self-destructs (AoE 1r, Dmg 20; stats: MR 8, Vit 50, Atk/Dmg 20, Def/AR 10).

supplies.name: D-Shifter
supplies.notes:
The D-Shifter is an enigmatic and powerful artifact, believed to be a relic of the ancient and long-vanished Shinto race. This device grants its user the extraordinary ability to phase in and out of existence, effectively slipping into an alternate plane of reality. While active, the user remains on the battlefield, visible and vulnerable to observation and attack, but only until their initiative moment, or Nish. At this precise moment, the user can take any actions they desire, such as moving or attacking. Immediately after, they vanish, becoming completely untouchable and immune to all forms of attack for the remainder of the round. The D-Shifter’s power makes its wielder a formidable force in combat, particularly for those with a high initiative, as it allows them to strike and then disappear, avoiding any retaliation.
The D-Shifter itself is a small, intricately designed artifact, with an otherworldly aesthetic that hints at its alien origins. Its surface is covered in faintly glowing symbols and patterns that pulse with a soft, ethereal light. When activated, these symbols light up in a sequence, and a faint shimmer surrounds the user, indicating the activation of the phasing mechanism. As the user phases out, the shimmer intensifies, and they seem to dissolve into the air, leaving behind only a ripple in the fabric of reality. The transition is smooth and almost mesmerizing, as if the user is being gently pulled into another dimension. The D-Shifter’s presence on the battlefield is both subtle and ominous, as enemies know that once the user vanishes, they are beyond reach, only to return at the most opportune moment.
Harness the ancient power of the D-Shifter, and turn the tide of battle in your favor by becoming an untouchable phantom, striking with precision and disappearing without a trace.
Effects
\-- Ancient alien artifact; phases user in/out of existence.
\-- User is present until Nish; then vanishes for rest of Rnd (no longer in or aware of this dimension).
\-- Reappears next Rnd, rolls Nish, and repeats

supplies.name: D-Sizer
supplies.notes:
The D-Sizer is an ingenious and versatile set of disks that allows the user to manipulate the size of metal objects, reducing them to a fraction of their original dimensions while maintaining full functionality. The set includes two disks: one that bonds to the user and another that attaches to a metal item, such as a weapon or device no larger than Destron armor. With the D-Sizer, the user can shrink the bonded item down to the size of a chess pawn, drastically reducing its and weight to just a few ounces. This makes the D-Sizer an invaluable tool for smuggling large weapons or carrying bulky equipment without the usual physical burden. The disk worn by the user controls the size transformation, allowing for precise adjustments to any percentage of the original size. While the D-Sizer offers incredible convenience, expanding an item within a confined space comes with risks, as it can potentially damage weaker materials.
The D-Sizer disks are small, sleek, and unobtrusive, designed to be easily concealed on the user's person or attached discreetly to an object. The disks have a matte finish with a subtle metallic sheen, and their surface is engraved with intricate, almost alien-looking patterns that seem to shimmer faintly in the light. When activated, the disk on the user emits a soft, pulsing glow that mirrors the glow on the bonded item, signaling the connection between the two. The process of shrinking or expanding an item is visually captivating: the object seems to fold in on itself, gradually compressing or expanding with an almost liquid grace. The sensation of holding a once-massive weapon reduced to a mere pawn-sized piece is both surreal and empowering, offering the user a unique blend of stealth and strength.
Transform your gear with the D-Sizer, and carry the power of a full arsenal in the palm of your hand, ready to expand to its full potential when you need it most.
Effects
\-- Set of disks; one Q-Bonds to user, other to metal item of Armor Suit or less.
\-- Shrinks target to any degree, down to chess-pawn size.
\-- Enc becomes \*; weight reduced to a few ounces.
\-- Controls shrink/return; any % of full size possible.
\-- Expanding in a confined area: Sk()^; may damage weak items.

supplies.name: D-Walker
supplies.notes:
The D-Walker is a highly advanced dimensional transporter that allows the user to shift into another dimension, effectively removing themselves from the current plane of existence. While in this alternate dimension, the user is completely isolated from all sensory input—unable to see, hear, or sense anything around them. Despite this sensory deprivation, the user retains the ability to move freely in any horizontal direction. When the D-Walker is deactivated, the user reappears in their original dimension at a location corresponding to their movements while shifted. This device is invaluable for covert operations, allowing the user to walk through walls, escape dangerous situations, or even travel through the vacuum of space between ships. However, the D-Walker must be used with caution, as the user risks re-materializing inside solid objects, a perilous consequence determined by the Game Master based on the player’s verbal instructions.
The D-Walker itself is a sleek, compact device, small enough to be worn discreetly on the body. Its design is minimalist, with a smooth, dark surface that seems to absorb light, giving it an almost ominous presence. When activated, the device emits a faint hum, and the user’s form begins to shimmer and blur before vanishing entirely from the visible spectrum. The experience of using the D-Walker is disorienting yet exhilarating, as the user feels the strange sensation of moving through a void, untethered to the physical world. The moment of re-materialization is equally intense, as the user suddenly snaps back into reality, with their surroundings shifting into focus as if emerging from a dream. The D-Walker’s power and potential make it a formidable tool, but one that requires precise control and careful planning.
Step into the unknown with the D-Walker, where the boundaries of reality are yours to transcend, offering unparalleled freedom and escape when you need it most.
Effects
\-- Shifts user to another dimension; no sense perception during shift.
\-- Move in any horizontal direction while shifted.
\-- Reappears in own dimension as if movement occurred there.
\-- GM determines re-materialization location based only on Player’s verbal direction/distance description
\-- Risk of materializing in solid objects (GM discretion).

supplies.name: Decohesion Gun
supplies.notes:
The Decohesion Gun is a specialized energy weapon designed for precise and relentless elimination of high-armor, high-vitality targets. Unlike standard blaster carbines, the Decohesion Gun operates by firing a continuous stream of energy at a single target, requiring the wielder to maintain aim until the accumulated damage surpasses the target’s armor and vitality. Once this threshold is breached, the target undergoes a catastrophic mini implosion, effectively disintegrating in a gruesome spectacle reminiscent of a bug splatting against a windshield. This weapon is particularly effective against heavily armored foes, allowing for a tactical approach that gradually wears down even the toughest defenses. However, if the target manages to evade the beam or move out of range, the entire process must be restarted.
The Decohesion Gun features a distinctive design, with its most notable characteristic being the small radio dish-like tip at the end of the barrel. This dish gives the weapon a deceptively benign appearance, almost resembling a scanning or listening device rather than a deadly weapon. The gun’s body is sleek and angular, with a matte black finish that absorbs light, adding to its stealthy nature. When fired, the Decohesion Gun emits a high-pitched whine, accompanied by a faint, jittery sensation that can be felt by the user and the target alike. Despite these minor sensory cues, the target remains largely unaware of the impending danger until the moment of implosion, making the Decohesion Gun a preferred tool for stealthy assassinations or tactical eliminations in the heat of battle.
Unleash the Decohesion Gun, the ultimate weapon for those who seek to dismantle their enemies with precision and subtlety, leaving nothing but a splattered memory in their wake.
Effects
\-- A carbine that cannot multi-atk, but continuous attack on 1 target until total Dmg \> target's AR+Vit.
\-- Causes mini implosion, "splatting" the target.
\-- Once hit, auto-hits (if target in Rng and LoS) just Dmg() each Rnd
\-- Target suffers no discomfort until implosion.
\-- Useful as stealth weapon.

supplies.name: Ghost Mine
supplies.notes:
The Ghost Mine is a deceptively simple yet incredibly effective device designed to turn any explosive into a deadly, cloaked trap. Despite its name, the Ghost Mine is not a mine in the traditional sense; instead, it is a small, button-like disc, only half an inch high and an inch in diameter. When attached to an explosive—be it a mine, grenade, plastic charge, or even a missile—the Ghost Mine cloaks the explosive with advanced stealth technology, rendering it invisible to the naked eye. This cloaking effect can conceal explosives up to the size of a six-foot missile, making it nearly impossible for enemies to detect. The Ghost Mine also projects a thin, invisible beam from its center, extending ten feet outward. Any motion that crosses this beam triggers the explosive, making it a perfect tool for setting up undetectable traps in strategic locations.
Visually, the Ghost Mine is a small, unassuming disc, matte black with a subtle, metallic sheen that hints at its advanced internal technology. Its compact size belies its deadly purpose, allowing it to be easily concealed or attached to a wide range of explosives. When activated, the cloaking mechanism engages without a sound, making the explosive it’s attached to vanish from sight as if swallowed by the shadows. The invisible beam that extends from the Ghost Mine’s center is imperceptible to the naked eye, but its presence is a constant, silent threat, waiting for the slightest movement to unleash its destructive power. The Ghost Mine’s design is minimalist and efficient, with every element optimized for stealth and lethality.
Turn any explosive into an undetectable death trap with the Ghost Mine, where even the most vigilant enemies won't see their end coming until it's too late.
Effects
\-- Small disc cloaks attached explosive (up to 6 ft missile) at Sk()^Awa;; comes in tubes of 5 discs.
\-- Projects invisible beam; triggers explosive on motion detection.
\-- Can activate nearly any tech-based explosive; pulls pins/arms bombs etc.
\-- Typically destroyed in explosion

Works for 1 hour before losing charge, self recharges in 1 hour. Useful for firing energy weapons out while being protected from low-tech kinetic projectiles.

supplies.name: GravLift
supplies.notes:
The GravLift is an innovative attachment designed to significantly enhance the handling and performance of a weapon by reducing its weight and improving its maneuverability. This device consists of two thumb-sized cylinders that can be discreetly inserted into the stock of a weapon or attached to its side. Once activated, the GravLift’s micro pumps create a near-perfect vacuum within the cylinders, causing them to expand like balloons and generate a counteracting force that brings the weapon to true buoyancy. The onboard microcomputers continuously adjust for environmental factors and altitude, ensuring optimal performance in any situation. The result is a weapon that feels lighter, draws faster, and boasts an impressive increase in range, making it an invaluable tool for those who require precision and speed in combat.
Visually, the GravLift is a marvel of miniaturization and high-tech engineering. The cylinders are sleek and compact, with a matte finish that blends seamlessly with the weapon’s design. When activated, a faint hum can be heard as the micro pumps go to work, and the cylinders subtly expand, giving the weapon a slight, almost imperceptible lift. The effect is immediate and dramatic: the weapon becomes easier to handle, with a noticeable reduction in weight that belies its true size. The enhanced draw speed and extended range are evident in the smooth, effortless motion of the weapon, as if it’s been perfectly balanced for optimal performance. The GravLift’s combination of subtlety and power makes it an essential upgrade for any serious combatant looking to gain an edge in the field.
Elevate your arsenal with the GravLift, and experience the perfect blend of agility and power, turning even the heaviest weapon into a feather-light precision instrument.
Effects
\-- Two thumb-sized anti-grav cylinders for weapon attachment.

supplies.name: GyroLock
supplies.notes:
The GyroLock is a precision stabilizer designed exclusively for rifles and cannons, offering unparalleled targeting accuracy by leveraging advanced gyroscopic technology. This small but powerful device clamps securely onto both sides of the weapon, providing a stabilizing force that dramatically improves aim after an initial adjustment period. When first activated, the GyroLock exerts a strong gyroscopic force that makes it difficult to move the weapon, resulting in an attack penalty as the user struggles to align with the desired target. However, after the first round, the stabilizer’s onboard computer takes over, locking onto the target and continuously tracking it as long as the target’s movement rate remains within specified limits. With each subsequent round that the user maintains focus on the same target, the GyroLock provides a cumulative aiming bonus, making it a formidable tool for snipers and heavy gunners who require precision and consistency in their shots.
Visually, the GyroLock is a sleek, compact unit that blends seamlessly with the weapon it’s attached to. Its dual arms are robust and well-engineered, clamping onto the weapon with a firm yet unobtrusive grip. When activated, the stabilizer hums with barely audible energy as the gyroscopic force comes into play, making the weapon feel momentarily resistant to movement. The sensation is like trying to twist an object suspended in a thick fluid—slow, deliberate, and requiring focused effort. Once the GyroLock’s computer locks onto a target, the weapon becomes almost an extension of the user’s will, smoothly tracking the target’s movements with precision. The longer the target is tracked, the steadier the weapon becomes, allowing for increasingly accurate shots. This gradual build-up of precision creates a sense of growing confidence in the user, as each round makes the target seem more and more within their grasp.
Take your marksmanship to the next level with the GyroLock, turning every shot into a calculated strike, where patience and precision are rewarded with deadly accuracy.
Effects
\-- Stabilizer for Rifles and Cannons; clamps to both sides of the weapon.
\-- Atk(-10) penalty 1st Rnd as weapon adjusts to gyroscopic force, may choose to not roll on 1st Rnd (e.g. avoid risking stealth shot failure).
\-- After 1st Rnd, locks on and tracks targets of MR(10) or less.
\-- Provides cumulative Atk bonus per Rnd on same target
\-- Bonus lost if target is lost, behind cover, moves \> MR10, or new target selected.

supplies.name: Gyroscopic Stabilizer (mso)
supplies.notes: Clamps onto rifles and cannons to dampen recoil and stabilize tracking. Imposes a -10 penalty on the first turn of aiming. Afterward, the targeting computer locks onto the target (if target 👣 is 10 or less) and provides a cumulative aiming bonus of +2 per turn of consecutive attack against the same target, up to a maximum of +10. Resets if cover is used or target switches.

supplies.name: Hand-D
supplies.notes:
The Hand-D is a palm band housing a micro-transporter that stores and retrieves a single non-living object instantaneously. With a simple palm press, the object vanishes into digital storage (reducing carried weight to zero); pressing retrieve rematerializes the item instantly in the user's grasp, enabling effortless weapon draws and gear swaps that appear as advanced magic.

supplies.name: Higgs Band
supplies.notes:
The Higgs Band, a seemingly simple and unassuming device, is actually a highly advanced piece of technology designed to create a localized gravitational anomaly. Resembling a traditional oriental fan made of gray gauze, the Higgs Band measures about two feet long in its dormant state. When deployed, the fan telescopes to five feet in length and unfolds into a doughnut-shaped structure with a one-square center, extending outward to cover the surrounding area. Once activated, the band generates an incredibly strong gravitational field that exerts a force on any physical object that passes over it. This force is so intense that arrows, bullets, rocks, and even melee weapons are pulled straight down to its surface, rendering them harmless unless they can overcome the massive strength requirement. The gravitational pull does not follow conventional physics; instead of curving objects downwards, it forces them to drop vertically, regardless of their initial trajectory.
The Higgs Band is visually striking in its simplicity. When folded, it looks like a delicate, paper-thin fan, but upon activation, it transforms into a formidable gravitational trap. The material, though thin as paper, is incredibly resilient, capable of withstanding the weight of anything that might walk or fall onto it. The surface of the band, once activated, shimmers subtly as it manipulates the gravitational field, creating an almost imperceptible distortion in the air above it. Objects caught in its influence drop abruptly and unnaturally, as if yanked by an invisible force. The effect is both eerie and awe-inspiring, making it clear that the Higgs Band is a tool of extraordinary power, designed to neutralize physical threats with ruthless efficiency while leaving the user free to attack with energy-based weapons.
Seize control of the battlefield with the Higgs Band, where gravity itself becomes your ally, pulling down enemy attacks and leaving your foes defenseless against your superior firepower.
Effects
\-- Telescopes to 5 ft, unfolds into a doughnut shape with 1sq center and generates a strong gravitational field
\-- Str()^Str to pull physical objects above it to the ground.
\-- Str()^Atk required to pull down arrows, bullets, etc.
\-- Items pulled drop straight down, ignoring horizontal speed.
\-- No inherent Dmg; but traps opponents, leaving them vulnerable to energy attacks.

Capturing active or secured targets requires an 👁️+4^20 capture check. Releases objects only onto stable horizontal surfaces of appropriate size. May store one object per hour, and retrieve anytime.
