supplies.name: Beetle Bomb (mso)
supplies.notes: Range: Short. These Biotech items resemble multi-legged beetles with large gas-filled sacs immediately beneath their wing-cases. When directed, beetle bombs (often called bomber beetles or just bombers) will scurry (👣 8) into an area and release their air sacs in an explosion of noxious gas functioning like a gas grenade. Once their raid is complete, beetles attempt to scamper back to the safety of their host. It takes a full day for the bomber to regenerate its gas sac. Beetle bombs are able to fulfill moderately complex pheromonal orders.

supplies.name: Death Eggs (mso)
supplies.notes: Range: Short (5 sq) or shot via Egg Spitter. A fragile organic egg sac containing a small burrowing crustacean called a bormaul. Normally tough and leathery, the egg sac grows fragile when launched and shatters on impact. The released bormaul seeks out the nearest non-Kryll lifeform, chewing beneath armor to feast on the target while bypassing most forms of armor.

supplies.name: Bionocular (mso)
supplies.notes: When a bionocular is activated, it slides itself up the back of its host’s neck onto the head. It then slaps flap-like appendages over the host’s eyes. Bonded to the eyes themselves, the bionocular now sends images to its host. Bionoculars can rotate their eyestalks in any direction, magnifying images up to 500:1. When the host completes its visual scan, the bionocular pulls its appendages off with a slurping pop and slithers back off the host’s head.

supplies.name: Breather (mso)
supplies.notes: Breathers are squid-like organisms which ride around on their host’s neck or other location near the mouth. When the need arises, the breather will quickly wrap its long radial appendages around the host’s head, sealing itself over the host’s mouth. The breather then absorbs the atmosphere about the host, filtering out harmful particulates and gasses (d100), and exhaling clean air into the host’s mouth. When the host exhales, the breather’s internal valves close and the used air exits with a flapping, wheezing sound from either side of the breather’s body. Breathers will function underwater, acting as a sort of artificial aqua-lung.

supplies.name: Choking Poison Vial (mso)
supplies.notes: Synthesized Calamorian asphyxiation neurotoxin that severely constricts airways and vocal cords.

supplies.name: Corrosive Poison Vial (mso)
supplies.notes: Flesh-melting Kryllian acid enzyme that rapidly eats through armor and living tissue.

supplies.name: Death Poison Vial (mso)
supplies.notes: Extremely lethal Sea Zimil cardiac neurotoxin causing acute heart failure upon intravenous introduction.

supplies.name: Feeder (mso)
supplies.notes: These creatures look like large, bloated, vein-covered balloons, with two long tube-like appendages. The more slender appendage winds its way up the hosts back, neck, and into one side of the host’s mouth, where it extends most of the way down the host’s throat. The other appendage is thicker, tougher, and can reach to the ground. It ends in a concentric mouth filled with numerous serrated teeth. Feeders are essentially an external stomach. The toothed appendage constantly sweeps over the host’s body, eating dead cells, dirt, waste, etc., as well as whatever the host offers it. Feeders eat nearly anything. They process their intake, spewing out whatever is non-nutritious, and routing the rest up the other appendage where a nutrient slime constantly trickles down the host’s throat, thus supplying the host with all of its nutrient and hydration needs. Feeders function only when there is sufficient organic material to process. In a vacuum, or on a dead, rocklike world, feeders act at greatly reduced efficiency, or do not function at all.

supplies.name: Firegnat Colony (mso)
supplies.notes: As soon as a firegnat colony is introduced to its host, it builds a wasp-like hive upon the host’s body. Most of the time, these nearly microscopic flies remain in the hive, coming out only to eat. However, when the host summons the colony, 800-1000 firegnats swarm out, activating bioluminescent chemicals in their abdomens. Together, the gnats can light up an area of 10 squares by 10 squares 10' high. Firegnats fly at 👣 10, and may illuminate any shape the host desires, so long as the area remains the same. They can also dim or extinguish upon command. The colony is able to keep an area lit endlessly as individual gnats fly out in shifts, while others return to rejuvenation their illumination abilities.

supplies.name: Glow Egg (mso)
supplies.notes: Glow eggs are actually not eggs, rather the dormant seeds of the glow plant. When an “egg” is sharply struck, it emits a radiant glow, illuminating a radius of six squares for 20 hours (after which it becomes useless). The light is intended for the mother plant to aid in photosynthesis, but is a highly efficient artificial light source.

supplies.name: Knockout Poison Vial (mso)
supplies.notes: Rapid-acting tactical sedative inducing immediate unconsciousness upon contact with the bloodstream.

supplies.name: Laughing Poison Vial (mso)
supplies.notes: Aerosolized euphoric agent that overwhelms the nervous system with uncontrollable hysterical laughter.

supplies.name: Lift Pods (mso)
supplies.notes: Symbiotic pseudo-sentient plant bowls that balance host weight and shoot adhesive runners up to 10 sq (50 ft). Pods reel in runners with a reeling strength of 💪10 (carrying up to 200 lbs per pod) to lift the host into the air (👣 3). Pods suspend host indefinitely or lower them down on command. As a weapon, runners make a d4 attack; each runner has d4 AR and 6 Vit.

supplies.name: Living Rope (mso)
supplies.notes: This semi-sentient plant can slither along surfaces (👣 3 or 15' per round), tie and untie itself, and secrete a sticky substance strong enough to hold 1000 lbs. Living Rope can be cut into smaller sections which will grow back together in a day’s time, if the ends are spliced.

supplies.name: Paralysis Poison Vial (mso)
supplies.notes: Potent Joc-Tun neuro-blocker that immobilizes motor neurons while leaving cognitive senses fully intact.

supplies.name: Platelets (mso)
supplies.notes: These tiny disk shaped mites spend most of their time in a state of hibernation inside the bud of the bloodwood plant. Bloodwood buds are implanted in the flesh of the host creature, where they draw minimal nutrition from the host itself. The platelets remain in hibernation until the bud opens, which only occurs when the host’s blood pressure drops dangerously low (such as when the host is suffering Vitality drain). When this happens, the bud opens and the platelets scurry across the host’s body to seal any open wounds. The platelets secrete a clotting agent and even use their own bodies to form fibrous chains across the wound. The net effect is that all effects of Vitality Drain will stop after one round. Once the bud opens, it is necessary to transplant the bloodwood blossom onto any available slain victim so the plant may complete its growth cycle. If kept upon the host, the plant’s root system will spread throughout the host’s body, causing death within d4 hours.

supplies.name: Saliva Mites (mso)
supplies.notes: Saliva mites are of the same genus as platelets. When purchased, they come in the form of a worm which spins a cocoon upon the host's body and fills it with mite eggs. This dome shaped cocoon is about two inches in diameter and slightly recessed into the host’s body. The mites can live within their cocoon for nearly a month, before hatching out on their own. However, they are fully developed after just a week's time and if the cocoon is torn open, the mites will function as if they naturally hatched. Either way, the mites quickly spread over the host’s body to repair tissue, eat dead flesh, and secrete a special saliva containing healing agents and helpful bacteria, resulting in d6 healing to the host. About a month later, the mites emerge through the host’s pores as small worms and eat each other until only one remains. They are soft and fall off during combat, meaning they rarely survive long enough to spin a new cocoon.

supplies.name: Sleep Poison Vial (mso)
supplies.notes: Synthesized Setchie narcotic inducing profound lethargic slumber.

supplies.name: Slimemold (mso)
supplies.notes: These items are a combination of several types of fungi. When first purchased slime-molds look like white jelly with green spots, which is coated onto the host in the desired area. Once applied, the slime-mold matures in about three days. The final product is a gelatinous layer about half an inch thick with two inch thick, fuzzy gripper-mold growing over its surface, along with three to five long tendrils (extending out to a foot and a half). Designed to hold items fast to the host. The mold’s holding power is equal to d10 strength and can be pheremonally commanded to hold and release items at will. Slime-mold is very soft to the touch and quite durable, however items held with it become permanently tainted with the smell of slime-mold.

supplies.name: TechMites (mso)
supplies.notes: Regulated flesh-and-circuit eating micromites contained in a bottle worm. When released, swarm moves 👣 1, devouring circuits, sensors, and alloys. Causes malfunction in electronic equipment on an eating roll of d6 exceeding device tier.

supplies.name: Tube-Worms (mso)
supplies.notes: Tube-worms are foot-long, hollow tube-like animals. These organisms are almost exclusively made up of muscle tissue, tendons and sinew. When a host places a hand, foot or other appendage within the tube-worm, it begins to crawl slowly up the host’s limb. When the tube-worm reaches the equivalent of an elbow or knee joint, it stops and centers itself over the joint in a sheath-like fashion. Any time the host moves the joint, the tube-worm flexes its body to assist, resulting in a +2 Str to that joint.

supplies.name: Communicator Comm1 (mso)
supplies.notes: The Company Comm1 unit is the standard communication device throughout Known Space. The unit includes a small output screen, video input, alphanumeric keypad, internal antenna, speaker/microphone, and a reactive band which wraps around and firmly holds onto anything upon which it is placed. The Comm1 has a range of approximately 200 miles, and is capable of communicating with space vessels in low orbit. The unit’s E/M dial is able to scan most of the electro-magnetic spectrum and up to 16 channels may be preprogrammed. Comm1s contain a security port able to accept encoding/decoding algorithms, making secure transmissions possible, provided the receiving unit contains the same algorithm. Communication may be in one of three modes — text, audio, or audio-visual. The most flexible feature of the Comm1 is its transceiver settings. Through frequency banding, a Comm1 may be set to “Open” or “Selective” channel. “Open” channel means communications may be sent to or received from anyone using the channel. “Selective” channel allows communication with a specified group of individuals. Finally, the built-in microcomputer allows verbal operation of all functions.

supplies.name: Audial Transceiver (mso)
supplies.notes: During this operation, one of the patient’s external ears (or tympanic membranes) is cosmetically replaced with a plasteel look alike. The new tympanic membrane acts like an amplification dish to boost transceiver signals. A micro transceiver is surgically implanted into the base of the ear just outside the eardrum. A microphone is also installed into the patient’s cranium. The transceiver works like a mentally controlled comm unit. Incoming messages are barely audible to bystanders (Dif 20) as the speaker is located next to the ear drum. If implanted with an enhanced ear, bystanders cannot hear anything, as incoming messages are electronically piped directly into the circuitry of the enhanced ear.

supplies.name: Cyber-Arm (mso)
supplies.notes: Complete bionic replacement of one arm with reinforced shoulder bracing to withstand high stress and weight. Internal alloy core is covered in durable vulcanized rubber (withstands molten metal temperatures). Whisper-quiet servos provide +3 on arm/hand checks (+1 melee/unarmed Dmg) and Advantage on joint locks against compression. Alloy frame is virtually indestructible against crushing (resisting impacts up to 💪+5 force).

supplies.name: Cyber-Eye
supplies.notes: Implanted during a very delicate operation in which one eye and eyelid are removed. In their place, a sophisticated visual lens is embedded into the eye socket. Entire implant is mentally controlled. Aperture reacts instantly to light intensity, adjusting to dim light or bright daylight. Binocular depth perception maintained. Internal transmitter to optic nerve can be shut down at will to induce blindness. Structure is airtight, functional in a vacuum, and underwater. Electrochemical charges keep lens surface clean (never blinks; immune to tear gas, smoke, extreme heat). Built-in filter screens out damaging light (can stare at a star or tech wand arc without harm). Accepts modular cyber-eye enhancements.

supplies.name: Cyber-Eye (mso)
supplies.notes: Implanted during a very delicate operation in which one eye and eyelid are removed. In their place, a sophisticated visual lens is embedded into the eye socket. Entirely mentally controlled. Aperture reacts to light intensity extremely fast (instantly adjusts to dim light or bright daylight). Processes vision binocularly (depth perception maintained). Optic nerve transmitter can be shut down (voluntary blindness). Airtight, fully functional in vacuum/water. Surface kept clean with electrochemical charges (never blinks). Filters automatically screen out damaging light. Eye can be upgraded with Infrared (+125 cr), Macro Enhancer (+125 cr), Micro Enhancer (+110 cr), Starlight (+100 cr), and Star Lamp (+25 cr).

supplies.name: Cyber-Legs (Speed Version) (mso)
supplies.notes: Complete bionic replacement of both legs including pelvic reinforcement. Metal alloy core covered in durable vulcanized rubber (withstands molten metal temperatures). Internal servos operate silently; no cyber armor may be worn over cyber-legs. Vulcanized alloy structure is virtually indestructible (resisting crushing forces up to 💪+5). Speed version provides +3 to 👣, tracked sole pads for traction, climbing claws for soft surfaces, and leaps/jumps made at +3.

supplies.name: Cyber-Legs (Strength Version) (mso)
supplies.notes: Complete bionic replacement of both legs including pelvic reinforcement. Metal alloy core covered in durable vulcanized rubber. Internal servos operate silently; no cyber armor may be worn over cyber-legs. Vulcanized alloy structure is virtually indestructible (resisting crushing forces up to 💪+5). Strength version enhances leg lifting power by 💪+5 (applies to shoulder lifts, leg presses, and carrying capacity; leg attacks gain +1 Dmg), with a -1 penalty to 👣.

supplies.name: Cyber-Oxygenator Implant (mso)
supplies.notes: A surgical prosthetic replacing a segment of the pulmonary vein with an in-line micro-compressor that filters and stores surplus oxygen from the bloodstream, automatically re-infusing the blood when external breathing is compromised.

supplies.name: Enhanced Ear (mso)
supplies.notes: During this operation, one of the patient’s eardrums and inner ears is replaced with a variable, hypersensitive audial implant. After the operation, the patient can mentally adjust the implant to amplify sound so that all 👁️ Perception check based on hearing are made at +3. The implant automatically filters out all sounds loud enough to cause harm, and volume may be adjusted at will. Picks up frequencies ranging well above and below human hearing.

supplies.name: Joint Locks (mso)
supplies.notes: Joint lock surgery replaces all major joints in the body (specifically arms and legs) with techsteel mechanical joints. locked joints are pre-tuned to automatically release if force begins to fracture adjoining skeletal structure (extremely effective with Titanium Endoskeleton). Purely compressional resistance (e.g. bracing a collapsing ceiling) increases Str by +3. Heavy items can be carried in tiring positions without fatigue, and patients can grip items or hold body positions indefinitely without concentration or tiredness.

supplies.name: Power Joints (mso)
supplies.notes: Power joint operation is similar to joint lock operation, but joints in only one appendage are replaced. Slightly more bulky. Power joints function like joint locks, but when joints are used in extreme exertion (e.g. lifting a boulder, bending bars), joint power automatically activates when muscle limit is reached. A failed 💪 check is doubled when the power joint kicks in (makes an audible whine like an electric winch).

supplies.name: QA Forearm (mso)
supplies.notes: Replaces the patient's old limb with a mechanical forearm of similar strength and dexterity, designed to attach to the Quick Attach Couplink. Equipped with internally locking joints. Fingers are optionally claw-tipped. Unlike most implants, the QA Forearm does not add body weight, but has an encumbrance of 15.

supplies.name: Quick Attach Couplink (mso)
supplies.notes: Patient's forearm is fitted with a techsteel elbow socket with drive shaft, control couplings, and chest-implanted power conduits. Allows rapid tool and weapon swapping. Standard unenhanced swap takes one movement action.

supplies.name: Thermoplas Implant (mso)
supplies.notes: A cylinder is implanted on the pulmonary artery with a sensor that activates when the blood drops below normal body temperature. The thermoplas heats the blood flow through it, allowing the user to survive without protective clothing in temperatures as low as 100 below zero.

supplies.name: Tish-Shocks (mso)
supplies.notes: Sub-dermal cylindrical dampeners embedded throughout the skeleton. Actuate instantly upon crushing or falling impact, creating localized magnetic absorption fields that provide +2 AR vs blunt and falling damage.

supplies.name: Titanium Endoskeleton (mso)
supplies.notes: Exhaustive 10-hour bionic procedure infusing the skeleton with titanium alloy filaments and reinforced joint sockets. Grants Advantage on joint locks, triples static deadlift capacity, and provides +3 AR vs blunt damage (stacks with sub-dermal tish-shocks). Bone structure is virtually indestructible with max skeletal resilience (Adv(💪12), resisting crushing up to 💪+5 force).

supplies.name: Audio Recorder (mso)
supplies.notes: Recorders are equipped with anti-grav units enabling them to hover wherever left or follow their user (👣 12, hovering just behind the right shoulder 2 feet up). By being attached to a handcomp, a simple flight routine can be programmed. Audio Recorder: This device records all sound up to 24 hours, and may be set to filter out certain frequencies in order to reduce background noise.

supplies.name: AV Recorder (mso)
supplies.notes: Recorders are equipped with anti-grav units enabling them to hover wherever left or follow their user (👣 12, hovering just behind the right shoulder 2 feet up). By being attached to a handcomp, a simple flight routine can be programmed. AV Recorder: This recorder is a silver sphere that records all audio and visual stimulus in a full 360 degree area.

supplies.name: Handcomp (mso)
supplies.notes: The computers of known space are generally quite small, easily fitting into an Anthropos’ hand. A handcomp comes with a holographically-projected keyboard, holoscreen, full up- and down link capabilities, and near-unlimited information storage capacity (based on magnetomic memory systems utilizing a phased crystalline array). Handcomps typically process information and run programs at a d6 rating.

supplies.name: Cyber-Fist (mso)
supplies.notes: Range: 1. A massive industrial cybernetic forearm replacement surgically attached at the elbow joint. Built with reinforced duralloy finger joint locks and an outer mentally commanded weighted sheath studded with armor-penetrating spikes that slides over the knuckles. Enhances unarmed Brawl strikes.

supplies.name: Force Gauntlet (mso)
supplies.notes: Range: 1. Flexible micro-articulated metallic gloves woven with internal repulsor projectors that trigger on physical impact to amplify unarmed Brawl strikes.

supplies.name: Implosion Ball (mso)
supplies.notes: Range: Short. A delicate cherry-sized hollow sphere crafted from resonant crystal. When infused with Sorce energy and hurled, the sphere shatters on impact and collapses inward into a localized dimensional rift.

supplies.name: QA Grappler (mso)
supplies.notes: Range: Medium. A cybernetic arm-mounted winch and grappling assembly firing an ultrafilament cable tipped with a locking grapnel. Used for tactical ascent, high-load hauling, and combat entanglement. Mounts via a Quick Attach Couplink.

supplies.name: Sorce Crystal (mso)
supplies.notes: Range: Short. A hollow, multi-faceted crystalline sphere the size of a small grenade. When infused with magical energy and hurled, the crystal detonates upon impact, discharging a concentrated burst of resonant arcane force across an area.

supplies.name: Spike Beetles (mso)
supplies.notes: Range: Short. A compact bio-containment canister holding a symbiotic colony of squat, spiky-shelled beetles and puffball seed caches. When seeds are scattered across a perimeter, the beetles burrow and establish an area-denial trap that swarms approaching intruders.

supplies.name: Sponge Ball (mso)
supplies.notes: Range: Short. A fibrous Kryllian biological sphere originally used in athletic games, adapted by skirmishers as an area-denial weapon. When tossed or rolled, it bursts on contact into hundreds of pressurized adhesive streamers that expand into a rigid, sticky web across an area.

supplies.name: Grapple Gun (mso)
supplies.notes: This item resembles a crossbow, but is designed to shoot a flanged grappling device. Grapple guns can be fired independently or attached to a hard point (see EM, tech, armor). The basic gun includes 100 feet of ultrafilament line on a spool able to support 1000 lbs.

supplies.name: Credit Card (mso)
supplies.notes: A credit card is a micro thin card with a digital readout and an optical transaction disk bonded to its surface. Credit cards are the standard medium of transaction and currency storage in known space. Normal credit cards have a 20 security rating. A card’s security rating may be increased by 10 for every 100 cr paid.

supplies.name: Illuminator (mso)
supplies.notes: Illuminators provide a 90 degree cone of light out to 20 squares. They also have an infrared toggle which allows them to shine light in the infrared spectrum, visible spectrum, or both. They are easily carried and are equipped with an ultralock pad so they may be mounted on any surface (such as a helmet).

supplies.name: First Aid Kit (mso)
supplies.notes: A compact 5"x8" portable medical kit containing emergency dressings, topical anesthetics, laser cauterizers, mediskin patches, thermal compresses, and sedative injectors designed for rapid trauma stabilization.

supplies.name: Laser Scalpel
supplies.notes: High-frequency precision surgical laser scalpel that cuts and cauterizes simultaneously. Rating 10.

supplies.name: Laser Scalpel (mso)
supplies.notes: A specialized medical cutting instrument projecting a micro-calibrated laser emitter that makes micro-thin sterile incisions while simultaneously cauterizing severed blood vessels.

supplies.name: Poison Antidote (Common)
supplies.notes: Broad-spectrum synthesized antidote neutralizing common biological toxins and venoms. Rating 10.

supplies.name: Poison Antidote (Common) (mso)
supplies.notes: A standardized pre-formulated chemical and biological antitoxin vial engineered to rapidly counteract common insect venoms, reptile bites, and biological toxins.

supplies.name: Power Syringe
supplies.notes: Pneumatic micro-injector designed for instant dermal delivery of antidotes, vaccines, and stimulants. Rating 10.

supplies.name: Power Syringe (mso)
supplies.notes: A compact pneumatic high-pressure hypospray applicator designed for needle-free transdermal delivery of medical cartridges through clothing and light armor seams.

supplies.name: Universal Poison Antidote (mso)
supplies.notes: A high-grade military and alchemical broad-spectrum counter-agent engineered with catalytic chelating enzymes capable of neutralizing both lethal neurotoxic venoms and complex synthetic chemical poisons.

supplies.name: Vaccine Dose (Common)
supplies.notes: Standard inoculated vaccine dose protecting against prevalent sector pathogens. Rating 10.

supplies.name: Vaccine Dose (Common) (mso)
supplies.notes: Standard inoculated vaccine dose protecting against prevalent sector pathogens. d6 rating.

supplies.name: Power Pack (mso)
supplies.notes: Cold fusion portable heavy power supply equipped with retractable power cables to continuously supply energy to heavy electronic devices and powered armor systems.

supplies.name: Nutritab (mso)
supplies.notes: Small dietary tabs produced by a nutripress or purchased separately. Supplies adequate nutrition for an entire day.

supplies.name: Communicator
supplies.notes: Text, audio, and audiovisual comms; ~200 miles including low-orbit. Open or Selective transceiver.

supplies.name: D-Crawler
supplies.notes: MR 8 transport; capacity. 1x1x1 sq interior; sealed compartment break (20).

supplies.name: DeCipher
supplies.notes: Security bypass: hack locks, find codes, override safeguards.

supplies.name: Disguise Pack
supplies.notes: Alters appearance (cosmetics, morphskin, biodyes). Stability 12 hr.

supplies.name: EnviroCube
supplies.notes: Generates a 2x2 airtight cube protecting against environmental gas, vacuum, and extreme temperatures (-200°F to 300°F); includes AirVault with 24 hours of breathable air.

supplies.name: EnviroTent
supplies.notes: 2x2 by 6 ft tall shelter; 3 occupants; 7-day air/water/nutrients; -300°F to 400°F; long range emergency transponder.

supplies.name: First Aid Pack
supplies.notes: 1st Deg Wnds if new; stops bleeding.

supplies.name: FusionSplicer
supplies.notes: nearly any substance; strips, splices, coats wires; repairs cloth/armor with stronger-than-original bonds.

supplies.name: GlowTorch
supplies.notes: Illuminates a 20-square wide path; infrared, visible, or both. Mounts via Q-Bond pad.

supplies.name: Grappling Gun
supplies.notes: Fires grappling hook; 100 ft Q-Bond cable supports 1000 lbs.

supplies.name: HealGel
supplies.notes: Heals 1st Deg; immediate tissue regeneration.

supplies.name: HoistMaster
supplies.notes: Winch for Grappling Gun; hoist/lower at 20 ft/Rnd.

supplies.name: HoloCaster
supplies.notes: Projects duplicate image up to medium range; mimics wearer; attacks pass through image thus attacker realizes fake

supplies.name: Hover Drone
supplies.notes: Verbal command: hover, follow, or pattern; max medium range. Carries; MR(10), MR(*.5) if carrying. [Dod/AR(✨)/(✨)] Vit[=(✨-1)].

supplies.name: Hover Drone Remote
supplies.notes: Controls drone remotely up to 200 Sqs; live audio-visual feed.

supplies.name: ImageScanner
supplies.notes: Records holographic image for ImageWrap; In close range, front/back/side; stores 10 images.

supplies.name: ImageWrap
supplies.notes: Holographic disguise around user; ^👁️. Stores 2 images.

supplies.name: Micro Hover Bug
supplies.notes: Hovers or follows target (MR 12); programmable via DataSleeve.

supplies.name: Miniflare Gun
supplies.notes: Fires signal flare (1000 ft); set to illuminate, tracer, and/or whistle.

supplies.name: Miniflare Gun Flares
supplies.notes: Ammo for Miniflare Gun or similar.

supplies.name: MiniScub Cartridge
supplies.notes: 1 hour compressed air for MiniScuba or similar.

supplies.name: MiniScuba
supplies.notes: Mouthpiece + cartridge; 1 hr air; cartridge auto-fills when not in use.

supplies.name: NanoShear
supplies.notes: Precision cut or engrave up to 6 in; rating 40. Auto-cut or programmed patterns.

supplies.name: Omni-Fab
supplies.notes: A compact quantum molecular assembler capable of printing simple tools and non-weapon supplies instantly.

supplies.name: Personal Scanner
supplies.notes: Handheld scanner medium range. Pose question to GM; answer limited to 1 word.

supplies.name: PlasmaTorch
supplies.notes: Plasma cutter/welder; up to12 in depth; cuts steel and bulkheads.

supplies.name: PowerTap
supplies.notes: Monitor/siphon energy. Holds 100 srg

supplies.name: Q-Bond Cable
supplies.notes: 100 ft cable; Q-Bond ends affix to surfaces; controlled from spool.

supplies.name: QuantumChef
supplies.notes: One-inch cube expands to tech-plates, utensils, thermal cups; atomic heating/cooling; stores up to week's food and water

supplies.name: Backpack (mso)
supplies.notes: This is the standard carrying device for explorers, adventurers, etc. It may be made of leather or synthetic material (although Calemora prefer leather). Backpacks can normally hold items of up to 100 Enc., and have various pockets and compartments for easy access.

supplies.name: Tech Case (1'x1')
supplies.notes: A 1'x1' reinforced tech case that can be security sealed for protection (Dif 20). Rating 10.

supplies.name: Tech Case (1'x1') (mso)
supplies.notes: A 1’x1' reinforced tech case that can be security sealed for protection (Dif 20). d6 rating.

supplies.name: Miniflare Gun (mso)
supplies.notes: This small gun contains ten signal flares, each one of which may be set to produce a special effect during their 1000 foot flight. Flares may be set to illuminate (in which case they will light up all surroundings within a number of feet equal to their height), to leave a tracer (a long, glowing path from the point at which the flare was fired, which lasts for several minutes), or to whistle loudly. Each flare may only have one special effect.

supplies.name: Oxygen Canister (1 hr) (mso)
supplies.notes: Additional six-inch canister holding an hour of compressed air for the Oxygenator Mask. Auto-fills when not in use.

supplies.name: Biometer (mso)
supplies.notes: A wrist or appendage band displaying real-time vital signs (Vitality, wounds, heart rate, respiration). Continuously monitors internal biometrics, granting Adv(First Aid 👁️) and 👁️+4^Dif to detect poisons, toxins, pathogens, or abnormal foreign substances. Emits audio-visual alerts upon detection.

supplies.name: Crawler, Personal (mso)
supplies.notes: A personal crawler is a small, tracked transport unit intended to carry equipment, possessions, and scientific samples with stats equal to PC stats (👣 8, Def 5, AR 5). Crawlers have an environmentally sealed compartment protected by a security lock which prevents unauthorized access (Dif 20). Internal antigrav generators and dimensional transducers easily carry up to 500 Enc within a 10' x 10' x 10' interior compartment, although externally measuring only 3' x 2' x 2'.

supplies.name: Disguise Kit (mso)
supplies.notes: Contains cosmetics, plastiskin, bio-colorizers, and molecular injectors to alter physical features, hair, chitin, fur, or eye color for up to 12 hours before breaking down. Grants Adv(Disguise 👁️) or 👁️+4 on disguise and cosmetic deception checks.

supplies.name: Energy Flow Monitor (mso)
supplies.notes: An energy flow monitor can hold up to 100 surge of energy. Stored energy can then be used to power an item or used to replenish an item's capacitor. Such transfer of energy is also accomplished without the need for physical contact between the item and the energy flow monitor. Transfer rate is, again, equal to the success of a roll. If a monitor is attached to a device’s power port, the transfer rate (either way) is instantaneous.

supplies.name: Genesis Capsule (mso)
supplies.notes: Genesis capsules are large black pills, filled with viscous matter. They are manufactured by the Company, which will not divulge the secrets of their creation. However, it has been determined that mechnites (microscopic robots) are contained within the capsule’s fluid. It is thought that the mechnites fill themselves with the fluid, then travel through the body’s systems (via blood vessels, lymph nodes, etc.) until they find damaged tissue. Then they inject the healing fluid, and use their small claws to tear away dead tissue and repair the area. The effect of all this is that at the end of the next round following ingestion, all wounds will be healed and the user will be fully revived (if unconscious). Only one capsule may be taken safely in a 24 hour period. Additional capsules require a FR roll — vs 10 times the number of capsules taken in the last 24 hours. If the FR roll fails, the user is irrevocably dead.

supplies.name: Hacker (mso)
supplies.notes: Compact data unit with display and interface keypad that splices into security systems, access panels, and computer safeguards. Decrypts security codes and overrides safeguards, granting 👁️+4^Dif (or Adv(Hacking 👁️)) on electronic security checks.

supplies.name: Holo-Scanner (mso)
supplies.notes: A holo-scanner records an individual’s holographic image. While holoimages are the standard known space version of modern photography, holo-scanner's can provide the advanced images required by hologuise units. Subjects must be scanned from within 2 sq. The scan must include front, back and side angles of the subject. Up to 10 images may be stored in the holo-scanner. These images may be transferred to and from a hologuise.

supplies.name: Hologuise (mso)
supplies.notes: A hologuise is a personal projection device which masquerades as a wristwatch. However, it can create a prerecorded holographic image around the user. The image is very accurate (d10 vs Awa on all attempts to detect the disguise). The image moves as the user moves thanks to an advanced processor and a number of sophisticated motion sensors which are placed upon the user's extremities. Up to two images may be stored in the hologuise at any given time.

supplies.name: Jump-Pack (mso)
supplies.notes: This backpack-sized unit contains an array of thrusters enabling individuals to make an assisted jump at with advantage (see CM, speed). A 🏃 check may be required for difficult landings (Dif set by the GM).

supplies.name: Laser Cutter (mso)
supplies.notes: Laser cutters are designed to cut very hard material very precisely. Their cutting ability is rated at d12, however, they can only cut something which can be placed between their cutting jaws (which can extend to 6 inches wide and 6 inches deep). They can also be programmed to auto-cut a specific pattern or engrave an item. Laser cutters can also sever live power cables while cauterizing the ends (preventing power leakage).

supplies.name: Macrovisor (mso)
supplies.notes: Macrovisors autotint to provide glare resistance (d6). They also optimize vision (+1 to vision based 👁️ Perception check) and provide image enhancement up to 500:1 (in other words, an object 500 feet away will appear to be one foot away when using image enhancement). This unit may be secured to the user’s head using ultralock pads placed near the temples (keeping user’s hands free). The speaker attachment enables the macrovisor to focus automatically and provide digital readouts of distance, light conditions, etc.

supplies.name: Mess Kit (mso)
supplies.notes: A Guild mess kit is far more than a simple collection of plates and eating utensils. Dimensionally compressed, the kit occupies a one-inch cube, and may be expanded by depressing a button on top. The mess kit contains three tech-plates (which sterilize, cook and cut your food), an ultralock eating utensil, and three thermal cups. The plates and cups are equipped with miniaturized atomic heating and cooling elements.

supplies.name: Nutripress (mso)
supplies.notes: Breaks food down into its component elements, producing compact nutritabs. Each nutritab supplies complete nutritional sustenance for an entire day. Holds seven pre-pressed nutritabs, while a dimensional reservoir stores up to a week’s worth of fresh water.

supplies.name: Oxygenator Mask (mso)
supplies.notes: An oxygenator is a light mask and six-inch long canister, which holds an hour of compressed air. The canister can be set on auto-fill when not being used.

supplies.name: Palmstore (mso)
supplies.notes: Thin palm-fitted band equipped with a micro-transporter storing the energy pattern of any one object up to 25 Enc. Stored objects dematerialize into memory with zero encumbrance, instantly materializing back into the user's hand upon command. Built-in safeguards prevent storage of living organisms; one palmstore may be worn per hand.

supplies.name: Personal Scanner (mso)
supplies.notes: Handheld sensor unit with holographic projected display and keypad (range 10 sq). Scans for lifesigns, energy conduits, and structural anomalies, granting 👁️+4^Dif (or Adv(Scan 👁️)) on technical sensor sweeps.

supplies.name: Personal Transporter (mso)
supplies.notes: A personal transporter is a belt that fits around the user’s waist. The unit can transport the wearer and any carried objects up to 100 miles (or to a ship in low orbit). A personal transporter has a 100 surge capacitor and a Q-cell which replenishes 50 surge every hour. Each transport expends 50 surge. In addition, the unit may be used to transport the user and one other individual (if fully charged), expending all of the transporter's energy. Personal transporters are not equipped for use with energy clips or power cables, and their technology is not able to transport other personal transporters.

supplies.name: PFF 1 (mso)
supplies.notes: The ultimate advancement of field-based technology, personal force fields throw up a shimmering bubble, protecting their owners from all physical- and energy-based attacks. Force fields carry their own power packs, and are available at a variety of protective levels. Zin-Shee shield technology is widely utilized coreward.

supplies.name: PFF 3 (mso)
supplies.notes: Personal force field generating a protective shimmering bubble of field-based kinetic shielding (+2 AR).

supplies.name: PFF 5 (mso)
supplies.notes: Elite personal force field generating a shimmering protective barrier with advanced kinetic absorption (+3 AR).

supplies.name: PFF 6 (mso)
supplies.notes: Top-tier personal force field utilizing Zin-Shee field harmonics to generate heavy kinetic deflection (+4 AR).

supplies.name: Phase Deviator (mso)
supplies.notes: A phase deviator is a small unit worn on the belt, which generates a powerful field of dimensional flux. The wearer rapidly “phases” between several locations, appearing blurry and hard to see. Their effect is to increase the wearer’s Def by +3. While they are incredibly effective defensive devices, phase deviators have a single flaw — they reduce their user’s attack rolls by -3 (it’s hard to fight when you keep blipping around).

supplies.name: Pod, Personal Hover (mso)
supplies.notes: This small drone may be verbally ordered to hover, move in a set pattern, or follow its owner. The drone can rise to an altitude of 10 sq. They are equipped with the same functions as an A-V recorder and a handcomp, and may be upgraded similarly. A hover pod can carry up to 50 Enc. of equipment. Its arm can lift anything up to this encumbrance which is not actively resisting. Its unencumbered MR is 10, but its MR is 6 if it is carrying any payload at all. In combat pods have a d6 rating for defensive purposes only.

supplies.name: Poisons (mso)
supplies.notes: Poisons can be purchased in four forms: contact (doubled cost), intravenous (normal), oral (normal), or gaseous (quadruple cost, covers 3x3 squares). Standard poisons include Choking (125 cr, prevents breathing), Corrosive (200 cr, burns continuous tissue), Death (250 cr, causes fatal heart attacks, Kalos II kicta fungus antidote), Knockout (150 cr, medical anesthesia), Laughing (125 cr, uncontrollable laughter), Paralysis (150 cr, male joc-tun serpent extract), and Sleep (125 cr, Setchie plant extract, Shanask are immune).

supplies.name: Power Frame (mso)
supplies.notes: A power frame is a military version of the power lifters commonly used to load cargo and move heavy objects. It resembles an oversized humanoid framework, with large mechanical claws and a partially-armored roll cage to protect its driver. Standard systems (included free) are compensators (👣 4), strength enhancers (with advantage — d12 minimum), joint locks, three external hard points, targeting computer, and two flood lights.

supplies.name: Slap Pack (mso)
supplies.notes: When slapped upon a wound, a slap pack’s two gel compounds combine to form a fast acting healing salve, which causes any wounded tissue to immediately begin regeneration. Each pack works only once, and almost instantaneously heals d6 points of damage.

supplies.name: Space Suit (mso)
supplies.notes: Space suits are very compact and efficient. These suits are completely space worthy, but are of minimal use in combat. Standard systems (included free) are sealed, internal environment, illuminator kit, macrovisor kit with star-light and star-lamp enhancement, and ultralock boot kit.

supplies.name: Survival Bag (mso)
supplies.notes: The survival bag is a one-person sleeping bag which may be used to withstand extreme climatic conditions. A built-in stasis field and heating/cooling network keep the user warm in temperatures as low as 200 below zero and keep the user relatively cool up to 300 degrees (Fahrenheit). The bag comes equipped with a 24 hour air supply which can auto-fill. An internal compartment stores a day’s supply of water which the user may drink through a special nipple attachment.

supplies.name: Survival Shield Generator (mso)
supplies.notes: Deploys a 2x2 hermetic cubic barrier of force. Airtight seal resists extreme temperatures (-200° to 300°F) and the vacuum of space. Blocks physical intrusions and debris with a static barrier strength of 💪+5 (does not block energy weapons or sorce). Internal compressor provides 24 hours of breathable air.

supplies.name: Survival Tent (mso)
supplies.notes: A survival tent is the ultimate portable shelter. Sealed with an ultralock airlock, a survival tent contains enough compressed air and nutrients to sustain up to three occupants for 7 days. Internal dimensional stabilizers provide a comfortable 10 foot square living area complete with hover cots and a small table. The tent has an outside dimension of 3 feet square (and when deactivated and rolled up, the tent is about the size of an individual's forearm). The tent’s environment is stable against temperatures from 300 below zero to 400 above (Fahrenheit). A 100 mile range emergency transponder is built into the tent. An ultralock bottom enables the tent to be attached to nearly any surface.

supplies.name: Targeter (mso)
supplies.notes: Targeters are small units which give ranged shot weapons (only) a +1 to hit and doubles the weapon’s range. The targeter is a cylindrical unit attached to a weapon, which sends out a thin bright laser beam for easy identification of the weapon’s impact point. When activated, targeters also provide a magnified view of the target complete with elevation, range, and size readouts.

supplies.name: Tech Pack (mso)
supplies.notes: A tech pack is a durable plasteel backpack with an internal dimensional condenser. The pack attaches to the user’s back via two ultralock strips. The pack itself is only about one foot square and six inches deep. However, it can hold items as if it were 4’x3', and has a capacity of 150 Enc.

supplies.name: Tech Wand (mso)
supplies.notes: Handheld pistol-grip cutting torch and industrial welder. Exerts a precision cutting strength of 💪+5 against blast doors, bulkheads, and hardened alloy plating, granting Adv(Repair 👁️) on structural welding.

supplies.name: Transportal (mso)
supplies.notes: This device consists of a one-foot long, two inch thick square bar. However, at least two of these devices are required for operation. When activated, the transportal bar telescopes out to 3 feet and bonds (using an ultralock field) to the surface below it. When first activated, the transportal must search for other transportals within its 1000 foot range. The portal's search ability is d6, and may be rolled once each round (and it may be combined(cat) with transporter skill). Only one other portal a round may be searched for, even if several are in the area. Once another bar is located a seven-foot tall wall of energy appears above the bar. The user may then step through the first bar’s portal and instantly exit the second doorway. These devices may remain active endlessly without power failure. However, heavy traffic will overload their circuits, shutting them off for several hours.

supplies.name: Turbo Pack (mso)
supplies.notes: A turbo pack is worn on the back and utilizes turbofans and a minijet propulsion system for atmospheric flight. Due to its reliance on air, it is useless in space. A pair of retractable arms complete with joysticks provide maneuvering control. When activated, the pack can lift its user and any carried items up to 100 feet per round and allows for a horizontal 👣 24. These packs are equipped with Q-cells and capacitors. The pack can operate for up to one hour before running out of power. The Q-cell recharges the packs’s power at the rate of 1 minute of flight time every 10 minutes. Packs are not equipped for power pack or energy clip use.

supplies.name: Ultrafilament Line (mso)
supplies.notes: Ultrafilament line comes in contained spools of 100 feet. Ultrafilament is very thin, very light, and virtually unbreakable (2d8). Despite its thinness, ultrafilament line is made with an ionic bonding surface, which allows users to climb without difficulty. On top of this, the end is sensitized with ultralock technology, enabling the line to be affixed to nearly any item without the need for tieing. The ultralock can be controlled from the spool container at the other end. Ultralock technology was developed by The Company. It utilizes a patented micro-range tractorbeam system which can lock onto physical items as determined by a selective AI program (i.e., it knows when to lock on and when to let go). This technology has nearly replaced the magnometric technology of the past, because ultralock can attach itself to nearly any material (not just metals).

supplies.name: Ultralock Boots (mso)
supplies.notes: Ultralock boots allow the user to stick to any surface with a d12 Str. The user must lock and unlock the boots with each step slowing movement to 1/2 normal. When activated wearers may walk on slippery surfaces and even hang upside-down.

supplies.name: Ultralock Utility Belt (mso)
supplies.notes: This utility harness attaches items to it via ultralock technology. It can hold up to 100 enc of items. The built in AI routine is very good at determining when an item is being pulled off by the user as opposed to being caught on a chair, brushed by swinging arms, etc. A built in security routine allows the user to program in up to 10 other authorized individuals. Otherwise, items must be wrenched off the belt — Str (20).

supplies.name: Wirelocks (mso)
supplies.notes: Automated precision wire strippers and circuit splicers utilizing a micro-molecular drill and bonding field to insulate and splice wiring or patch armor tears with superior bond strength.

supplies.name: Compressor (mso)
supplies.notes: A portable high-pressure gas cylinder equipped with an automated atmospheric intake turbine, shoulder strap, and integrated anti-gravity ballast to counteract the physical weight of compressed gas. Sustains normal respiration for up to 24 hours in hazardous or vacuum environments.

supplies.name: Engineering Supplies
supplies.notes: Miscellaneous components, conduits, fuses, and connectors for starship, ATM, or weapon field repairs. Rating 10.

supplies.name: Engineering Supplies (mso)
supplies.notes: A heavy-duty portable satchel packed with universal fiber conduits, replacement relays, solid-state fuses, patch alloy, and diagnostic couplers for emergency technical repairs.

supplies.name: Plasma Precipitator Pack (mso)
supplies.notes: This backpack-style device is required when using a plasma weapon (plasma sword, turbo plaz, etc.). The precipitator pack filters particles from the air and superheats them to a state of plasma, which is then available for use by any plasma weapon which is plugged into the pack.

equipment.name: Mallet (wood)

equipment.name: Nails (25)

equipment.name: Net (10 ft)
equipment.notes: A 10-foot diameter net woven from thick, water-resistant fibers, its knots reinforced with metal rings to prevent fraying. The mesh is taut and evenly spaced, ideal for entangling prey or securing cargo during transport.

equipment.name: Pickaxe
equipment.notes: A robust pickaxe with a long, reinforced shaft and a heavy, chisel-like head. The head is forged from hardened steel, featuring a pointed tip and two sturdy prongs for breaking through stone and rock.

equipment.name: Rope (50 ft silk)

equipment.name: Saw (hand)

equipment.name: Shovel (iron)

equipment.name: Skillet (iron)

equipment.name: AegisColar
equipment.notes:
The AegisColar is a sophisticated piece of gear designed to provide instant access to protective armor with the simple press of a button. This half-collar, worn around the back of the neck, can store an entire set of armor by breaking it down into individual plates and storing them within the collar itself. When needed, the collar swiftly reassembles and deploys the armor over the wearer’s body, providing immediate protection. The process is efficient, though it does produce a slight noise as the plates are fitted together during the assembly and disassembly.
The AegisColar resembles the regal collars of ancient Egypt, but with a futuristic twist. Its sleek, metallic surface gleams with a polished sheen, catching the light as it rests subtly on the back of the neck. When activated, the collar emits a faint hum, and the stored armor begins to unfurl from within. Plates glide smoothly over the wearer’s body, forming a seamless protective layer. The entire process is a marvel of technology, as each plate locks into place with precision, creating a visual spectacle akin to watching an intricate puzzle assemble itself. The slight clinking of metal as the plates fit together adds to the sense of mechanical elegance, making the transformation feel both powerful and awe-inspiring.
Unleash the power of instant protection with the AegisColar, the ultimate fusion of ancient style and cutting-edge technology, ensuring you're always ready for battle at the press of a button.
Effects
\-- Half collar stores/returns armor at press of a button.
\-- Armor rolls out/in as plates via internal transporters.

equipment.name: AeroJet Thruster
equipment.notes:
The AeroJet Thruster is an advanced propulsion system worn as a backpack, designed specifically for atmospheric flight. Utilizing a combination of powerful turbofans and a minijet propulsion system, it enables the wearer to achieve vertical lift and horizontal movement. The pack is controlled through a pair of retractable arms equipped with joysticks, allowing for precise maneuverability in flight. However, its functionality is limited to environments with an atmosphere, rendering it ineffective in space. The pack is powered by Nova-Cores, providing up to one hour of continuous operation before needing to recharge. The Nova-Core recharges the pack at a rate of one minute of flight time for every ten minutes of downtime.
The AeroJet Thruster is a sleek and robust piece of equipment, with a design that exudes both power and efficiency. The backpack is crafted from lightweight, durable materials, its surface smooth and aerodynamic. When activated, the turbofans emit a low hum that gradually intensifies as the minijet engines ignite, propelling the user into the air. The retractable control arms extend smoothly, bringing the joysticks into the user’s hands, ready for immediate maneuvering. As the thruster lifts off, the sensation of acceleration is exhilarating, with the world below quickly shrinking as the user soars effortlessly through the sky. The soft glow of the Nova-Core, visible through a small panel on the pack, pulsates rhythmically, a visual testament to the advanced technology within.
With the AeroJet Thruster, take to the skies and leave the ground far behind—where your only limit is the horizon.
Effects
\-- Backpack with turbofans/minijet for atmospheric flight (useless in space).
\-- Lifts up to 100 ft/Rnd, horizontal MR(24).
\-- Retractable arms with joysticks for control.
\-- Operates 1 hr on Nova-Cores, recharges 1 min flight per 10 min.

equipment.name: Anti-Grav Harness
equipment.notes:
The Anti-Grav Harness is a sophisticated suspensor belt that provides unparalleled support and versatility for its wearer. This large metal ring, equipped with adjustable expansion slides, comfortably fits around the midsection of most beings. Once secured with eight inward-extending pins, the harness activates its anti-gravity field, allowing the user to hover effortlessly as they move. The harness has additional storage options provided by various hooks, fasteners, and compartments integrated into the belt’s design. Moreover, if the user’s armor is rigid, the harness can integrate directly with the armor. An articulated arm, which can mount a single heavy item like a cannon, extends from the belt and offers buoyant support, making even the heaviest weapons feel nearly weightless. The arm’s internal technology ensures that the user’s balance remains stable, despite the additional load. However, the harness does impose a movement restriction.
Visually, the Anti-Grav Harness is an impressive piece of engineering, its robust metal ring gleaming with a polished finish. The belt’s structure is both functional and aesthetically pleasing, with its sleek design and compact form. When activated, the harness emits a faint, barely audible hum, creating a sense of quiet power. The eight pins, which secure the belt to the user, extend smoothly and lock into place with a satisfying click. The articulated arm, with its highly maneuverable joints, is a marvel to behold, moving effortlessly in response to the wearer’s commands. Whether suspending a heavy weapon or simply hovering alongside the user, the harness exudes an air of effortless control, making it an indispensable tool for those who require both mobility and heavy-duty support.
Elevate your combat readiness with the Anti-Grav Harness, the ultimate solution for carrying heavy loads without breaking a sweat, ensuring you're always prepared for whatever the battlefield throws your way.
Effects
\-- Suspensor belt, activates anti-gravity field to support X Enc
\-- Includes articulated arm, mounts single item up to additional Y Enc (e.g., heavy weapon).
\-- Arm-mount item has no Enc, provides buoyant support, compensates balance.

The Blur Band is an artifact known for its ability to phase the wearer rapidly in and out of dimension, creating a disorienting blur effect. This rapid phasing makes it exceedingly difficult for enemies to track or target the wearer. Attacks targeting the wearer suffer Disadvantage, and grabbing or physically restraining them is nearly impossible. However, the immense physical strain of dimensional phasing takes a toll; the wearer must succeed on a Resist 🫀^🫀 check at the start of each Nish or succumb to phase sickness, which abruptly ends the effect and halves MR until a subsequent Resist 🫀^🫀 check succeeds.
Visually, the Blur Band is a slender metallic band with shifting geometric engravings. When activated, it pulses with an ethereal glow as the wearer's form blurs and shimmers between dimensions.

equipment.name: Cyber X-Ray Eye
equipment.notes:
The Cyber X-Ray Eye is an advanced cybernetic implant designed to enhance an existing cyber eye, providing the user with the ability to see through various layers of material. This implant allows the user to penetrate surfaces, revealing hidden objects, spaces or things behind them. The depth of vision depends on the material’s density, with greater clarity through lighter substances such as cloth or thin walls, and more resistance when attempting to see through denser materials like stone or metal. This implant is particularly valuable for reconnaissance, security, and tactical operations, offering the wearer a significant advantage in environments where unseen obstacles or threats may lurk.
Visually, the Cyber X-Ray Eye is a marvel of sleek, futuristic design, seamlessly integrated with the user’s existing cyber eye. When activated, the eye emits a faint, bluish glow that intensifies as the X-ray vision engages, casting a subtle light across the surface being scanned. The surrounding area may appear slightly distorted, as if the air itself is rippling in response to the eye’s penetrating gaze. As the user focuses, the glow sharpens into a precise beam, illuminating hidden details beneath layers of material. The experience of using the Cyber X-Ray Eye is akin to peeling back the layers of reality, revealing a hidden world that exists just out of sight. The sensation is both thrilling and empowering, giving the user a sense of omniscience as they uncover secrets that would otherwise remain concealed.
Unlock the unseen with the Cyber X-Ray Eye, and gain the power to see beyond the surface, revealing hidden truths and gaining the ultimate advantage in any situation.
Effects
\-- Cyber implant requiring existing cyber eye.
\-- X-ray vision with Sk() open-ended roll based on material density

equipment.name: Cyber-Legs, Speed
equipment.notes:
Cyber-Legs, Speed are a cutting-edge full-leg replacement designed for individuals seeking enhanced mobility and speed. These cybernetic limbs replace both legs entirely, including necessary reinforcements to the pelvic area to handle the increased weight and torque generated by the advanced mechanics. Constructed with a metal alloy core wrapped in a durable vulcanized rubber exterior, these legs are built to endure extreme conditions, including the heat from soft molten metal. The internal servos operate with remarkable quietness, ensuring smooth and efficient movement. Designed for speed, these cyber-legs significantly boost the wearer’s movement rate and agility, making them an ideal choice for those who require quick and nimble responses in high-stakes environments.
The visual design of the Cyber-Legs, Speed is both sleek and robust, exuding a sense of raw power combined with high-tech elegance. The metal alloy core gleams beneath the matte, textured finish of the vulcanized rubber, giving the legs a rugged yet polished appearance. The feet are equipped with specialized tracks and retractable claws, providing superior grip on various surfaces, from slick urban streets to soft, uneven terrain. When in motion, the legs exhibit a fluid, almost graceful movement, with the servos operating so silently that they seem to glide effortlessly. The enhanced leap and jump capabilities add a dynamic edge, allowing the user to vault over obstacles with ease. The overall effect is one of relentless precision and strength, as these cyber-legs transform the wearer into a veritable force of nature.
Elevate your performance with Cyber-Legs, Speed, where every step is a leap towards unparalleled agility and power, ensuring you outpace and outmaneuver anything that stands in your way.
Effects
\-- Full leg replacement for speed and agility; metal alloy core, vulcanized rubber exterior.
\-- Feet have tracks/claws for grip or soft surfaces.
\-- Permanent AR bonuses apply

equipment.name: Cyber-Legs, Strength
equipment.notes:
The Cyber-Legs, Strength model is a powerful full-leg replacement designed for those who require enhanced strength and durability. These cybernetic limbs replace both legs entirely, incorporating enhancements to the pelvic area to support the increased weight and torque generated by their advanced mechanics. With a metal alloy core encased in a durable vulcanized rubber exterior, these legs are built to endure the harshest conditions, including exposure to soft molten metal. The internal servos are engineered to operate with near-silent efficiency, providing seamless and powerful movement. These cyber-legs significantly boost the wearer’s leg strength, allowing for immense power in activities such as shoulder lifts and leg presses, as well as delivering devastating kicks. However, the added bulk of these legs imposes a limit on the wearer’s movement rate, ensuring that the trade-off between strength and speed is carefully balanced.
Visually, the Cyber-Legs, Strength model is a striking fusion of industrial might and cutting-edge technology. The metal alloy core is visible beneath the rugged vulcanized rubber, giving the legs a formidable and imposing appearance. The legs are bulkier than other models, with a design that emphasizes power over agility. The reinforced joints and pistons are built to withstand immense pressure, and the overall construction exudes an aura of unyielding strength. When in use, the legs move with a deliberate, controlled force, each step resonating with the power of an unstoppable machine. The sound of the servos is barely perceptible, adding to the impression of effortless strength. The wearer’s kicks and movements carry an undeniable weight, making it clear that these legs are designed for those who need to overpower their surroundings with sheer force.
Harness the raw power of Cyber-Legs, Strength, and experience a level of physical dominance that will leave your foes trembling, as you crush obstacles and opponents alike with every step.
Effects
\-- Full leg replacement for strength and power; metal alloy core, vulcanized rubber exterior.

equipment.name: CyberGuards
equipment.notes:
CyberGuards are a revolutionary cybernetic implant designed to enhance the body's natural defense against blunt force trauma. These implants consist of thousands of nail-shaped shock absorbers that are meticulously embedded beneath the skin and anchored to the underlying bone structure. By distributing the impact of blunt forces more effectively than tissue alone, CyberGuards significantly reduce the damage from crushing, falling, or any blunt weapon strikes. The result is a system where the user might only experience a series of round, circular bruises instead of severe injuries. When combined with SteelOsteal enhancements, the protective benefits are amplified even further, making the wearer incredibly resilient to blunt trauma.
Visually, the presence of CyberGuards is almost undetectable, as the implants are discreetly hidden beneath the skin. However, upon closer inspection or under certain lighting, a subtle pattern of faintly raised circles might be visible, hinting at the advanced technology beneath. The skin over these areas feels slightly firmer to the touch, a testament to the shock absorbers working beneath the surface. During an impact, there is a noticeable dampening effect, as if the force is being absorbed and dispersed by an invisible shield. This gives the user a sense of invulnerability, as they withstand blows that would incapacitate an ordinary person. The combination of advanced materials and precise engineering results in a seamless integration that enhances both the durability and functionality of the user's body.
Equip yourself with CyberGuards and turn every hit into a mere bruise, ensuring that no amount of blunt force can slow you down as you stand strong against the harshest of impacts.
Effects
\-- Cyber implant of shock absorbers under the skin.

equipment.name: D-Carbine
equipment.notes:
The D-Carbine is an advanced weapon utilizing dimensional technology to fire unpredictable transformative projectiles. Similar in design to a standard Blaster Carbine, it fires two-inch dimensional spheres that transform after traveling two squares into random objects or entities.
Effects
-- Carbine shoots dimensional balls that transform after 2 squares.
-- Ball types randomly determined per shot:
  1 Rubble: 1sq, Dmg 20, knockdown (💪^💪).
  2 Steel beam: 2sq swath, Dmg 10, knockdown (💪^💪) and pushed back.
  3 Ice Cubes: 2 dozen cubes, cosmetic impact (no significant Dmg).
  4 Burning logs: Dmg 25, knockdown (💪^💪), ignites flammables as a burn hazard.
  5 Nest of snakes/insects: AoE 1r, Dmg 10 at start of each Nish.
  6 Combat Mech: Fights for Encounter, then self-destructs (AoE 1r, Dmg 20; stats: MR 8, Vit 50, Atk/Dmg 20, Def/AR 10).

equipment.name: D-Shifter
equipment.notes:
The D-Shifter is an enigmatic and powerful artifact, believed to be a relic of the ancient and long-vanished Shinto race. This device grants its user the extraordinary ability to phase in and out of existence, effectively slipping into an alternate plane of reality. While active, the user remains on the battlefield, visible and vulnerable to observation and attack, but only until their initiative moment, or Nish. At this precise moment, the user can take any actions they desire, such as moving or attacking. Immediately after, they vanish, becoming completely untouchable and immune to all forms of attack for the remainder of the round. The D-Shifter’s power makes its wielder a formidable force in combat, particularly for those with a high initiative, as it allows them to strike and then disappear, avoiding any retaliation.
The D-Shifter itself is a small, intricately designed artifact, with an otherworldly aesthetic that hints at its alien origins. Its surface is covered in faintly glowing symbols and patterns that pulse with a soft, ethereal light. When activated, these symbols light up in a sequence, and a faint shimmer surrounds the user, indicating the activation of the phasing mechanism. As the user phases out, the shimmer intensifies, and they seem to dissolve into the air, leaving behind only a ripple in the fabric of reality. The transition is smooth and almost mesmerizing, as if the user is being gently pulled into another dimension. The D-Shifter’s presence on the battlefield is both subtle and ominous, as enemies know that once the user vanishes, they are beyond reach, only to return at the most opportune moment.
Harness the ancient power of the D-Shifter, and turn the tide of battle in your favor by becoming an untouchable phantom, striking with precision and disappearing without a trace.
Effects
\-- Ancient alien artifact; phases user in/out of existence.
\-- User is present until Nish; then vanishes for rest of Rnd (no longer in or aware of this dimension).
\-- Reappears next Rnd, rolls Nish, and repeats

equipment.name: D-Sizer
equipment.notes:
The D-Sizer is an ingenious and versatile set of disks that allows the user to manipulate the size of metal objects, reducing them to a fraction of their original dimensions while maintaining full functionality. The set includes two disks: one that bonds to the user and another that attaches to a metal item, such as a weapon or device no larger than Destron armor. With the D-Sizer, the user can shrink the bonded item down to the size of a chess pawn, drastically reducing its and weight to just a few ounces. This makes the D-Sizer an invaluable tool for smuggling large weapons or carrying bulky equipment without the usual physical burden. The disk worn by the user controls the size transformation, allowing for precise adjustments to any percentage of the original size. While the D-Sizer offers incredible convenience, expanding an item within a confined space comes with risks, as it can potentially damage weaker materials.
The D-Sizer disks are small, sleek, and unobtrusive, designed to be easily concealed on the user's person or attached discreetly to an object. The disks have a matte finish with a subtle metallic sheen, and their surface is engraved with intricate, almost alien-looking patterns that seem to shimmer faintly in the light. When activated, the disk on the user emits a soft, pulsing glow that mirrors the glow on the bonded item, signaling the connection between the two. The process of shrinking or expanding an item is visually captivating: the object seems to fold in on itself, gradually compressing or expanding with an almost liquid grace. The sensation of holding a once-massive weapon reduced to a mere pawn-sized piece is both surreal and empowering, offering the user a unique blend of stealth and strength.
Transform your gear with the D-Sizer, and carry the power of a full arsenal in the palm of your hand, ready to expand to its full potential when you need it most.
Effects
\-- Set of disks; one Q-Bonds to user, other to metal item of Armor Suit or less.
\-- Shrinks target to any degree, down to chess-pawn size.
\-- Enc becomes \*; weight reduced to a few ounces.
\-- Controls shrink/return; any % of full size possible.

equipment.name: D-Walker
equipment.notes:
The D-Walker is a highly advanced dimensional transporter that allows the user to shift into another dimension, effectively removing themselves from the current plane of existence. While in this alternate dimension, the user is completely isolated from all sensory input—unable to see, hear, or sense anything around them. Despite this sensory deprivation, the user retains the ability to move freely in any horizontal direction. When the D-Walker is deactivated, the user reappears in their original dimension at a location corresponding to their movements while shifted. This device is invaluable for covert operations, allowing the user to walk through walls, escape dangerous situations, or even travel through the vacuum of space between ships. However, the D-Walker must be used with caution, as the user risks re-materializing inside solid objects, a perilous consequence determined by the Game Master based on the player’s verbal instructions.
The D-Walker itself is a sleek, compact device, small enough to be worn discreetly on the body. Its design is minimalist, with a smooth, dark surface that seems to absorb light, giving it an almost ominous presence. When activated, the device emits a faint hum, and the user’s form begins to shimmer and blur before vanishing entirely from the visible spectrum. The experience of using the D-Walker is disorienting yet exhilarating, as the user feels the strange sensation of moving through a void, untethered to the physical world. The moment of re-materialization is equally intense, as the user suddenly snaps back into reality, with their surroundings shifting into focus as if emerging from a dream. The D-Walker’s power and potential make it a formidable tool, but one that requires precise control and careful planning.
Step into the unknown with the D-Walker, where the boundaries of reality are yours to transcend, offering unparalleled freedom and escape when you need it most.
Effects
\-- Shifts user to another dimension; no sense perception during shift.
\-- Move in any horizontal direction while shifted.
\-- Reappears in own dimension as if movement occurred there.
\-- GM determines re-materialization location based only on Player’s verbal direction/distance description
\-- Risk of materializing in solid objects (GM discretion).

equipment.name: Decohesion Gun
equipment.notes:
The Decohesion Gun is a specialized energy weapon designed for precise and relentless elimination of high-armor, high-vitality targets. Unlike standard blaster carbines, the Decohesion Gun operates by firing a continuous stream of energy at a single target, requiring the wielder to maintain aim until the accumulated damage surpasses the target’s armor and vitality. Once this threshold is breached, the target undergoes a catastrophic mini implosion, effectively disintegrating in a gruesome spectacle reminiscent of a bug splatting against a windshield. This weapon is particularly effective against heavily armored foes, allowing for a tactical approach that gradually wears down even the toughest defenses. However, if the target manages to evade the beam or move out of range, the entire process must be restarted.
The Decohesion Gun features a distinctive design, with its most notable characteristic being the small radio dish-like tip at the end of the barrel. This dish gives the weapon a deceptively benign appearance, almost resembling a scanning or listening device rather than a deadly weapon. The gun’s body is sleek and angular, with a matte black finish that absorbs light, adding to its stealthy nature. When fired, the Decohesion Gun emits a high-pitched whine, accompanied by a faint, jittery sensation that can be felt by the user and the target alike. Despite these minor sensory cues, the target remains largely unaware of the impending danger until the moment of implosion, making the Decohesion Gun a preferred tool for stealthy assassinations or tactical eliminations in the heat of battle.
Unleash the Decohesion Gun, the ultimate weapon for those who seek to dismantle their enemies with precision and subtlety, leaving nothing but a splattered memory in their wake.
Effects
\-- A carbine that cannot multi-atk, but continuous attack on 1 target until total Dmg \> target's AR+Vit.
\-- Causes mini implosion, "splatting" the target.
\-- Once hit, auto-hits (if target in Rng and LoS) just Dmg() each Rnd
\-- Target suffers no discomfort until implosion.
\-- Useful as stealth weapon.

equipment.name: Ghost Mine
equipment.notes:
The Ghost Mine is a deceptively simple yet incredibly effective device designed to turn any explosive into a deadly, cloaked trap. Despite its name, the Ghost Mine is not a mine in the traditional sense; instead, it is a small, button-like disc, only half an inch high and an inch in diameter. When attached to an explosive—be it a mine, grenade, plastic charge, or even a missile—the Ghost Mine cloaks the explosive with advanced stealth technology, rendering it invisible to the naked eye. This cloaking effect can conceal explosives up to the size of a six-foot missile, making it nearly impossible for enemies to detect. The Ghost Mine also projects a thin, invisible beam from its center, extending ten feet outward. Any motion that crosses this beam triggers the explosive, making it a perfect tool for setting up undetectable traps in strategic locations.
Visually, the Ghost Mine is a small, unassuming disc, matte black with a subtle, metallic sheen that hints at its advanced internal technology. Its compact size belies its deadly purpose, allowing it to be easily concealed or attached to a wide range of explosives. When activated, the cloaking mechanism engages without a sound, making the explosive it’s attached to vanish from sight as if swallowed by the shadows. The invisible beam that extends from the Ghost Mine’s center is imperceptible to the naked eye, but its presence is a constant, silent threat, waiting for the slightest movement to unleash its destructive power. The Ghost Mine’s design is minimalist and efficient, with every element optimized for stealth and lethality.
Turn any explosive into an undetectable death trap with the Ghost Mine, where even the most vigilant enemies won't see their end coming until it's too late.
Effects
\-- Small disc cloaks attached explosive (up to 6 ft missile) at Sk()^Awa;; comes in tubes of 5 discs.
\-- Projects invisible beam; triggers explosive on motion detection.
\-- Can activate nearly any tech-based explosive; pulls pins/arms bombs etc.
\-- Typically destroyed in explosion

equipment.name: GravLift
equipment.notes:
The GravLift is an innovative attachment designed to significantly enhance the handling and performance of a weapon by reducing its weight and improving its maneuverability. This device consists of two thumb-sized cylinders that can be discreetly inserted into the stock of a weapon or attached to its side. Once activated, the GravLift’s micro pumps create a near-perfect vacuum within the cylinders, causing them to expand like balloons and generate a counteracting force that brings the weapon to true buoyancy. The onboard microcomputers continuously adjust for environmental factors and altitude, ensuring optimal performance in any situation. The result is a weapon that feels lighter, draws faster, and boasts an impressive increase in range, making it an invaluable tool for those who require precision and speed in combat.
Visually, the GravLift is a marvel of miniaturization and high-tech engineering. The cylinders are sleek and compact, with a matte finish that blends seamlessly with the weapon’s design. When activated, a faint hum can be heard as the micro pumps go to work, and the cylinders subtly expand, giving the weapon a slight, almost imperceptible lift. The effect is immediate and dramatic: the weapon becomes easier to handle, with a noticeable reduction in weight that belies its true size. The enhanced draw speed and extended range are evident in the smooth, effortless motion of the weapon, as if it’s been perfectly balanced for optimal performance. The GravLift’s combination of subtlety and power makes it an essential upgrade for any serious combatant looking to gain an edge in the field.
Elevate your arsenal with the GravLift, and experience the perfect blend of agility and power, turning even the heaviest weapon into a feather-light precision instrument.

\-- Two thumb-sized anti-grav cylinders for weapon attachment.
