gear.name: ZX52 Rocket (mso)
gear.notes: A rocket sled designed for extreme speeds: 320Mph in hover mode, and 900Mph up to Mach 47.5 in rocket mode, capable of entering orbit in 7 minutes powered by 1 gallon of water. Coated in Frictionless diamond-ceramic armor (withstands 3000 degrees). Features dual energy barrels and a self-destruct nuke mode.

gear.name: Beetle Bomb (mso)
gear.notes: Range: Short. These Biotech items resemble multi-legged beetles with large gas-filled sacs immediately beneath their wing-cases. When directed, beetle bombs (often called bomber beetles or just bombers) will scurry (👣 8) into an area and release their air sacs in an explosion of noxious gas functioning like a gas grenade. Once their raid is complete, beetles attempt to scamper back to the safety of their host. It takes a full day for the bomber to regenerate its gas sac. Beetle bombs are able to fulfill moderately complex pheromonal orders.

gear.name: Death Eggs (mso)
gear.notes: Range: Short (5 sq) or shot via Egg Spitter. A fragile organic egg sac containing a small burrowing crustacean called a bormaul. Normally tough and leathery, the egg sac grows fragile when launched and shatters on impact. The released bormaul seeks out the nearest non-Kryll lifeform, chewing beneath armor to feast on the target while bypassing most forms of armor.

gear.name: Bionocular (mso)
gear.notes: When a bionocular is activated, it slides itself up the back of its host’s neck onto the head. It then slaps flap-like appendages over the host’s eyes. Bonded to the eyes themselves, the bionocular now sends images to its host. Bionoculars can rotate their eyestalks in any direction, magnifying images up to 500:1. When the host completes its visual scan, the bionocular pulls its appendages off with a slurping pop and slithers back off the host’s head.

gear.name: Breather (mso)
gear.notes: Breathers are squid-like organisms which ride around on their host’s neck or other location near the mouth. When the need arises, the breather will quickly wrap its long radial appendages around the host’s head, sealing itself over the host’s mouth. The breather then absorbs the atmosphere about the host, filtering out harmful particulates and gasses (d100), and exhaling clean air into the host’s mouth. When the host exhales, the breather’s internal valves close and the used air exits with a flapping, wheezing sound from either side of the breather’s body. Breathers will function underwater, acting as a sort of artificial aqua-lung.

gear.name: Choking Poison Vial (mso)
gear.notes: Synthesized Calamorian asphyxiation neurotoxin that severely constricts airways and vocal cords.

gear.name: Corrosive Poison Vial (mso)
gear.notes: Flesh-melting Kryllian acid enzyme that rapidly eats through armor and living tissue.

gear.name: Death Poison Vial (mso)
gear.notes: Extremely lethal Sea Zimil cardiac neurotoxin causing acute heart failure upon intravenous introduction.

gear.name: Feeder (mso)
gear.notes: These creatures look like large, bloated, vein-covered balloons, with two long tube-like appendages. The more slender appendage winds its way up the hosts back, neck, and into one side of the host’s mouth, where it extends most of the way down the host’s throat. The other appendage is thicker, tougher, and can reach to the ground. It ends in a concentric mouth filled with numerous serrated teeth. Feeders are essentially an external stomach. The toothed appendage constantly sweeps over the host’s body, eating dead cells, dirt, waste, etc., as well as whatever the host offers it. Feeders eat nearly anything. They process their intake, spewing out whatever is non-nutritious, and routing the rest up the other appendage where a nutrient slime constantly trickles down the host’s throat, thus supplying the host with all of its nutrient and hydration needs. Feeders function only when there is sufficient organic material to process. In a vacuum, or on a dead, rocklike world, feeders act at greatly reduced efficiency, or do not function at all.

gear.name: Firegnat Colony (mso)
gear.notes: As soon as a firegnat colony is introduced to its host, it builds a wasp-like hive upon the host’s body. Most of the time, these nearly microscopic flies remain in the hive, coming out only to eat. However, when the host summons the colony, 800-1000 firegnats swarm out, activating bioluminescent chemicals in their abdomens. Together, the gnats can light up an area of 10 squares by 10 squares 10' high. Firegnats fly at 👣 10, and may illuminate any shape the host desires, so long as the area remains the same. They can also dim or extinguish upon command. The colony is able to keep an area lit endlessly as individual gnats fly out in shifts, while others return to rejuvenation their illumination abilities.

gear.name: Glow Egg (mso)
gear.notes: Glow eggs are actually not eggs, rather the dormant seeds of the glow plant. When an “egg” is sharply struck, it emits a radiant glow, illuminating a radius of six squares for 20 hours (after which it becomes useless). The light is intended for the mother plant to aid in photosynthesis, but is a highly efficient artificial light source.

gear.name: Knockout Poison Vial (mso)
gear.notes: Rapid-acting tactical sedative inducing immediate unconsciousness upon contact with the bloodstream.

gear.name: Laughing Poison Vial (mso)
gear.notes: Aerosolized euphoric agent that overwhelms the nervous system with uncontrollable hysterical laughter.

gear.name: Lift Pods (mso)
gear.notes: Symbiotic pseudo-sentient plant bowls that balance host weight and shoot adhesive runners up to 10 sq (50 ft). Pods reel in runners with a reeling strength of 💪10 (carrying up to 200 lbs per pod) to lift the host into the air (👣 3). Pods suspend host indefinitely or lower them down on command. As a weapon, runners make a d4 attack; each runner has d4 AR and 6 Vit.

gear.name: Living Rope (mso)
gear.notes: This semi-sentient plant can slither along surfaces (👣 3 or 15' per round), tie and untie itself, and secrete a sticky substance strong enough to hold 1000 lbs. Living Rope can be cut into smaller sections which will grow back together in a day’s time, if the ends are spliced.

gear.name: Paralysis Poison Vial (mso)
gear.notes: Potent Joc-Tun neuro-blocker that immobilizes motor neurons while leaving cognitive senses fully intact.

gear.name: Platelets (mso)
gear.notes: These tiny disk shaped mites spend most of their time in a state of hibernation inside the bud of the bloodwood plant. Bloodwood buds are implanted in the flesh of the host creature, where they draw minimal nutrition from the host itself. The platelets remain in hibernation until the bud opens, which only occurs when the host’s blood pressure drops dangerously low (such as when the host is suffering Vitality drain). When this happens, the bud opens and the platelets scurry across the host’s body to seal any open wounds. The platelets secrete a clotting agent and even use their own bodies to form fibrous chains across the wound. The net effect is that all effects of Vitality Drain will stop after one round. Once the bud opens, it is necessary to transplant the bloodwood blossom onto any available slain victim so the plant may complete its growth cycle. If kept upon the host, the plant’s root system will spread throughout the host’s body, causing death within d4 hours.

gear.name: Saliva Mites (mso)
gear.notes: Saliva mites are of the same genus as platelets. When purchased, they come in the form of a worm which spins a cocoon upon the host's body and fills it with mite eggs. This dome shaped cocoon is about two inches in diameter and slightly recessed into the host’s body. The mites can live within their cocoon for nearly a month, before hatching out on their own. However, they are fully developed after just a week's time and if the cocoon is torn open, the mites will function as if they naturally hatched. Either way, the mites quickly spread over the host’s body to repair tissue, eat dead flesh, and secrete a special saliva containing healing agents and helpful bacteria, resulting in d6 healing to the host. About a month later, the mites emerge through the host’s pores as small worms and eat each other until only one remains. They are soft and fall off during combat, meaning they rarely survive long enough to spin a new cocoon.

gear.name: Sleep Poison Vial (mso)
gear.notes: Synthesized Setchie narcotic inducing profound lethargic slumber.

gear.name: Slimemold (mso)
gear.notes: These items are a combination of several types of fungi. When first purchased slime-molds look like white jelly with green spots, which is coated onto the host in the desired area. Once applied, the slime-mold matures in about three days. The final product is a gelatinous layer about half an inch thick with two inch thick, fuzzy gripper-mold growing over its surface, along with three to five long tendrils (extending out to a foot and a half). Designed to hold items fast to the host. The mold’s holding power is equal to d10 strength and can be pheremonally commanded to hold and release items at will. Slime-mold is very soft to the touch and quite durable, however items held with it become permanently tainted with the smell of slime-mold.

gear.name: TechMites (mso)
gear.notes: Regulated flesh-and-circuit eating micromites contained in a bottle worm. When released, swarm moves 👣 1, devouring circuits, sensors, and alloys. Causes malfunction in electronic equipment on an eating roll of d6 exceeding device tier.

gear.name: Tube-Worms (mso)
gear.notes: Tube-worms are foot-long, hollow tube-like animals. These organisms are almost exclusively made up of muscle tissue, tendons and sinew. When a host places a hand, foot or other appendage within the tube-worm, it begins to crawl slowly up the host’s limb. When the tube-worm reaches the equivalent of an elbow or knee joint, it stops and centers itself over the joint in a sheath-like fashion. Any time the host moves the joint, the tube-worm flexes its body to assist, resulting in a +2 Str to that joint.

gear.name: Communicator Comm1 (mso)
gear.notes: The Company Comm1 unit is the standard communication device throughout Known Space. The unit includes a small output screen, video input, alphanumeric keypad, internal antenna, speaker/microphone, and a reactive band which wraps around and firmly holds onto anything upon which it is placed. The Comm1 has a range of approximately 200 miles, and is capable of communicating with space vessels in low orbit. The unit’s E/M dial is able to scan most of the electro-magnetic spectrum and up to 16 channels may be preprogrammed. Comm1s contain a security port able to accept encoding/decoding algorithms, making secure transmissions possible, provided the receiving unit contains the same algorithm. Communication may be in one of three modes — text, audio, or audio-visual. The most flexible feature of the Comm1 is its transceiver settings. Through frequency banding, a Comm1 may be set to “Open” or “Selective” channel. “Open” channel means communications may be sent to or received from anyone using the channel. “Selective” channel allows communication with a specified group of individuals. Finally, the built-in microcomputer allows verbal operation of all functions.

gear.name: Audial Transceiver (mso)
gear.notes: During this operation, one of the patient’s external ears (or tympanic membranes) is cosmetically replaced with a plasteel look alike. The new tympanic membrane acts like an amplification dish to boost transceiver signals. A micro transceiver is surgically implanted into the base of the ear just outside the eardrum. A microphone is also installed into the patient’s cranium. The transceiver works like a mentally controlled comm unit. Incoming messages are barely audible to bystanders (Dif 20) as the speaker is located next to the ear drum. If implanted with an enhanced ear, bystanders cannot hear anything, as incoming messages are electronically piped directly into the circuitry of the enhanced ear.

gear.name: Cyber-Arm (mso)
gear.notes: Complete bionic replacement of one arm with reinforced shoulder bracing to withstand high stress and weight. Internal alloy core is covered in durable vulcanized rubber (withstands molten metal temperatures). Whisper-quiet servos provide +3 on arm/hand checks (+1 melee/unarmed Dmg) and Advantage on joint locks against compression. Alloy frame is virtually indestructible against crushing (resisting impacts up to 💪+5 force).

gear.name: Cyber-Eye
gear.notes: Implanted during a very delicate operation in which one eye and eyelid are removed. In their place, a sophisticated visual lens is embedded into the eye socket. Entire implant is mentally controlled. Aperture reacts instantly to light intensity, adjusting to dim light or bright daylight. Binocular depth perception maintained. Internal transmitter to optic nerve can be shut down at will to induce blindness. Structure is airtight, functional in a vacuum, and underwater. Electrochemical charges keep lens surface clean (never blinks; immune to tear gas, smoke, extreme heat). Built-in filter screens out damaging light (can stare at a star or tech wand arc without harm). Accepts modular cyber-eye enhancements.

gear.name: Cyber-Eye (mso)
gear.notes: Implanted during a very delicate operation in which one eye and eyelid are removed. In their place, a sophisticated visual lens is embedded into the eye socket. Entirely mentally controlled. Aperture reacts to light intensity extremely fast (instantly adjusts to dim light or bright daylight). Processes vision binocularly (depth perception maintained). Optic nerve transmitter can be shut down (voluntary blindness). Airtight, fully functional in vacuum/water. Surface kept clean with electrochemical charges (never blinks). Filters automatically screen out damaging light. Eye can be upgraded with Infrared (+125 cr), Macro Enhancer (+125 cr), Micro Enhancer (+110 cr), Starlight (+100 cr), and Star Lamp (+25 cr).

gear.name: Cyber-Legs (Speed Version) (mso)
gear.notes: Complete bionic replacement of both legs including pelvic reinforcement. Metal alloy core covered in durable vulcanized rubber (withstands molten metal temperatures). Internal servos operate silently; no cyber armor may be worn over cyber-legs. Vulcanized alloy structure is virtually indestructible (resisting crushing forces up to 💪+5). Speed version provides +3 to 👣, tracked sole pads for traction, climbing claws for soft surfaces, and leaps/jumps made at +3.

gear.name: Cyber-Legs (Strength Version) (mso)
gear.notes: Complete bionic replacement of both legs including pelvic reinforcement. Metal alloy core covered in durable vulcanized rubber. Internal servos operate silently; no cyber armor may be worn over cyber-legs. Vulcanized alloy structure is virtually indestructible (resisting crushing forces up to 💪+5). Strength version enhances leg lifting power by 💪+5 (applies to shoulder lifts, leg presses, and carrying capacity; leg attacks gain +1 Dmg), with a -1 penalty to 👣.

gear.name: Cyber-Oxygenator Implant (mso)
gear.notes: A surgical prosthetic replacing a segment of the pulmonary vein with an in-line micro-compressor that filters and stores surplus oxygen from the bloodstream, automatically re-infusing the blood when external breathing is compromised.

gear.name: Enhanced Ear (mso)
gear.notes: During this operation, one of the patient’s eardrums and inner ears is replaced with a variable, hypersensitive audial implant. After the operation, the patient can mentally adjust the implant to amplify sound so that all 👁️ Perception check based on hearing are made at +3. The implant automatically filters out all sounds loud enough to cause harm, and volume may be adjusted at will. Picks up frequencies ranging well above and below human hearing.

gear.name: Joint Locks (mso)
gear.notes: Joint lock surgery replaces all major joints in the body (specifically arms and legs) with techsteel mechanical joints. locked joints are pre-tuned to automatically release if force begins to fracture adjoining skeletal structure (extremely effective with Titanium Endoskeleton). Purely compressional resistance (e.g. bracing a collapsing ceiling) increases Str by +3. Heavy items can be carried in tiring positions without fatigue, and patients can grip items or hold body positions indefinitely without concentration or tiredness.

gear.name: Power Joints (mso)
gear.notes: Power joint operation is similar to joint lock operation, but joints in only one appendage are replaced. Slightly more bulky. Power joints function like joint locks, but when joints are used in extreme exertion (e.g. lifting a boulder, bending bars), joint power automatically activates when muscle limit is reached. A failed 💪 check is doubled when the power joint kicks in (makes an audible whine like an electric winch).

gear.name: QA Forearm (mso)
gear.notes: Replaces the patient's old limb with a mechanical forearm of similar strength and dexterity, designed to attach to the Quick Attach Couplink. Equipped with internally locking joints. Fingers are optionally claw-tipped. Unlike most implants, the QA Forearm does not add body weight, but has an encumbrance of 15.

gear.name: Quick Attach Couplink (mso)
gear.notes: Patient's forearm is fitted with a techsteel elbow socket with drive shaft, control couplings, and chest-implanted power conduits. Allows rapid tool and weapon swapping. Standard unenhanced swap takes one movement action.

gear.name: Thermoplas Implant (mso)
gear.notes: A cylinder is implanted on the pulmonary artery with a sensor that activates when the blood drops below normal body temperature. The thermoplas heats the blood flow through it, allowing the user to survive without protective clothing in temperatures as low as 100 below zero.

gear.name: Tish-Shocks (mso)
gear.notes: Sub-dermal cylindrical dampeners embedded throughout the skeleton. Actuate instantly upon crushing or falling impact, creating localized magnetic absorption fields that provide +2 AR vs blunt and falling damage.

gear.name: Titanium Endoskeleton (mso)
gear.notes: Exhaustive 10-hour bionic procedure infusing the skeleton with titanium alloy filaments and reinforced joint sockets. Grants Advantage on joint locks, triples static deadlift capacity, and provides +3 AR vs blunt damage (stacks with sub-dermal tish-shocks). Bone structure is virtually indestructible with max skeletal resilience (Adv(💪12), resisting crushing up to 💪+5 force).

gear.name: Audio Recorder (mso)
gear.notes: Recorders are equipped with anti-grav units enabling them to hover wherever left or follow their user (👣 12, hovering just behind the right shoulder 2 feet up). By being attached to a handcomp, a simple flight routine can be programmed. Audio Recorder: This device records all sound up to 24 hours, and may be set to filter out certain frequencies in order to reduce background noise.

gear.name: AV Recorder (mso)
gear.notes: Recorders are equipped with anti-grav units enabling them to hover wherever left or follow their user (👣 12, hovering just behind the right shoulder 2 feet up). By being attached to a handcomp, a simple flight routine can be programmed. AV Recorder: This recorder is a silver sphere that records all audio and visual stimulus in a full 360 degree area.

gear.name: Handcomp (mso)
gear.notes: The computers of known space are generally quite small, easily fitting into an Anthropos’ hand. A handcomp comes with a holographically-projected keyboard, holoscreen, full up- and down link capabilities, and near-unlimited information storage capacity (based on magnetomic memory systems utilizing a phased crystalline array). Handcomps typically process information and run programs at a d6 rating.

gear.name: Cyber-Fist (mso)
gear.notes: Range: 1. A massive industrial cybernetic forearm replacement surgically attached at the elbow joint. Built with reinforced duralloy finger joint locks and an outer mentally commanded weighted sheath studded with armor-penetrating spikes that slides over the knuckles. Enhances unarmed Brawl strikes.

gear.name: Force Gauntlet (mso)
gear.notes: Range: 1. Flexible micro-articulated metallic gloves woven with internal repulsor projectors that trigger on physical impact to amplify unarmed Brawl strikes.

gear.name: Implosion Ball (mso)
gear.notes: Range: Short. A delicate cherry-sized hollow sphere crafted from resonant crystal. When infused with Sorce energy and hurled, the sphere shatters on impact and collapses inward into a localized dimensional rift.

gear.name: QA Grappler (mso)
gear.notes: Range: Medium. A cybernetic arm-mounted winch and grappling assembly firing an ultrafilament cable tipped with a locking grapnel. Used for tactical ascent, high-load hauling, and combat entanglement. Mounts via a Quick Attach Couplink.

gear.name: Sorce Crystal (mso)
gear.notes: Range: Short. A hollow, multi-faceted crystalline sphere the size of a small grenade. When infused with magical energy and hurled, the crystal detonates upon impact, discharging a concentrated burst of resonant arcane force across an area.

gear.name: Spike Beetles (mso)
gear.notes: Range: Short. A compact bio-containment canister holding a symbiotic colony of squat, spiky-shelled beetles and puffball seed caches. When seeds are scattered across a perimeter, the beetles burrow and establish an area-denial trap that swarms approaching intruders.

gear.name: Sponge Ball (mso)
gear.notes: Range: Short. A fibrous Kryllian biological sphere originally used in athletic games, adapted by skirmishers as an area-denial weapon. When tossed or rolled, it bursts on contact into hundreds of pressurized adhesive streamers that expand into a rigid, sticky web across an area.

gear.name: Grapple Gun (mso)
gear.notes: This item resembles a crossbow, but is designed to shoot a flanged grappling device. Grapple guns can be fired independently or attached to a hard point (see EM, tech, armor). The basic gun includes 100 feet of ultrafilament line on a spool able to support 1000 lbs.

gear.name: Credit Card (mso)
gear.notes: A credit card is a micro thin card with a digital readout and an optical transaction disk bonded to its surface. Credit cards are the standard medium of transaction and currency storage in known space. Normal credit cards have a 20 security rating. A card’s security rating may be increased by 10 for every 100 cr paid.

gear.name: Illuminator (mso)
gear.notes: Illuminators provide a 90 degree cone of light out to 20 squares. They also have an infrared toggle which allows them to shine light in the infrared spectrum, visible spectrum, or both. They are easily carried and are equipped with an ultralock pad so they may be mounted on any surface (such as a helmet).

gear.name: First Aid Kit (mso)
gear.notes: A compact 5"x8" portable medical kit containing emergency dressings, topical anesthetics, laser cauterizers, mediskin patches, thermal compresses, and sedative injectors designed for rapid trauma stabilization.

gear.name: Laser Scalpel
gear.notes: High-frequency precision surgical laser scalpel that cuts and cauterizes simultaneously. Rating 10.

gear.name: Laser Scalpel (mso)
gear.notes: A specialized medical cutting instrument projecting a micro-calibrated laser emitter that makes micro-thin sterile incisions while simultaneously cauterizing severed blood vessels.

gear.name: Poison Antidote (Common)
gear.notes: Broad-spectrum synthesized antidote neutralizing common biological toxins and venoms. Rating 10.

gear.name: Poison Antidote (Common) (mso)
gear.notes: A standardized pre-formulated chemical and biological antitoxin vial engineered to rapidly counteract common insect venoms, reptile bites, and biological toxins.

gear.name: Power Syringe
gear.notes: Pneumatic micro-injector designed for instant dermal delivery of antidotes, vaccines, and stimulants. Rating 10.

gear.name: Power Syringe (mso)
gear.notes: A compact pneumatic high-pressure hypospray applicator designed for needle-free transdermal delivery of medical cartridges through clothing and light armor seams.

gear.name: Universal Poison Antidote (mso)
gear.notes: A high-grade military and alchemical broad-spectrum counter-agent engineered with catalytic chelating enzymes capable of neutralizing both lethal neurotoxic venoms and complex synthetic chemical poisons.

gear.name: Vaccine Dose (Common)
gear.notes: Standard inoculated vaccine dose protecting against prevalent sector pathogens. Rating 10.

gear.name: Vaccine Dose (Common) (mso)
gear.notes: Standard inoculated vaccine dose protecting against prevalent sector pathogens. d6 rating.

gear.name: Power Pack (mso)
gear.notes: Cold fusion portable heavy power supply equipped with retractable power cables to continuously supply energy to heavy electronic devices and powered armor systems.

gear.name: Nutritab (mso)
gear.notes: Small dietary tabs produced by a nutripress or purchased separately. Supplies adequate nutrition for an entire day.

gear.name: Communicator
gear.notes: Text, audio, and audiovisual comms; ~200 miles including low-orbit. Open or Selective transceiver.

gear.name: D-Crawler
gear.notes: MR 8 transport; capacity. 1x1x1 sq interior; sealed compartment break (20).

gear.name: DeCipher
gear.notes: Security bypass: hack locks, find codes, override safeguards.

gear.name: Disguise Pack
gear.notes: Alters appearance (cosmetics, morphskin, biodyes). Stability 12 hr.

gear.name: EnviroCube
gear.notes: Generates a 2x2 airtight cube protecting against environmental gas, vacuum, and extreme temperatures (-200°F to 300°F); includes AirVault with 24 hours of breathable air.

gear.name: EnviroTent
gear.notes: 2x2 by 6 ft tall shelter; 3 occupants; 7-day air/water/nutrients; -300°F to 400°F; long range emergency transponder.

gear.name: First Aid Pack
gear.notes: 1st Deg Wnds if new; stops bleeding.

gear.name: FusionSplicer
gear.notes: nearly any substance; strips, splices, coats wires; repairs cloth/armor with stronger-than-original bonds.

gear.name: GlowTorch
gear.notes: Illuminates a 20-square wide path; infrared, visible, or both. Mounts via Q-Bond pad.

gear.name: Grappling Gun
gear.notes: Fires grappling hook; 100 ft Q-Bond cable supports 1000 lbs.

gear.name: HealGel
gear.notes: Heals 1st Deg; immediate tissue regeneration.

gear.name: HoistMaster
gear.notes: Winch for Grappling Gun; hoist/lower at 20 ft/Rnd.

gear.name: HoloCaster
gear.notes: Projects duplicate image up to medium range; mimics wearer; attacks pass through image thus attacker realizes fake

gear.name: Hover Drone
gear.notes: Verbal command: hover, follow, or pattern; max medium range. Carries; MR(10), MR(*.5) if carrying. [Dod/AR(✨)/(✨)] Vit[=(✨-1)].

gear.name: Hover Drone Remote
gear.notes: Controls drone remotely up to 200 Sqs; live audio-visual feed.

gear.name: ImageScanner
gear.notes: Records holographic image for ImageWrap; In close range, front/back/side; stores 10 images.

gear.name: ImageWrap
gear.notes: Holographic disguise around user; ^👁️. Stores 2 images.

gear.name: Micro Hover Bug
gear.notes: Hovers or follows target (MR 12); programmable via DataSleeve.

gear.name: Miniflare Gun
gear.notes: Fires signal flare (1000 ft); set to illuminate, tracer, and/or whistle.

gear.name: Miniflare Gun Flares
gear.notes: Ammo for Miniflare Gun or similar.

gear.name: MiniScub Cartridge
gear.notes: 1 hour compressed air for MiniScuba or similar.

gear.name: MiniScuba
gear.notes: Mouthpiece + cartridge; 1 hr air; cartridge auto-fills when not in use.

gear.name: NanoShear
gear.notes: Precision cut or engrave up to 6 in; rating 40. Auto-cut or programmed patterns.

gear.name: Omni-Fab
gear.notes: A compact quantum molecular assembler capable of printing simple tools and non-weapon supplies instantly.

gear.name: Personal Scanner
gear.notes: Handheld scanner medium range. Pose question to GM; answer limited to 1 word.

gear.name: PlasmaTorch
gear.notes: Plasma cutter/welder; up to12 in depth; cuts steel and bulkheads.

gear.name: PowerTap
gear.notes: Monitor/siphon energy. Holds 100 srg

gear.name: Q-Bond Cable
gear.notes: 100 ft cable; Q-Bond ends affix to surfaces; controlled from spool.

gear.name: QuantumChef
gear.notes: One-inch cube expands to tech-plates, utensils, thermal cups; atomic heating/cooling; stores up to week's food and water

gear.name: Backpack (mso)
gear.notes: This is the standard carrying device for explorers, adventurers, etc. It may be made of leather or synthetic material (although Calemora prefer leather). Backpacks can normally hold items of up to 100 Enc., and have various pockets and compartments for easy access.

gear.name: Tech Case (1'x1')
gear.notes: A 1'x1' reinforced tech case that can be security sealed for protection (Dif 20). Rating 10.

gear.name: Tech Case (1'x1') (mso)
gear.notes: A 1’x1' reinforced tech case that can be security sealed for protection (Dif 20). d6 rating.

gear.name: Miniflare Gun (mso)
gear.notes: This small gun contains ten signal flares, each one of which may be set to produce a special effect during their 1000 foot flight. Flares may be set to illuminate (in which case they will light up all surroundings within a number of feet equal to their height), to leave a tracer (a long, glowing path from the point at which the flare was fired, which lasts for several minutes), or to whistle loudly. Each flare may only have one special effect.

gear.name: Oxygen Canister (1 hr) (mso)
gear.notes: Additional six-inch canister holding an hour of compressed air for the Oxygenator Mask. Auto-fills when not in use.

gear.name: Biometer (mso)
gear.notes: A wrist or appendage band displaying real-time vital signs (Vitality, wounds, heart rate, respiration). Continuously monitors internal biometrics, granting Adv(First Aid 👁️) and 👁️+4^Dif to detect poisons, toxins, pathogens, or abnormal foreign substances. Emits audio-visual alerts upon detection.

gear.name: Crawler, Personal (mso)
gear.notes: A personal crawler is a small, tracked transport unit intended to carry equipment, possessions, and scientific samples with stats equal to PC stats (👣 8, Def 5, AR 5). Crawlers have an environmentally sealed compartment protected by a security lock which prevents unauthorized access (Dif 20). Internal antigrav generators and dimensional transducers easily carry up to 500 Enc within a 10' x 10' x 10' interior compartment, although externally measuring only 3' x 2' x 2'.

gear.name: Disguise Kit (mso)
gear.notes: Contains cosmetics, plastiskin, bio-colorizers, and molecular injectors to alter physical features, hair, chitin, fur, or eye color for up to 12 hours before breaking down. Grants Adv(Disguise 👁️) or 👁️+4 on disguise and cosmetic deception checks.

gear.name: Energy Flow Monitor (mso)
gear.notes: An energy flow monitor can hold up to 100 surge of energy. Stored energy can then be used to power an item or used to replenish an item's capacitor. Such transfer of energy is also accomplished without the need for physical contact between the item and the energy flow monitor. Transfer rate is, again, equal to the success of a roll. If a monitor is attached to a device’s power port, the transfer rate (either way) is instantaneous.

gear.name: Genesis Capsule (mso)
gear.notes: Genesis capsules are large black pills, filled with viscous matter. They are manufactured by the Company, which will not divulge the secrets of their creation. However, it has been determined that mechnites (microscopic robots) are contained within the capsule’s fluid. It is thought that the mechnites fill themselves with the fluid, then travel through the body’s systems (via blood vessels, lymph nodes, etc.) until they find damaged tissue. Then they inject the healing fluid, and use their small claws to tear away dead tissue and repair the area. The effect of all this is that at the end of the next round following ingestion, all wounds will be healed and the user will be fully revived (if unconscious). Only one capsule may be taken safely in a 24 hour period. Additional capsules require a FR roll — vs 10 times the number of capsules taken in the last 24 hours. If the FR roll fails, the user is irrevocably dead.

gear.name: Hacker (mso)
gear.notes: Compact data unit with display and interface keypad that splices into security systems, access panels, and computer safeguards. Decrypts security codes and overrides safeguards, granting 👁️+4^Dif (or Adv(Hacking 👁️)) on electronic security checks.

gear.name: Holo-Scanner (mso)
gear.notes: A holo-scanner records an individual’s holographic image. While holoimages are the standard known space version of modern photography, holo-scanner's can provide the advanced images required by hologuise units. Subjects must be scanned from within 2 sq. The scan must include front, back and side angles of the subject. Up to 10 images may be stored in the holo-scanner. These images may be transferred to and from a hologuise.

gear.name: Hologuise (mso)
gear.notes: A hologuise is a personal projection device which masquerades as a wristwatch. However, it can create a prerecorded holographic image around the user. The image is very accurate (d10 vs Awa on all attempts to detect the disguise). The image moves as the user moves thanks to an advanced processor and a number of sophisticated motion sensors which are placed upon the user's extremities. Up to two images may be stored in the hologuise at any given time.

gear.name: Jump-Pack (mso)
gear.notes: This backpack-sized unit contains an array of thrusters enabling individuals to make an assisted jump at with advantage (see CM, speed). A 🏃 check may be required for difficult landings (Dif set by the GM).

gear.name: Laser Cutter (mso)
gear.notes: Laser cutters are designed to cut very hard material very precisely. Their cutting ability is rated at d12, however, they can only cut something which can be placed between their cutting jaws (which can extend to 6 inches wide and 6 inches deep). They can also be programmed to auto-cut a specific pattern or engrave an item. Laser cutters can also sever live power cables while cauterizing the ends (preventing power leakage).

gear.name: Macrovisor (mso)
gear.notes: Macrovisors autotint to provide glare resistance (d6). They also optimize vision (+1 to vision based 👁️ Perception check) and provide image enhancement up to 500:1 (in other words, an object 500 feet away will appear to be one foot away when using image enhancement). This unit may be secured to the user’s head using ultralock pads placed near the temples (keeping user’s hands free). The speaker attachment enables the macrovisor to focus automatically and provide digital readouts of distance, light conditions, etc.

gear.name: Mess Kit (mso)
gear.notes: A Guild mess kit is far more than a simple collection of plates and eating utensils. Dimensionally compressed, the kit occupies a one-inch cube, and may be expanded by depressing a button on top. The mess kit contains three tech-plates (which sterilize, cook and cut your food), an ultralock eating utensil, and three thermal cups. The plates and cups are equipped with miniaturized atomic heating and cooling elements.

gear.name: Nutripress (mso)
gear.notes: Breaks food down into its component elements, producing compact nutritabs. Each nutritab supplies complete nutritional sustenance for an entire day. Holds seven pre-pressed nutritabs, while a dimensional reservoir stores up to a week’s worth of fresh water.

gear.name: Oxygenator Mask (mso)
gear.notes: An oxygenator is a light mask and six-inch long canister, which holds an hour of compressed air. The canister can be set on auto-fill when not being used.

gear.name: Palmstore (mso)
gear.notes: Thin palm-fitted band equipped with a micro-transporter storing the energy pattern of any one object up to 25 Enc. Stored objects dematerialize into memory with zero encumbrance, instantly materializing back into the user's hand upon command. Built-in safeguards prevent storage of living organisms; one palmstore may be worn per hand.

gear.name: Personal Scanner (mso)
gear.notes: Handheld sensor unit with holographic projected display and keypad (range 10 sq). Scans for lifesigns, energy conduits, and structural anomalies, granting 👁️+4^Dif (or Adv(Scan 👁️)) on technical sensor sweeps.

gear.name: Personal Transporter (mso)
gear.notes: A personal transporter is a belt that fits around the user’s waist. The unit can transport the wearer and any carried objects up to 100 miles (or to a ship in low orbit). A personal transporter has a 100 surge capacitor and a Q-cell which replenishes 50 surge every hour. Each transport expends 50 surge. In addition, the unit may be used to transport the user and one other individual (if fully charged), expending all of the transporter's energy. Personal transporters are not equipped for use with energy clips or power cables, and their technology is not able to transport other personal transporters.

gear.name: PFF 1 (mso)
gear.notes: The ultimate advancement of field-based technology, personal force fields throw up a shimmering bubble, protecting their owners from all physical- and energy-based attacks. Force fields carry their own power packs, and are available at a variety of protective levels. Zin-Shee shield technology is widely utilized coreward.

gear.name: PFF 3 (mso)
gear.notes: Personal force field generating a protective shimmering bubble of field-based kinetic shielding (+2 AR).

gear.name: PFF 5 (mso)
gear.notes: Elite personal force field generating a shimmering protective barrier with advanced kinetic absorption (+3 AR).

gear.name: PFF 6 (mso)
gear.notes: Top-tier personal force field utilizing Zin-Shee field harmonics to generate heavy kinetic deflection (+4 AR).

gear.name: Phase Deviator (mso)
gear.notes: A phase deviator is a small unit worn on the belt, which generates a powerful field of dimensional flux. The wearer rapidly “phases” between several locations, appearing blurry and hard to see. Their effect is to increase the wearer’s Def by +3. While they are incredibly effective defensive devices, phase deviators have a single flaw — they reduce their user’s attack rolls by -3 (it’s hard to fight when you keep blipping around).

gear.name: Pod, Personal Hover (mso)
gear.notes: This small drone may be verbally ordered to hover, move in a set pattern, or follow its owner. The drone can rise to an altitude of 10 sq. They are equipped with the same functions as an A-V recorder and a handcomp, and may be upgraded similarly. A hover pod can carry up to 50 Enc. of equipment. Its arm can lift anything up to this encumbrance which is not actively resisting. Its unencumbered MR is 10, but its MR is 6 if it is carrying any payload at all. In combat pods have a d6 rating for defensive purposes only.

gear.name: Poisons (mso)
gear.notes: Poisons can be purchased in four forms: contact (doubled cost), intravenous (normal), oral (normal), or gaseous (quadruple cost, covers 3x3 squares). Standard poisons include Choking (125 cr, prevents breathing), Corrosive (200 cr, burns continuous tissue), Death (250 cr, causes fatal heart attacks, Kalos II kicta fungus antidote), Knockout (150 cr, medical anesthesia), Laughing (125 cr, uncontrollable laughter), Paralysis (150 cr, male joc-tun serpent extract), and Sleep (125 cr, Setchie plant extract, Shanask are immune).

gear.name: Power Frame (mso)
gear.notes: A power frame is a military version of the power lifters commonly used to load cargo and move heavy objects. It resembles an oversized humanoid framework, with large mechanical claws and a partially-armored roll cage to protect its driver. Standard systems (included free) are compensators (👣 4), strength enhancers (with advantage — d12 minimum), joint locks, three external hard points, targeting computer, and two flood lights.

gear.name: Slap Pack (mso)
gear.notes: When slapped upon a wound, a slap pack’s two gel compounds combine to form a fast acting healing salve, which causes any wounded tissue to immediately begin regeneration. Each pack works only once, and almost instantaneously heals d6 points of damage.

gear.name: Space Suit (mso)
gear.notes: Space suits are very compact and efficient. These suits are completely space worthy, but are of minimal use in combat. Standard systems (included free) are sealed, internal environment, illuminator kit, macrovisor kit with star-light and star-lamp enhancement, and ultralock boot kit.

gear.name: Survival Bag (mso)
gear.notes: The survival bag is a one-person sleeping bag which may be used to withstand extreme climatic conditions. A built-in stasis field and heating/cooling network keep the user warm in temperatures as low as 200 below zero and keep the user relatively cool up to 300 degrees (Fahrenheit). The bag comes equipped with a 24 hour air supply which can auto-fill. An internal compartment stores a day’s supply of water which the user may drink through a special nipple attachment.

gear.name: Survival Shield Generator (mso)
gear.notes: Deploys a 2x2 hermetic cubic barrier of force. Airtight seal resists extreme temperatures (-200° to 300°F) and the vacuum of space. Blocks physical intrusions and debris with a static barrier strength of 💪+5 (does not block energy weapons or sorce). Internal compressor provides 24 hours of breathable air.

gear.name: Survival Tent (mso)
gear.notes: A survival tent is the ultimate portable shelter. Sealed with an ultralock airlock, a survival tent contains enough compressed air and nutrients to sustain up to three occupants for 7 days. Internal dimensional stabilizers provide a comfortable 10 foot square living area complete with hover cots and a small table. The tent has an outside dimension of 3 feet square (and when deactivated and rolled up, the tent is about the size of an individual's forearm). The tent’s environment is stable against temperatures from 300 below zero to 400 above (Fahrenheit). A 100 mile range emergency transponder is built into the tent. An ultralock bottom enables the tent to be attached to nearly any surface.

gear.name: Targeter (mso)
gear.notes: Targeters are small units which give ranged shot weapons (only) a +1 to hit and doubles the weapon’s range. The targeter is a cylindrical unit attached to a weapon, which sends out a thin bright laser beam for easy identification of the weapon’s impact point. When activated, targeters also provide a magnified view of the target complete with elevation, range, and size readouts.

gear.name: Tech Pack (mso)
gear.notes: A tech pack is a durable plasteel backpack with an internal dimensional condenser. The pack attaches to the user’s back via two ultralock strips. The pack itself is only about one foot square and six inches deep. However, it can hold items as if it were 4’x3', and has a capacity of 150 Enc.

gear.name: Tech Wand (mso)
gear.notes: Handheld pistol-grip cutting torch and industrial welder. Exerts a precision cutting strength of 💪+5 against blast doors, bulkheads, and hardened alloy plating, granting Adv(Repair 👁️) on structural welding.

gear.name: Transportal (mso)
gear.notes: This device consists of a one-foot long, two inch thick square bar. However, at least two of these devices are required for operation. When activated, the transportal bar telescopes out to 3 feet and bonds (using an ultralock field) to the surface below it. When first activated, the transportal must search for other transportals within its 1000 foot range. The portal's search ability is d6, and may be rolled once each round (and it may be combined(cat) with transporter skill). Only one other portal a round may be searched for, even if several are in the area. Once another bar is located a seven-foot tall wall of energy appears above the bar. The user may then step through the first bar’s portal and instantly exit the second doorway. These devices may remain active endlessly without power failure. However, heavy traffic will overload their circuits, shutting them off for several hours.

gear.name: Turbo Pack (mso)
gear.notes: A turbo pack is worn on the back and utilizes turbofans and a minijet propulsion system for atmospheric flight. Due to its reliance on air, it is useless in space. A pair of retractable arms complete with joysticks provide maneuvering control. When activated, the pack can lift its user and any carried items up to 100 feet per round and allows for a horizontal 👣 24. These packs are equipped with Q-cells and capacitors. The pack can operate for up to one hour before running out of power. The Q-cell recharges the packs’s power at the rate of 1 minute of flight time every 10 minutes. Packs are not equipped for power pack or energy clip use.

gear.name: Ultrafilament Line (mso)
gear.notes: Ultrafilament line comes in contained spools of 100 feet. Ultrafilament is very thin, very light, and virtually unbreakable (2d8). Despite its thinness, ultrafilament line is made with an ionic bonding surface, which allows users to climb without difficulty. On top of this, the end is sensitized with ultralock technology, enabling the line to be affixed to nearly any item without the need for tieing. The ultralock can be controlled from the spool container at the other end. Ultralock technology was developed by The Company. It utilizes a patented micro-range tractorbeam system which can lock onto physical items as determined by a selective AI program (i.e., it knows when to lock on and when to let go). This technology has nearly replaced the magnometric technology of the past, because ultralock can attach itself to nearly any material (not just metals).

gear.name: Ultralock Boots (mso)
gear.notes: Ultralock boots allow the user to stick to any surface with a d12 Str. The user must lock and unlock the boots with each step slowing movement to 1/2 normal. When activated wearers may walk on slippery surfaces and even hang upside-down.

gear.name: Ultralock Utility Belt (mso)
gear.notes: This utility harness attaches items to it via ultralock technology. It can hold up to 100 enc of items. The built in AI routine is very good at determining when an item is being pulled off by the user as opposed to being caught on a chair, brushed by swinging arms, etc. A built in security routine allows the user to program in up to 10 other authorized individuals. Otherwise, items must be wrenched off the belt — Str (20).

gear.name: Wirelocks (mso)
gear.notes: Automated precision wire strippers and circuit splicers utilizing a micro-molecular drill and bonding field to insulate and splice wiring or patch armor tears with superior bond strength.

gear.name: Compressor (mso)
gear.notes: A portable high-pressure gas cylinder equipped with an automated atmospheric intake turbine, shoulder strap, and integrated anti-gravity ballast to counteract the physical weight of compressed gas. Sustains normal respiration for up to 24 hours in hazardous or vacuum environments.

gear.name: Engineering Supplies
gear.notes: Miscellaneous components, conduits, fuses, and connectors for starship, ATM, or weapon field repairs. Rating 10.

gear.name: Engineering Supplies (mso)
gear.notes: A heavy-duty portable satchel packed with universal fiber conduits, replacement relays, solid-state fuses, patch alloy, and diagnostic couplers for emergency technical repairs.

gear.name: Plasma Precipitator Pack (mso)
gear.notes: This backpack-style device is required when using a plasma weapon (plasma sword, turbo plaz, etc.). The precipitator pack filters particles from the air and superheats them to a state of plasma, which is then available for use by any plasma weapon which is plugged into the pack.

monsters.name: Aviathar
monsters.weapons: Claw, Beak, Blow Weapons, Blasters, Fang Rifle

monsters.name: Boner
monsters.abilities: Echolocation, Paralyzing Bite (Histamine Poison: Causes swelling; Paralysis over 4 Rnds)

monsters.name: Claw Enforcer
